passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: But for a satisfaction of my thought. No further harm.
passages.vernacular: 只係為咗滿足我嘅思緒。冇別嘅害處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只是為了滿足我的思緒。沒別的害處。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why of thy thought, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 你嘅思緒係咩,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的思緒是什麼,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I did not think he had been acquainted with her.
passages.vernacular: 我冇想到佢認識佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我沒想到他認識她。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O yes, and went between us very oft.
passages.vernacular: 啊,認識,而且常常喺我哋之間傳話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,認識,而且常常在我們之間傳話。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Indeed?
passages.vernacular: 真嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Indeed? Ay, indeed. Discern’st thou aught in that? Is he not honest?
passages.vernacular: 真嘅?係,真嘅。你從中睇出咩嗎?佢唔誠實嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的?是,真的。你從中看出什麼嗎?他不誠實嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Honest, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 誠實,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誠實,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Honest? ay, honest.
passages.vernacular: 誠實?係,誠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誠實?是,誠實。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My lord, for aught I know.
passages.vernacular: 大人,據我所知。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,據我所知。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What dost thou think?
passages.vernacular: 你點諗?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎麼想?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Think, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 諗,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Think, my lord? By heaven, he echoes me, As if there were some monster in his thought Too hideous to be shown. Thou dost mean something. I heard thee say even now, thou lik’st not that, When Cassio left my wife. What didst not like? And when I told thee he was of my counsel In my whole course of wooing, thou criedst, “Indeed?” And didst contract and purse thy brow together, As if thou then hadst shut up in thy brain Some horrible conceit: if thou dost love me, Show me thy thought.
passages.vernacular: 諗,大人?天啊,佢重複我嘅話,好似佢心裡有個太醜陋而唔能展示嘅怪物。你嘅話有所指。我剛才聽到你講,凱西奧離開我妻子時,你唔鍾意咁樣。你唔鍾意咩?當我告訴你,在我整個求婚過程中佢係我嘅參謀時,你喊「真嘅?」仲皺起眉頭緊縮,好似你把某個可怕嘅念頭鎖進腦裡:如果你愛我,把你嘅想法告訴我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想,大人?天啊,他在重複我的話,好像他心裡有個太醜陋而不能展示的怪物。你的話有所指。我剛才聽到你說,凱西奧離開我妻子時,你不喜歡那樣。你不喜歡什麼?當我告訴你,在我整個求婚過程中他是我的參謀時,你喊「真的?」還皺起眉頭緊縮,好像你把某個可怕的念頭鎖進腦裡:如果你愛我,把你的想法告訴我。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My lord, you know I love you.
passages.vernacular: 大人,您知道我愛您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,您知道我愛您。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I think thou dost; And for I know thou’rt full of love and honesty And weigh’st thy words before thou giv’st them breath, Therefore these stops of thine fright me the more: For such things in a false disloyal knave Are tricks of custom; but in a man that’s just, They’re close dilations, working from the heart, That passion cannot rule.
passages.vernacular: 我諗你愛;因為我知道你充滿愛與誠實,且在講話之前先權衡你嘅話,所以你呢啲停頓更令我害怕:因為呢類事喺虛偽不忠嘅惡棍身上,係慣用嘅把戲;但喺正直嘅人身上,佢哋係隱藏嘅展開,從心裡發出,激情也無法控制。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想你愛;因為我知道你充滿愛與誠實,且在說話之前先權衡你的話,所以你這些停頓更令我害怕:因為這類事在虛偽不忠的惡棍身上,是慣用的把戲;但在正直的人身上,它們是隱藏的展開,從心裡發出,激情也無法控制。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: For Michael Cassio, I dare be sworn I think that he is honest.
passages.vernacular: 至於邁克爾·凱西奧,我敢發誓,我認為佢誠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於邁克爾·凱西奧,我敢發誓,我認為他誠實。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I think so too.
passages.vernacular: 我也咁認為。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也這樣認為。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Men should be what they seem; Or those that be not, would they might seem none!
passages.vernacular: 人應該表裡如一;否則,唔係咁嘅人,真希望佢哋睇起來也唔係!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 人應該表裡如一;否則,不是這樣的人,真希望他們看起來也不是!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Certain, men should be what they seem.
passages.vernacular: 確實,人應該表裡如一。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實,人應該表裡如一。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why then, I think Cassio’s an honest man.
passages.vernacular: 咁,我認為凱西奧係個誠實嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,我認為凱西奧是個誠實的人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, yet there’s more in this: I prithee, speak to me as to thy thinkings, As thou dost ruminate, and give thy worst of thoughts The worst of words.
passages.vernacular: 唔,呢度面還有更多:請你好似對你自己嘅思想一樣對我講,好似你在反覆思量,把你最壞嘅想法用最壞嘅話講出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這裡面還有更多:請你像對你自己的思想那樣對我說,像你在反覆思量那樣,把你最壞的想法用最壞的話說出來。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Good my lord, pardon me. Though I am bound to every act of duty, I am not bound to that all slaves are free to. Utter my thoughts? Why, say they are vile and false: As where’s that palace whereinto foul things Sometimes intrude not? Who has a breast so pure But some uncleanly apprehensions Keep leets and law-days, and in session sit With meditations lawful?
passages.vernacular: 好大人,請原諒我。雖然我受約束要履行一切義務,但我唔受約束去做所有奴隸都可以自由做嘅事。講出我嘅想法?咦,就算佢哋係卑鄙虛假嘅:邊座宮殿唔會有時有骯髒嘅嘢闖入?誰嘅胸懷純潔到唔會有啲唔潔嘅猜疑舉行法庭、審判日,並與正當嘅沉思一齊開庭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好大人,請原諒我。雖然我受約束要履行一切義務,但我不受約束去做所有奴隸都可以自由做的事。說出我的想法?咦,就算它們是卑鄙虛假的:哪座宮殿不會有時有骯髒的東西闖入?誰的胸懷純潔到不會有些不潔的猜疑舉行法庭、審判日,並與正當的沉思一起開庭?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Thou dost conspire against thy friend, Iago, If thou but think’st him wrong’d and mak’st his ear A stranger to thy thoughts.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古,如果你認為你朋友受咗冤屈,卻令佢嘅耳朵對你嘅想法陌生,咁你就係在背叛朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古,如果你認為你朋友受了冤屈,卻讓他的耳朵對你的想法陌生,那你就是在背叛朋友。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I do beseech you, Though I perchance am vicious in my guess, As, I confess, it is my nature’s plague To spy into abuses, and of my jealousy Shapes faults that are not,—that your wisdom From one that so imperfectly conceits, Would take no notice; nor build yourself a trouble Out of his scattering and unsure observance. It were not for your quiet nor your good, Nor for my manhood, honesty, or wisdom, To let you know my thoughts.
passages.vernacular: 我懇求您,我嘅猜測也許有毛病,我承認,窺探弊端係我天性嘅瘟疫,我嘅猜疑會編造唔存在嘅過錯——請您嘅智慧唔好理會呢個推測如此不完整嘅人;也唔好憑佢零散而不確定嘅觀察,為自己製造麻煩。讓您知道我嘅想法,既不利於您嘅安寧同益處,也唔合我嘅男子氣概、誠實或智慧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我懇求您,我的猜測也許有毛病,我承認,窺探弊端是我天性的瘟疫,我的猜疑會編造不存在的過錯——請您的智慧不要理會這個推測如此不完整的人;也不要憑他零散而不確定的觀察,為自己製造麻煩。讓您知道我的想法,既不利於您的安寧和益處,也不合我的男子氣概、誠實或智慧。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What dost thou mean?
passages.vernacular: 你係咩意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是什麼意思?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Good name in man and woman, dear my lord, Is the immediate jewel of their souls. Who steals my purse steals trash. ’Tis something, nothing; ’Twas mine, ’tis his, and has been slave to thousands. But he that filches from me my good name Robs me of that which not enriches him And makes me poor indeed.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅大人,男人同女人嘅好名聲,係佢哋靈魂最貼身嘅珍寶。偷我錢包嘅人偷嘅係垃圾。嗰算係有,也算冇;佢曾係我嘅,而家係佢嘅,也曾做過成千人嘅奴隸。但偷走我好名聲嘅人,搶走咗我嘅嘢,卻無助於佢致富,卻實在令我貧窮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的大人,男人和女人的好名聲,是他們靈魂最貼身的珍寶。偷我錢包的人偷的是垃圾。那算是有,也算沒有;它曾是我的,現在是他的,也曾做過成千人的奴隸。但偷走我好名聲的人,搶走了我的東西,卻無助於他致富,卻實在使我貧窮。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, I’ll know thy thoughts.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,我要知道你嘅想法。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,我要知道你的想法。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You cannot, if my heart were in your hand, Nor shall not, whilst ’tis in my custody.
passages.vernacular: 你唔能,即使我嘅心在你手裡,只要佢喺我嘅保管之中,你也唔會知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不能,即使我的心在你手裡,只要它在我的保管之中,你也不會知道。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ha?
passages.vernacular: 哈?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, beware, my lord, of jealousy; It is the green-ey’d monster which doth mock The meat it feeds on. That cuckold lives in bliss Who, certain of his fate, loves not his wronger; But O, what damned minutes tells he o’er Who dotes, yet doubts, suspects, yet strongly loves!
passages.vernacular: 啊,大人,小心嫉妒;佢係綠眼睛嘅怪物,嘲弄佢所吞食嘅食物。嗰個戴綠帽卻確知命運、唔愛傷害佢嘅人嘅丈夫,活喺福中;但啊,嗰個癡愛卻懷疑、猜疑卻深愛嘅人,數住幾咁該死嘅分分秒秒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,大人,小心嫉妒;它是綠眼睛的怪物,嘲弄它所吞食的食物。那個戴綠帽卻確知命運、不愛傷害他的人的丈夫,活在福中;但啊,那個癡愛卻懷疑、猜疑卻深愛的人,數著多麼該死的分分秒秒!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O misery!
passages.vernacular: 啊,悲慘!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,悲慘!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Poor and content is rich, and rich enough; But riches fineless is as poor as winter To him that ever fears he shall be poor. Good heaven, the souls of all my tribe defend From jealousy!
passages.vernacular: 貧窮而知足就係富有,而且足夠富有;但對於總怕自己會窮嘅人,無邊嘅財富也像冬天一樣貧乏。好上天,保護我全族嘅靈魂免於嫉妒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 貧窮而知足就是富有,而且足夠富有;但對於總怕自己會窮的人,無邊的財富也像冬天一樣貧乏。好上天,保護我全族的靈魂免於嫉妒!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why, why is this? Think’st thou I’d make a life of jealousy, To follow still the changes of the moon With fresh suspicions? No. To be once in doubt Is once to be resolv’d: exchange me for a goat When I shall turn the business of my soul To such exsufflicate and blown surmises, Matching thy inference. ’Tis not to make me jealous, To say my wife is fair, feeds well, loves company, Is free of speech, sings, plays, and dances well; Where virtue is, these are more virtuous: Nor from mine own weak merits will I draw The smallest fear or doubt of her revolt, For she had eyes, and chose me. No, Iago, I’ll see before I doubt; when I doubt, prove; And on the proof, there is no more but this: Away at once with love or jealousy!
passages.vernacular: 點解,點解咁樣?你以為我會把生活過成嫉妒,永遠跟隨月亮嘅圓缺用新嘅猜疑?唔會。一旦起疑,就一次解決:如果我把靈魂嘅大事轉向呢種乾癟、吹出嚟嘅臆測,匹配你嘅推論,就拎我換一隻山羊。講我妻子美麗、食得好、愛交際、言辭自由、唱歌彈琴跳舞好,呢啲並唔能令我嫉妒;有美德嘅地方,呢啲更顯得美德:我也唔會從自己微薄嘅優點中抽出對佢背叛嘅最小恐懼或疑慮,因為佢有眼睛,而選咗我。唔,伊阿古,我要先睇見先懷疑;懷疑時,就要證明;有咗證據,就只剩呢一件事:立刻拋開愛或嫉妒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,為什麼這樣?你以為我會把生活過成嫉妒,永遠跟隨月亮的圓缺用新的猜疑?不會。一旦起疑,就一次解決:如果我把靈魂的大事轉向這種乾癟、吹出來的臆測,匹配你的推論,就拿我換一隻山羊。說我妻子美麗、吃得好、愛交際、言辭自由、唱歌彈琴跳舞好,這些並不能使我嫉妒;有美德的地方,這些更顯得美德:我也不會從自己微薄的優點中抽出對她背叛的最小恐懼或疑慮,因為她有眼睛,而選了我。不,伊阿古,我要先看見才懷疑;懷疑時,就要證明;有了證據,就只剩這一件事:立刻拋開愛或嫉妒!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am glad of it, for now I shall have reason To show the love and duty that I bear you With franker spirit: therefore, as I am bound, Receive it from me. I speak not yet of proof. Look to your wife; observe her well with Cassio; Wear your eye thus, not jealous nor secure. I would not have your free and noble nature, Out of self-bounty, be abus’d. Look to’t. I know our country disposition well; In Venice they do let heaven see the pranks They dare not show their husbands. Their best conscience Is not to leave undone, but keep unknown.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興,因為而家我有理由用更坦率嘅精神向您表示我對您嘅愛同責任:所以,按我嘅職責,請聽我講。我仲未講到證據。留意您嘅妻子;觀察佢同凱西奧在一起嘅樣子;咁樣用眼睛:既不嫉妒也不放心。我唔願您自由高貴嘅天性,因為自己嘅寬厚而受騙。請留意。我好了解我哋國家嘅習性;喺威尼斯,佢哋讓上天睇見唔敢畀丈夫睇嘅把戲。佢哋最好嘅良心唔係唔做,而係唔畀人知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興,因為現在我有理由用更坦率的精神向您表示我對您的愛和責任:所以,按我的職責,請聽我說。我還沒說到證據。留意您的妻子;觀察她與凱西奧在一起的樣子;這樣用眼睛:既不嫉妒也不放心。我不願您自由高貴的天性,因為自己的寬厚而受騙。請留意。我很了解我們國家的習性;在威尼斯,她們讓上天看見不敢讓丈夫看的把戲。她們最好的良心不是不做,而是不讓人知道。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Dost thou say so?
passages.vernacular: 你咁講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這樣說?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: She did deceive her father, marrying you; And when she seem’d to shake and fear your looks, She loved them most.
passages.vernacular: 佢嫁畀您時欺騙咗佢父親;當佢似乎對您嘅面容發抖同害怕時,佢其實最愛佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她嫁給您時欺騙了她父親;當她似乎對您的面容發抖和害怕時,她其實最愛它。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: And so she did.
passages.vernacular: 佢確實如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她確實如此。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, go to then. She that so young could give out such a seeming, To seal her father’s eyes up close as oak, He thought ’twas witchcraft. But I am much to blame. I humbly do beseech you of your pardon For too much loving you.
passages.vernacular: 咦,咁你講吧。佢咁年輕就能裝出嗰樣嘅樣子,把父親嘅眼睛封得像橡木一樣緊,佢仲以為係巫術。但我太唔對喇。我謙卑地懇求您原諒,因為我太愛您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,你說吧。她那麼年輕就能裝出那樣的樣子,把父親的眼睛封得像橡木一樣緊,他還以為是巫術。但我太不對了。我謙卑地懇求您原諒,因為我太愛您。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am bound to thee for ever.
passages.vernacular: 我永遠感激你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠感激你。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I see this hath a little dash’d your spirits.
passages.vernacular: 我睇呢個稍微打擊咗您嘅精神。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看這稍微打擊了您的精神。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Not a jot, not a jot.
passages.vernacular: 一點也唔,一點也唔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一點也不,一點也不。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Trust me, I fear it has. I hope you will consider what is spoke Comes from my love. But I do see you’re mov’d. I am to pray you not to strain my speech To grosser issues nor to larger reach Than to suspicion.
passages.vernacular: 相信我,我怕確實如此。我希望您考慮到我所講嘅出於我嘅愛。但我睇出您被觸動喇。我請求您唔好把我嘅話引申到更粗劣嘅結論或更廣嘅範圍,超過猜疑嘅程度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我,我怕確實如此。我希望您考慮到我所說的出於我的愛。但我看出您被觸動了。我請求您不要把我的話引申到更粗劣的結論或更廣的範圍,超過猜疑的程度。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I will not.
passages.vernacular: 我唔會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不會。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Should you do so, my lord, My speech should fall into such vile success Which my thoughts aim’d not. Cassio’s my worthy friend. My lord, I see you’re mov’d.
passages.vernacular: 如果您嗰樣做,大人,我嘅話就會得到我心裡冇諗到嘅卑劣結果。凱西奧係我嘅好朋友。大人,我睇出您被觸動喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您那樣做,大人,我的話就會得到我心裡沒想到的卑劣結果。凱西奧是我的好朋友。大人,我看出您被觸動了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: No, not much mov’d. I do not think but Desdemona’s honest.
passages.vernacular: 唔,冇點動。我認為戴絲德夢娜係貞潔嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,沒怎麼動。我認為戴絲德夢娜是貞潔的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Long live she so! And long live you to think so!
passages.vernacular: 願佢永遠咁樣!也願您永遠咁諗!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願她永遠這樣!也願您永遠這樣想!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: And yet, how nature erring from itself—
passages.vernacular: 然而,天性竟如何背離自身——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而,天性竟如何背離自身——

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, there’s the point. As, to be bold with you, Not to affect many proposed matches, Of her own clime, complexion, and degree, Whereto we see in all things nature tends; Foh! One may smell in such a will most rank, Foul disproportion, thoughts unnatural. But pardon me: I do not in position Distinctly speak of her, though I may fear Her will, recoiling to her better judgement, May fall to match you with her country forms, And happily repent.
passages.vernacular: 對,關鍵在呢度。比如,恕我大膽直講,佢唔喜歡許多提議嘅婚事,都係同佢自己氣候、膚色、身份嘅人,而我哋睇到喺一切事上天性都傾向呢個;呸!喺咁樣嘅意願中可以聞到最惡臭嘅、骯髒嘅不相稱,違反自然嘅思想。但請原諒我:我並冇明確地針對佢講,雖然我可能擔心,佢嘅意願退回到更好嘅判斷時,會拎您與佢本國嘅形象比較,也許會後悔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,關鍵在這裡。比如,恕我大膽直言,她不喜歡許多提議的婚事,都是同她自己氣候、膚色、身份的人,而我們看到在一切事上天性都傾向這個;呸!在這樣的意願中可以聞到最惡臭的、骯髒的不相稱,違反自然的思想。但請原諒我:我並沒有明確地針對她說,雖然我可能擔心,她的意願退回到更好的判斷時,會拿您與她本國的形象比較,也許會後悔。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Farewell, farewell: If more thou dost perceive, let me know more; Set on thy wife to observe. Leave me, Iago.
passages.vernacular: 再見,再見:如果你察覺到更多,讓我知道;叫你妻子去觀察。離開我,伊阿古。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見,再見:如果你察覺到更多,讓我知道;叫你妻子去觀察。離開我,伊阿古。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: [Going.] My lord, I take my leave.
passages.vernacular: [走。]大人,我告辭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [走。]大人,我告辭。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why did I marry? This honest creature doubtless Sees and knows more, much more, than he unfolds.
passages.vernacular: 我點解要結婚?呢個誠實嘅人無疑睇到並知道得更多,多得多,比佢透露嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我為什麼要結婚?這個誠實的人無疑看到並知道得更多,多得多,比他透露的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: [Returning.] My lord, I would I might entreat your honour To scan this thing no further. Leave it to time: Though it be fit that Cassio have his place, For sure he fills it up with great ability, Yet if you please to hold him off awhile, You shall by that perceive him and his means. Note if your lady strain his entertainment With any strong or vehement importunity, Much will be seen in that. In the meantime, Let me be thought too busy in my fears (As worthy cause I have to fear I am) And hold her free, I do beseech your honour.
passages.vernacular: [返回。]大人,我希望能懇求您唔好再深究呢件事。交畀時間:雖然凱西奧應該恢復職位,因為佢確實有出色能力勝任,但如果您願意讓佢暫時等一等,您就可以由此觀察佢同佢嘅手段。留意您嘅夫人是否用任何強烈或猛烈嘅催促去促成佢嘅復職,從中可以睇出好多。與此同時,就當我嘅恐懼太多事吧(我確有正當理由擔心自己係咁),並請您認為佢係清白嘅,我懇求您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [返回。]大人,我希望能懇求您不要再深究這件事。交給時間:雖然凱西奧應該恢復職位,因為他確實有出色能力勝任,但如果您願意讓他暫時等一等,您就可以由此觀察他和他的手段。留意您的夫人是否用任何強烈或猛烈的催促去促成他的復職,從中可以看出很多。與此同時,就當我的恐懼太多事吧(我確有正當理由擔心自己是這樣),並請您認為她是清白的,我懇求您。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fear not my government.
passages.vernacular: 唔使擔心我嘅自制。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不用擔心我的自制。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I once more take my leave.
passages.vernacular: 我再次告辭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我再次告辭。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: This fellow’s of exceeding honesty, And knows all qualities, with a learned spirit, Of human dealings. If I do prove her haggard, Though that her jesses were my dear heartstrings, I’d whistle her off, and let her down the wind To prey at fortune. Haply, for I am black, And have not those soft parts of conversation That chamberers have, or for I am declin’d Into the vale of years,—yet that’s not much— She’s gone, I am abus’d, and my relief Must be to loathe her. O curse of marriage, That we can call these delicate creatures ours, And not their appetites! I had rather be a toad, And live upon the vapour of a dungeon, Than keep a corner in the thing I love For others’ uses. Yet, ’tis the plague of great ones, Prerogativ’d are they less than the base, ’Tis destiny unshunnable, like death: Even then this forked plague is fated to us When we do quicken. Desdemona comes. If she be false, O, then heaven mocks itself! I’ll not believe’t.
passages.vernacular: 呢個傢伙極其誠實,以博學嘅心靈深知人際交往嘅一切品性。如果我證明佢係野性難馴嘅鷹,即使佢嘅腳帶係我心愛嘅心弦,我也要吹哨放走佢,讓佢順風去隨運氣獵食。也許因為我黑,缺乏嗰啲閨房情郎所具有嘅柔和談吐,或者因為我已沉入暮年嘅山谷——不過呢個並唔算多——佢走喇,我受騙喇,我嘅解脫只能係厭惡佢。啊,婚姻嘅詛咒,我哋可以稱呢啲嬌嫩嘅人為自己嘅,卻唔能稱佢哋嘅慾望為自己嘅!我寧願做癩蛤蟆,靠地牢嘅蒸氣為生,也唔願在我所愛之物中留一角畀別人使用。然而,呢個係大人物嘅瘟疫,佢哋嘅特權還不如卑賤者,呢個係無法躲避嘅命運,如同死亡:就在我哋出生時,呢個分叉嘅瘟疫就注定畀我哋。戴絲德夢娜來喇。如果佢不忠,啊,咁上天就係在嘲笑自己!我唔相信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這傢伙極其誠實,以博學的心靈深知人際交往的一切品性。如果我證明她是野性難馴的鷹,即使她的腳帶是我心愛的心弦,我也要吹哨放走她,讓她順風去隨運氣獵食。也許因為我黑,缺乏那些閨房情郎所具有的柔和談吐,或者因為我已沉入暮年的山谷——不過這並不算多——她走了,我受騙了,我的解脫只能是厭惡她。啊,婚姻的詛咒,我們可以稱這些嬌嫩的人為自己的,卻不能稱她們的慾望為自己的!我寧願做癩蛤蟆,靠地牢的蒸氣為生,也不願在我所愛之物中留一角給別人使用。然而,這是大人物的瘟疫,他們的特權還不如卑賤者,這是無法躲避的命運,如同死亡:就在我們出生時,這分叉的瘟疫就注定給我們。戴絲德夢娜來了。如果她不忠,啊,那麼上天就是在嘲笑自己!我不相信。

passages.original: Enter Desdemona and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: How now, my dear Othello? Your dinner, and the generous islanders By you invited, do attend your presence.
passages.vernacular: 點樣喇,我親愛嘅奧賽羅?您嘅午餐,仲有您邀請嘅高貴島民,都在等候您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,我親愛的奧賽羅?您的午餐,還有您邀請的高貴島民,都在等候您。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am to blame.
passages.vernacular: 係我唔對。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是我不對。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why do you speak so faintly? Are you not well?
passages.vernacular: 你點解講嘢咁虛弱?你唔舒服嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為何說話這麼虛弱?你不舒服嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I have a pain upon my forehead here.
passages.vernacular: 我呢度額頭痛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我這裡額頭疼。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Faith, that’s with watching, ’twill away again; Let me but bind it hard, within this hour It will be well.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,嗰係因為熬夜,會好嘅;讓我用力把佢綁緊,一小時內就會好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,那是因為熬夜,會好的;讓我用力把它綁緊,一小時內就會好。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Your napkin is too little;
passages.vernacular: 你嘅手帕太細喇;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的手帕太小了;

passages.original: [He puts the handkerchief from him, and she drops it.]
passages.vernacular: [佢把手帕推開,手帕掉落。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [他把手帕推開,手帕掉落。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Let it alone. Come, I’ll go in with you.
passages.vernacular: 唔使理佢。來,我同你入去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不用管它。來,我和你進去。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I am very sorry that you are not well.
passages.vernacular: 你唔舒服,我好難過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不舒服,我很難過。

passages.original: [Exeunt Othello and Desdemona.]
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅同戴絲德夢娜下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅和戴絲德夢娜下。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I am glad I have found this napkin; This was her first remembrance from the Moor. My wayward husband hath a hundred times Woo’d me to steal it. But she so loves the token, For he conjur’d her she should ever keep it, That she reserves it evermore about her To kiss and talk to. I’ll have the work ta’en out, And give’t Iago. What he will do with it Heaven knows, not I, I nothing but to please his fantasy.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興搵到呢條手帕;呢個係摩爾人畀佢嘅第一份紀念物。我嗰任性嘅丈夫已經一百次求我偷佢。但佢太愛呢個信物,因為佢懇求佢永遠保留,所以佢始終帶喺身邊,親吻佢、對住佢講嘢。我要把花樣描低,然後把佢畀伊阿古。佢拎佢做咩,只有上天知道,我唔知道,我只係順佢嘅心意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興找到這條手帕;這是摩爾人給她的第一份紀念物。我那任性的丈夫已經一百次求我偷它。但她太愛這信物,因為他懇求她永遠保留,所以她始終帶在身邊,親吻它、對著它說話。我要把花樣描下來,然後把它給伊阿古。他拿它做什麼,只有上天知道,我不知道,我只是順他的心意。

passages.original: Enter Iago.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now? What do you here alone?
passages.vernacular: 點樣喇?你獨自喺度做咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了?你獨自在這裡幹什麼?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Do not you chide. I have a thing for you.
passages.vernacular: 你別罵我。我有樣嘢畀你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你別罵我。我有東西給你。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: A thing for me? It is a common thing—
passages.vernacular: 畀我嘅嘢?嗰係件常見嘅嘢——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我的東西?那是件常見的東西——

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Ha?
passages.vernacular: 哈?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: To have a foolish wife.
passages.vernacular: 就係有個傻老婆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是有個傻老婆。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, is that all? What will you give me now For that same handkerchief?
passages.vernacular: 啊,就係咁多嗎?而家,你肯為嗰條手帕畀我咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,就這個嗎?現在,你肯為那條手帕給我什麼?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What handkerchief?
passages.vernacular: 咩手帕?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼手帕?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: What handkerchief? Why, that the Moor first gave to Desdemona, That which so often you did bid me steal.
passages.vernacular: 咩手帕?咦,就係摩爾人最先送畀戴絲德夢娜嗰條,你常常叫我偷嗰條。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼手帕?咦,就是摩爾人最先送給戴絲德夢娜的那條,你常常叫我偷的那條。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Hast stol’n it from her?
passages.vernacular: 你從佢嗰度偷嚟嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你從她那裡偷來的?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: No, faith, she let it drop by negligence, And, to the advantage, I being here, took ’t up. Look, here it is.
passages.vernacular: 唔,講真嘅,佢唔小心掉咗,我正好喺度,趁機撿起嚟。睇,喺度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,說真的,她不小心掉了,我正好在這裡,趁機撿起來。看,在這裡。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: A good wench, give it me.
passages.vernacular: 好姑娘,畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好姑娘,給我。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: What will you do with’t, that you have been so earnest To have me filch it?
passages.vernacular: 你要拎佢做咩,竟然咁急住要我偷?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要拿它做什麼,竟然這麼急著要我偷?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: [Snatching it.] Why, what’s that to you?
passages.vernacular: [奪過。]咦,呢個同你有咩關係?
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奪過。]咦,這跟你有什麼關係?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: If it be not for some purpose of import, Give ’t me again. Poor lady, she’ll run mad When she shall lack it.
passages.vernacular: 如果唔係為咗咩重要嘅用途,把佢還畀我。可憐嘅夫人,佢失去佢時會發瘋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果不是為了什麼重要的用途,把它還給我。可憐的夫人,她失去它時會發瘋。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Be not acknown on’t, I have use for it. Go, leave me.
passages.vernacular: 唔好承認知道呢件事,我有用處。去,離開我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要承認知道這事,我有用處。去,離開我。

passages.original: [Exit Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞下。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I will in Cassio’s lodging lose this napkin, And let him find it. Trifles light as air Are to the jealous confirmations strong As proofs of holy writ. This may do something. The Moor already changes with my poison: Dangerous conceits are in their natures poisons, Which at the first are scarce found to distaste, But with a little act upon the blood Burn like the mines of sulphur. I did say so.
passages.vernacular: 我要把呢條手帕丟喺凱西奧嘅住處,讓佢搵到。輕如空氣嘅小事,對嫉妒嘅人來講,係同聖經嘅證據一樣有力嘅證實。呢個也許有用。摩爾人已經喺我嘅毒藥下改變:危險嘅念頭本質就係毒藥,起初幾乎唔覺得難受,但稍微作用在血液上,就像硫磺礦一樣燃燒。我早講過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把這條手帕丟在凱西奧的住處,讓他找到。輕如空氣的小事,對嫉妒的人來說,是和聖經的證據一樣有力的證實。這也許有用。摩爾人已經在我的毒藥下改變:危險的念頭本質就是毒藥,起初幾乎不覺得難受,但稍微作用在血液上,就像硫磺礦一樣燃燒。我早說過。

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Look, where he comes. Not poppy, nor mandragora, Nor all the drowsy syrups of the world, Shall ever medicine thee to that sweet sleep Which thou ow’dst yesterday.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢來喇。無論罌粟、曼德拉草,還係世上所有催眠嘅糖漿,都唔能再令你得到你琴日仲擁有嘅嗰種甜美睡眠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,他來了。無論罌粟、曼德拉草,還是世上所有催眠的糖漿,都不能再使你得到你昨天還擁有的那種甜美睡眠。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ha! ha! false to me?
passages.vernacular: 哈!哈!對我不忠?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈!哈!對我不忠?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, how now, general? No more of that.
passages.vernacular: 咦,點樣喇,將軍?唔好再講嗰個喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,怎麼了,將軍?別再說那個了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Avaunt! be gone! Thou hast set me on the rack. I swear ’tis better to be much abus’d Than but to know’t a little.
passages.vernacular: 走開!滾!你把我放上咗刑架。我發誓,被騙得好厲害,也比稍微知道好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開!滾!你把我放上了刑架。我發誓,被騙得很厲害,也比稍微知道好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 點樣喇,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What sense had I of her stol’n hours of lust? I saw’t not, thought it not, it harm’d not me. I slept the next night well, was free and merry; I found not Cassio’s kisses on her lips. He that is robb’d, not wanting what is stol’n, Let him not know’t, and he’s not robb’d at all.
passages.vernacular: 我對佢偷來嘅情慾時光有咩感覺?我冇見,冇諗到,佢冇傷害我。第二日夜裡我瞓得好好,自由快樂;我冇喺佢嘴唇上發現凱西奧嘅吻。被盜嘅人,若不缺少被偷走嘅嘢,只要佢唔知道,佢就根本冇被盜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對她偷來的情慾時光有什麼感覺?我沒看見,沒想到,它沒傷害我。第二天夜裡我睡得很好,自由快樂;我沒在她嘴唇上發現凱西奧的吻。被盜的人,若不缺少被偷走的東西,只要他不知道,他就根本沒被盜。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am sorry to hear this.
passages.vernacular: 聽到呢個我好難過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽到這個我很難過。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I had been happy if the general camp, Pioners and all, had tasted her sweet body, So I had nothing known. O, now, for ever Farewell the tranquil mind! Farewell content! Farewell the plumed troops and the big wars That make ambition virtue! O, farewell, Farewell the neighing steed and the shrill trump, The spirit-stirring drum, the ear-piercing fife, The royal banner, and all quality, Pride, pomp, and circumstance of glorious war! And, O you mortal engines, whose rude throats The immortal Jove’s dread clamours counterfeit, Farewell! Othello’s occupation’s gone!
passages.vernacular: 如果整個軍營,連工兵在內,都嘗過佢甜美嘅身體,只要我咩都唔知道,我就會幸福。啊,從而家起,永別喇,平靜嘅心!永別喇,滿足!永別喇,插羽嘅軍隊同令野心成為美德嘅大戰!啊,永別喇,永別喇,嘶鳴嘅戰馬、尖銳嘅號角、激勵心靈嘅戰鼓、刺耳嘅短笛、皇家旗幟,以及輝煌戰爭嘅一切品質、驕傲、儀仗同氣派!還有你哋,致命嘅大炮,你哋粗野嘅喉嚨模仿永生朱庇特可怕嘅雷鳴,永別喇!奧賽羅嘅職業完喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果整個軍營,連工兵在內,都嘗過她甜美的身體,只要我什麼都不知道,我就會幸福。啊,從現在起,永別了,平靜的心!永別了,滿足!永別了,插羽的軍隊和使野心成為美德的大戰!啊,永別了,永別了,嘶鳴的戰馬、尖銳的號角、激勵心靈的戰鼓、刺耳的短笛、皇家旗幟,以及輝煌戰爭的一切品質、驕傲、儀仗與氣派!還有你們,致命的大炮,你們粗野的喉嚨模仿永生朱庇特可怕的雷鳴,永別了!奧賽羅的職業完了!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Is’t possible, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Villain, be sure thou prove my love a whore; Be sure of it. Give me the ocular proof, Or, by the worth of man’s eternal soul, Thou hadst been better have been born a dog Than answer my wak’d wrath.
passages.vernacular: 惡棍,你一定要證明我愛嘅人係個娼婦;一定要確定。畀我親眼所見嘅證據,否則,憑人類永恆靈魂嘅價值,你寧願生為一條狗,也唔好面對我被喚醒嘅怒火。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 惡棍,你一定要證明我愛的人是個娼婦;一定要確定。給我親眼所見的證據,否則,憑人類永恆靈魂的價值,你寧願生為一條狗,也不要面對我被喚醒的怒火。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Is’t come to this?
passages.vernacular: 到咁地步了嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 到這地步了嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Make me to see’t, or at the least so prove it, That the probation bear no hinge nor loop To hang a doubt on, or woe upon thy life!
passages.vernacular: 令我睇見,或者至少證明得令證據冇任何鉸鏈或環扣可以掛上疑問,否則你嘅性命有禍喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我看見,或者至少證明得讓證據沒有任何鉸鏈或環扣可以掛上疑問,否則你的性命有禍了!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My noble lord,—
passages.vernacular: 我高貴嘅大人——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我高貴的大人——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: If thou dost slander her and torture me, Never pray more. Abandon all remorse; On horror’s head horrors accumulate; Do deeds to make heaven weep, all earth amaz’d; For nothing canst thou to damnation add Greater than that.
passages.vernacular: 如果你誹謗佢並折磨我,就唔好再祈禱喇。拋棄一切悔意;在恐怖之上堆積恐怖;做出令天堂哭泣、全地驚駭嘅事;因為你再也冇比呢個更大嘅事可添加到你嘅詛咒之上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你誹謗她並折磨我,就別再祈禱了。拋棄一切悔意;在恐怖之上堆積恐怖;做出令天堂哭泣、全地驚駭的事;因為你再也沒有比這更大的事可添加到你的詛咒之上。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O grace! O heaven defend me! Are you a man? Have you a soul or sense? God be wi’ you. Take mine office.—O wretched fool, That liv’st to make thine honesty a vice! O monstrous world! Take note, take note, O world, To be direct and honest is not safe. I thank you for this profit, and from hence I’ll love no friend, sith love breeds such offence.
passages.vernacular: 啊,恩典!啊,上天保佑我!你係人嗎?你有靈魂或感覺嗎?願上帝與您同在。收回我嘅職位。——啊,可憐嘅傻瓜,你活著竟令自己嘅誠實成為罪惡!啊,荒唐嘅世界!留意,留意,世界啊,直率誠實並唔安全。我感謝您畀我呢個教訓,從此我唔再愛任何朋友,因為愛會招來咁嘅冒犯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,恩典!啊,上天保佑我!你是人嗎?你有靈魂或感覺嗎?願上帝與您同在。收回我的職位。——啊,可憐的傻瓜,你活著竟使自己的誠實成為罪惡!啊,荒唐的世界!留意,留意,世界啊,直率誠實並不安全。我感謝您給我這個教訓,從此我不再愛任何朋友,因為愛會招來這種冒犯。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, stay. Thou shouldst be honest.
passages.vernacular: 唔,留低。你應該係誠實嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,留下。你應該是誠實的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I should be wise; for honesty’s a fool, And loses that it works for.
passages.vernacular: 我應該聰明;因為誠實係傻瓜,會失去自己努力爭取嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我應該聰明;因為誠實是傻瓜,會失去自己努力爭取的東西。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By the world, I think my wife be honest, and think she is not. I think that thou art just, and think thou art not. I’ll have some proof: her name, that was as fresh As Dian’s visage, is now begrim’d and black As mine own face. If there be cords or knives, Poison or fire, or suffocating streams, I’ll not endure ’t. Would I were satisfied!
passages.vernacular: 憑世界起誓,我認為我妻子貞潔,又認為佢唔貞潔。我認為你正直,又認為你唔正直。我要有啲證據:佢嘅名譽,曾像月神嘅面容一樣清新,而家被弄污,黑得像我自己嘅臉。只要有繩索或刀,毒藥或火,或令人窒息嘅河流,我都唔忍受。但願我得到確定!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑世界起誓,我認為我妻子貞潔,又認為她不貞潔。我認為你正直,又認為你不正直。我要有些證據:她的名譽,曾像月神的面容一樣清新,現在被弄污,黑得像我自己的臉。只要有繩索或刀,毒藥或火,或令人窒息的河流,我都不忍受。但願我得到確定!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I see, sir, you are eaten up with passion. I do repent me that I put it to you. You would be satisfied?
passages.vernacular: 我睇,先生,您被激情吞噬喇。我後悔對您講咗呢件事。您想得到確證嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看,先生,您被激情吞噬了。我後悔對您說了這件事。您想得到確證嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Would? Nay, I will.
passages.vernacular: 想?唔,我一定要。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想?不,我一定要。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And may; but how? How satisfied, my lord? Would you, the supervisor, grossly gape on, Behold her topp’d?
passages.vernacular: 也可以;但點做?點樣確證,大人?您作為監督者,要粗俗地瞪大眼睛睇住,睇佢被騎嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也可以;但怎麼做?怎樣確證,大人?您作為監督者,要粗俗地瞪大眼睛看著,看她被騎嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Death and damnation! O!
passages.vernacular: 死亡同詛咒!啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 死亡與詛咒!啊!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: It were a tedious difficulty, I think, To bring them to that prospect. Damn them then, If ever mortal eyes do see them bolster More than their own! What then? How then? What shall I say? Where’s satisfaction? It is impossible you should see this, Were they as prime as goats, as hot as monkeys, As salt as wolves in pride, and fools as gross As ignorance made drunk. But yet I say, If imputation and strong circumstances, Which lead directly to the door of truth, Will give you satisfaction, you may have’t.
passages.vernacular: 我諗,要把佢哋弄到嗰種境地讓您睇到,係好麻煩困難嘅事。咁就詛咒佢哋,如果有凡人嘅眼睛見到佢哋共枕,除咗佢哋自己嘅眼睛!咁點樣?又點樣?我該講咩?確證喺邊?您不可能睇見呢個,即使佢哋像山羊一樣淫蕩、像猴子一樣火熱、像發情嘅狼一樣好色,愚蠢得像被無知灌醉嘅傻瓜。但我仍然講,如果指控同強有力嘅旁證,直接通往真相之門,能畀您確證,您可以得到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想,要把他們弄到那種境地讓您看到,是很麻煩困難的事。那就詛咒他們,如果有凡人的眼睛見到他們共枕,除了他們自己的眼睛!那怎樣?又怎樣?我該說什麼?確證在哪?您不可能看見這個,即使他們像山羊一樣淫蕩、像猴子一樣火熱、像發情的狼一樣好色,愚蠢得像被無知灌醉的傻瓜。但我仍然說,如果指控和強有力的旁證,直接通往真相之門,能給您確證,您可以得到。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Give me a living reason she’s disloyal.
passages.vernacular: 畀我一個活生生嘅理由,證明佢不忠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我一個活生生的理由,證明她不忠。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I do not like the office, But sith I am enter’d in this cause so far, Prick’d to ’t by foolish honesty and love, I will go on. I lay with Cassio lately, And being troubled with a raging tooth, I could not sleep. There are a kind of men so loose of soul, That in their sleeps will mutter their affairs. One of this kind is Cassio: In sleep I heard him say, “Sweet Desdemona, Let us be wary, let us hide our loves;” And then, sir, would he gripe and wring my hand, Cry “O sweet creature!” and then kiss me hard, As if he pluck’d up kisses by the roots, That grew upon my lips, then laid his leg Over my thigh, and sigh’d and kiss’d, and then Cried “Cursed fate that gave thee to the Moor!”
passages.vernacular: 我唔鍾意呢個差事,但既然我已陷入呢件事咁深,被愚蠢嘅誠實同愛刺激住,我就繼續。我最近同凱西奧同瞓,因為牙痛得厲害,瞓唔著。有一類人靈魂如此鬆散,在睡夢中會喃喃自語佢哋嘅私事。凱西奧就係呢類人:我聽到佢喺睡夢中講「甜美嘅戴絲德夢娜,我哋要小心,要隱藏我哋嘅愛」;然後,先生,佢緊握並擰我嘅手,喊「啊,甜美嘅人兒!」然後用力吻我,好似要把長喺我嘴唇上嘅吻連根拔起,然後把腿放到我大腿上,歎息住吻,然後喊「該死嘅命運,把你畀咗摩爾人!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不喜歡這個差事,但既然我已陷入這件事這麼深,被愚蠢的誠實與愛刺激著,我就繼續。我最近與凱西奧同睡,因為牙痛得厲害,睡不著。有一類人靈魂如此鬆散,在睡夢中會喃喃自語他們的私事。凱西奧就是這類人:我聽到他在睡夢中說「甜美的戴絲德夢娜,我們要小心,要隱藏我們的愛」;然後,先生,他緊握並擰我的手,喊「啊,甜美的人兒!」然後用力吻我,好像要把長在我嘴唇上的吻連根拔起,然後把腿放到我大腿上,歎息著吻,然後喊「該死的命運,把你給了摩爾人!」

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O monstrous! monstrous!
passages.vernacular: 啊,荒唐!荒唐!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,荒唐!荒唐!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, this was but his dream.
passages.vernacular: 唔,呢個只係佢嘅夢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這只是他的夢。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: But this denoted a foregone conclusion. ’Tis a shrewd doubt, though it be but a dream.
passages.vernacular: 但呢個表明咗一個既定嘅事實。呢個係個尖銳嘅疑點,即使只係夢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這表明了一個既定的事實。這是個尖銳的疑點,即使只是夢。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And this may help to thicken other proofs That do demonstrate thinly.
passages.vernacular: 呢個可以幫助加強其他單薄嘅證據。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這可以幫助加強其他單薄的證據。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I’ll tear her all to pieces.
passages.vernacular: 我要把佢撕成碎片。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把她撕成碎片。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, but be wise. Yet we see nothing done, She may be honest yet. Tell me but this, Have you not sometimes seen a handkerchief Spotted with strawberries in your wife’s hand?
passages.vernacular: 唔,要明智。我哋仲未見到任何事,佢可能仍然貞潔。只告訴我呢個:您有冇時常見您妻子手裡有條繡草莓花紋嘅手帕?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,要明智。我們還沒見到任何事,她可能仍然貞潔。只告訴我這個:您有沒有時常見您妻子手裡有條繡草莓花紋的手帕?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I gave her such a one, ’twas my first gift.
passages.vernacular: 我畀過佢咁樣一條,嗰係我嘅第一份禮物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我給過她這樣一條,那是我的第一份禮物。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I know not that: but such a handkerchief (I am sure it was your wife’s) did I today See Cassio wipe his beard with.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道呢個:但咁樣一條手帕(我肯定係您妻子嘅),我今日見到凱西奧用佢擦鬍子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道這個:但這樣一條手帕(我肯定是您妻子的),我今天見到凱西奧用它擦鬍子。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: If it be that,—
passages.vernacular: 如果係嗰條——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是那條——

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: If it be that, or any that was hers, It speaks against her with the other proofs.
passages.vernacular: 如果係嗰條,或任何屬於佢嘅,佢與其他證據一齊指控佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是那條,或任何屬於她的,它與其他證據一起指控她。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, that the slave had forty thousand lives! One is too poor, too weak for my revenge! Now do I see ’tis true. Look here, Iago; All my fond love thus do I blow to heaven. ’Tis gone. Arise, black vengeance, from thy hollow hell! Yield up, O love, thy crown and hearted throne To tyrannous hate! Swell, bosom, with thy fraught, For ’tis of aspics’ tongues!
passages.vernacular: 啊,但願嗰奴才有四萬條命!一條太少,對我嘅復仇太弱喇!而家我睇出呢個係真嘅。睇呢度,伊阿古;我所有癡情嘅愛就咁樣吹向天空。佢消失喇。起來,黑色嘅復仇,從你空洞嘅地獄中!愛啊,把你嘅王冠同心中嘅寶座,交畀暴虐嘅恨!胸膛啊,脹滿你嘅負載吧,因為嗰係毒蛇嘅舌頭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,但願那奴才有四萬條命!一條太少,對我的復仇太弱了!現在我看出這是真的。看這裡,伊阿古;我所有癡情的愛就這樣吹向天空。它消失了。起來,黑色的復仇,從你空洞的地獄中!愛啊,把你的王冠和心中的寶座,交給暴虐的恨!胸膛啊,脹滿你的負載吧,因為那是毒蛇的舌頭!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Yet be content.
passages.vernacular: 還係要耐心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是要耐心。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, blood, Iago, blood!
passages.vernacular: 啊,血,伊阿古,血!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,血,伊阿古,血!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Patience, I say. Your mind perhaps may change.
passages.vernacular: 耐心,我話。您嘅心也許會改變。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 耐心,我說。您的心也許會改變。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Never, Iago. Like to the Pontic Sea, Whose icy current and compulsive course Ne’er feels retiring ebb, but keeps due on To the Propontic and the Hellespont; Even so my bloody thoughts, with violent pace Shall ne’er look back, ne’er ebb to humble love, Till that a capable and wide revenge Swallow them up. Now by yond marble heaven, In the due reverence of a sacred vow [Kneels.] I here engage my words.
passages.vernacular: 永不,伊阿古。就像黑海,佢冰冷嘅水流同不可抗拒嘅航道從不感到退潮,而係一直向前,流入普羅滂提斯同赫勒斯滂海峽;我嘅血腥思想也將咁樣,以猛烈嘅步伐永不回頭,永不退潮回到卑微嘅愛,直到一場容量廣大嘅復仇把佢哋吞冇。而家憑嗰大理石般嘅蒼天,以對神聖誓言應有嘅敬畏 [跪下。]我在此許下我嘅話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 永不,伊阿古。就像黑海,它冰冷的水流和不可抗拒的航道從不感到退潮,而是一直向前,流入普羅滂提斯和赫勒斯滂海峽;我的血腥思想也將這樣,以猛烈的步伐永不回頭,永不退潮回到卑微的愛,直到一場容量廣大的復仇把它們吞沒。現在憑那大理石般的蒼天,以對神聖誓言應有的敬畏 [跪下。]我在此許下我的話。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do not rise yet. [Kneels.] Witness, you ever-burning lights above, You elements that clip us round about, Witness that here Iago doth give up The execution of his wit, hands, heart, To wrong’d Othello’s service! Let him command, And to obey shall be in me remorse, What bloody business ever.
passages.vernacular: 先別起身。[跪下。]作證吧,你哋天上永遠燃燒嘅光,你哋環抱我哋嘅元素,作證伊阿古在此獻出佢嘅智慧、雙手、心靈嘅運用,為受冤屈嘅奧賽羅服務!讓佢下令,無論幾血腥嘅事,我都以悲憫之心服從。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先別起來。[跪下。]作證吧,你們天上永遠燃燒的光,你們環抱我們的元素,作證伊阿古在此獻出他的智慧、雙手、心靈的運用,為受冤屈的奧賽羅服務!讓他下令,無論多血腥的事,我都以悲憫之心服從。

passages.original: [They rise.]
passages.vernacular: [二人起身。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [二人起身。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I greet thy love, Not with vain thanks, but with acceptance bounteous, And will upon the instant put thee to ’t. Within these three days let me hear thee say That Cassio’s not alive.
passages.vernacular: 我迎接你嘅愛,唔係用空洞嘅謝意,而係慷慨接受,並即刻就要考驗你。三日之內,讓我聽你講凱西奧已不在人世。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我迎接你的愛,不是用空洞的謝意,而是慷慨接受,並馬上就要考驗你。三天之內,讓我聽你說凱西奧已不在人世。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My friend is dead. ’Tis done at your request. But let her live.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅朋友死咗。呢個係照你嘅要求辦嘅。但讓佢活著。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的朋友死了。這是照你的要求辦的。但讓她活著。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Damn her, lewd minx! O, damn her, damn her! Come, go with me apart, I will withdraw To furnish me with some swift means of death For the fair devil. Now art thou my lieutenant.
passages.vernacular: 詛咒佢,呢個淫蕩嘅賤人!啊,詛咒佢,詛咒佢!來,跟我到一旁,我要退下,為呢個美麗嘅魔鬼準備一些迅速嘅死亡手段。而家你係我嘅副官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 詛咒她,這個淫蕩的賤人!啊,詛咒她,詛咒她!來,跟我到一旁,我要退下,為這個美麗的魔鬼準備一些迅速的死亡手段。現在你是我的副官。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am your own for ever.
passages.vernacular: 我永遠屬於您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠屬於您。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene IV — Cyprus. Before the Castle 第三幕第四場:塞浦路斯城堡前

passages.original: Enter Desdemona, Emilia and Clown.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞同小丑上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞和小丑上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Do you know, sirrah, where Lieutenant Cassio lies?
passages.vernacular: 細路,你知唔知凱西奧副官住喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小子,你知道凱西奧副官住在哪嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I dare not say he lies anywhere.
passages.vernacular: 我唔敢講佢「住」(lie,兼有「撒謊」之意)喺任何地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不敢說他「住」(lie,兼有「撒謊」之意)在任何地方。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, man?
passages.vernacular: 點解,老兄?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,老兄?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: He’s a soldier; and for one to say a soldier lies is stabbing.
passages.vernacular: 佢係軍人;講一個軍人「撒謊」,就等於捅佢一刀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他是軍人;說一個軍人「撒謊」,就等於捅他一刀。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Go to. Where lodges he?
passages.vernacular: 得啦。佢住喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了。他住在哪?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: To tell you where he lodges is to tell you where I lie.
passages.vernacular: 要告訴你佢住喺邊,就等於告訴你我「撒謊」喺邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要告訴你他住在哪,就等於告訴你我「撒謊」在哪。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Can anything be made of this?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲嘢有咩可理解嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些話有什麼可理解的嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I know not where he lodges; and for me to devise a lodging, and say he lies here, or he lies there, were to lie in mine own throat.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知佢住喺邊;而我若自己編一個住處,話佢住呢度或住嗰度,就係喺我自己喉嚨裡撒謊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道他住在哪;而我若自己編一個住處,說他住這裡或住那裡,就是在我自己喉嚨裡撒謊。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Can you inquire him out, and be edified by report?
passages.vernacular: 你可以打聽出佢,聽報告得到明白嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你可以打聽出他,聽報告得到明白嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I will catechize the world for him, that is, make questions and by them answer.
passages.vernacular: 我會為佢盤問全世界,即係發問,憑問題得到答案。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會為他盤問全世界,即是發問,憑問題得到答案。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Seek him, bid him come hither. Tell him I have moved my lord on his behalf, and hope all will be well.
passages.vernacular: 去搵佢,叫佢嚟呢度。告訴佢我已為佢向我丈夫求情,希望一切順利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去找他,叫他來這裡。告訴他我已為他向我丈夫求情,希望一切順利。

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: To do this is within the compass of man’s wit, and therefore I will attempt the doing it.
passages.vernacular: 做呢件事在人類智慧範圍之內,所以我會嘗試去做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 做這件事在人類智慧範圍之內,所以我會嘗試去做。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Where should I lose that handkerchief, Emilia?
passages.vernacular: 我應該喺邊度弄丟嗰條手帕,愛米利亞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我應該在哪裡弄丟那條手帕,愛米利亞?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I know not, madam.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Believe me, I had rather have lost my purse Full of crusadoes. And but my noble Moor Is true of mind and made of no such baseness As jealous creatures are, it were enough To put him to ill thinking.
passages.vernacular: 相信我,我寧願丟失一個裝滿十字軍金幣嘅錢包。而若唔係我高貴嘅摩爾人心地真誠,唔係好似善妒嘅人嗰樣卑劣,呢個足以令佢起壞念頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我,我寧願丟失一個裝滿十字軍金幣的錢包。而若不是我高貴的摩爾人心地真誠,不是像善妒的人那樣卑劣,這足以讓他起壞念頭。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Is he not jealous?
passages.vernacular: 佢唔善妒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不善妒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Who, he? I think the sun where he was born Drew all such humours from him.
passages.vernacular: 誰,佢?我諗佢出生地嘅太陽,已把所有呢類脾性從佢身上吸走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰,他?我想他出生地的太陽,已把所有這類脾性從他身上吸走了。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Look, where he comes.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢來喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,他來了。

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will not leave him now till Cassio Be call’d to him. How is’t with you, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 我而家唔會離開佢,直到凱西奧被召到佢面前。你點樣,我嘅大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在不會離開他,直到凱西奧被召到他面前。你怎樣,我的大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Well, my good lady. [Aside.] O, hardness to dissemble! How do you, Desdemona?
passages.vernacular: 好,我嘅好夫人。[旁白。]啊,掩飾幾咁艱難!你點樣,戴絲德夢娜?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我的好夫人。[旁白。]啊,掩飾多麼艱難!你怎樣,戴絲德夢娜?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Well, my good lord.
passages.vernacular: 好,我嘅好大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我的好大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Give me your hand. This hand is moist, my lady.
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我。呢隻手係濕嘅,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我。這隻手是濕的,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It yet hath felt no age nor known no sorrow.
passages.vernacular: 佢仲未感受過衰老,也冇知曉過悲傷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它還沒感受過衰老,也沒知曉過悲傷。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: This argues fruitfulness and liberal heart. Hot, hot, and moist. This hand of yours requires A sequester from liberty, fasting and prayer, Much castigation, exercise devout; For here’s a young and sweating devil here That commonly rebels. ’Tis a good hand, A frank one.
passages.vernacular: 呢個表明豐饒同慷慨嘅心。熱,熱,而且濕。你呢隻手需要隔絕自由,需要齋戒同祈禱,許多鞭責,虔誠嘅修行;因為呢度有個年輕、出汗嘅魔鬼,常常造反。呢係隻好手,一隻坦率嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這表明豐饒和慷慨的心。熱,熱,而且濕。你這隻手需要隔絕自由,需要齋戒和祈禱,許多鞭責,虔誠的修行;因為這裡有個年輕、出汗的魔鬼,常常造反。這是隻好手,一隻坦率的手。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: You may indeed say so, For ’twas that hand that gave away my heart.
passages.vernacular: 你確實可以咁講,因為正正係嗰隻手交出咗我嘅心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你確實可以這樣說,因為正是那隻手交出了我的心。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: A liberal hand. The hearts of old gave hands, But our new heraldry is hands, not hearts.
passages.vernacular: 一隻慷慨嘅手。古時候心畀手,但我哋新嘅紋章學係手,唔係心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一隻慷慨的手。古時候心給手,但我們新的紋章學是手,不是心。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I cannot speak of this. Come now, your promise.
passages.vernacular: 我講唔到呢個。來吧,你嘅承諾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說不了這個。來吧,你的承諾。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What promise, chuck?
passages.vernacular: 咩承諾,小雞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼承諾,小雞?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have sent to bid Cassio come speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 我已派人請凱西奧嚟同你講嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已派人請凱西奧來與你說話。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I have a salt and sorry rheum offends me. Lend me thy handkerchief.
passages.vernacular: 我有咸澀可惡嘅鼻水困擾我。把你嘅手帕借畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我有咸澀可惡的鼻水困擾我。把你的手帕借給我。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Here, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 畀,我嘅大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給,我的大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That which I gave you.
passages.vernacular: 我畀你嗰條。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我給你的那條。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have it not about me.
passages.vernacular: 我身上冇帶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我身上沒帶。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Not?
passages.vernacular: 冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, faith, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 冇,講真嘅,我嘅大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,說真的,我的大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That is a fault. That handkerchief Did an Egyptian to my mother give. She was a charmer, and could almost read The thoughts of people. She told her, while she kept it, ’Twould make her amiable and subdue my father Entirely to her love. But if she lost it, Or made a gift of it, my father’s eye Should hold her loathed, and his spirits should hunt After new fancies: she, dying, gave it me, And bid me, when my fate would have me wive, To give it her. I did so; and take heed on’t, Make it a darling like your precious eye. To lose’t or give’t away were such perdition As nothing else could match.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係過失。嗰條手帕,係一個埃及人送畀我母親嘅。佢係個術士,幾乎能讀人嘅思想。佢告訴我母親,只要佢保存住,就會令佢可愛,並令我父親完全屬於佢嘅愛。但如果佢丟咗,或送人,我父親嘅眼睛就會視佢為可憎,佢嘅心會去追逐新嘅幻想:佢臨死時把佢畀咗我,吩咐我,當我嘅命運要我娶妻時,把佢畀佢。我照做喇;你要留意:把佢當作你珍貴眼睛般嘅寶貝。丟失或送人,會係任何別嘅事都比唔上嘅毀滅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是過失。那條手帕,是一個埃及人送給我母親的。她是個術士,幾乎能讀人的思想。她告訴我母親,只要她保存著,就會令她可愛,並使我父親完全屬於她的愛。但如果她丟了,或送人,我父親的眼睛就會視她為可憎,他的心會去追逐新的幻想:她臨死時把它給了我,吩咐我,當我的命運要我娶妻時,把它給她。我照做了;你要留意:把它當作你珍貴眼睛般的寶貝。丟失或送人,會是任何別的事都比不上的毀滅。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Is’t possible?
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: ’Tis true. There’s magic in the web of it. A sibyl, that had number’d in the world The sun to course two hundred compasses, In her prophetic fury sew’d the work; The worms were hallow’d that did breed the silk, And it was dyed in mummy, which the skillful Conserv’d of maiden’s hearts.
passages.vernacular: 千真萬確。佢嘅織物裡有魔法。一位在世上已見太陽運行兩百圈嘅女先知,在預言嘅狂熱中縫製咗呢件作品;吐絲嘅蠶係被祝聖過嘅,佢係用木乃伊染成嘅,木乃伊係巧匠從處女嘅心中保存嚟嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 千真萬確。它的織物裡有魔法。一位在世上已見太陽運行兩百圈的女先知,在預言的狂熱中縫製了這件作品;吐絲的蠶是被祝聖過的,它是用木乃伊染成的,木乃伊是巧匠從處女的心中保存來的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Indeed? Is’t true?
passages.vernacular: 真嘅?係真嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的?是真的嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Most veritable, therefore look to ’t well.
passages.vernacular: 千真萬確,所以要好好留意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 千真萬確,所以要好好留意。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Then would to God that I had never seen ’t!
passages.vernacular: 咁我寧願上帝令我從未見過佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我寧願上帝讓我從未見過它!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ha? wherefore?
passages.vernacular: 哈?點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈?為什麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why do you speak so startingly and rash?
passages.vernacular: 你點解講嘢咁突然急躁?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為何說話這麼突然急躁?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Is’t lost? is’t gone? speak, is it out of the way?
passages.vernacular: 丟咗嗎?走咗嗎?講,係咪唔見咗?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丟了嗎?走了嗎?說,是不是不見了?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven bless us!
passages.vernacular: 上天保佑我哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天保佑我們!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Say you?
passages.vernacular: 你講咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說什麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It is not lost, but what and if it were?
passages.vernacular: 冇丟,但如果丟咗呢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有丟,但如果丟了呢?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: How?
passages.vernacular: 點?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I say it is not lost.
passages.vernacular: 我話冇丟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說沒有丟。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fetch’t, let me see ’t.
passages.vernacular: 去拎嚟,畀我睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿來,讓我看。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, so I can, sir, but I will not now. This is a trick to put me from my suit. Pray you, let Cassio be receiv’d again.
passages.vernacular: 咦,我可以,先生,但而家唔拎。呢個係把戲,要令我放棄我嘅請求。請你,讓凱西奧重新被接納。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,我可以,先生,但現在不拿。這是把戲,要讓我放棄我的請求。請你,讓凱西奧重新被接納。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fetch me the handkerchief! My mind misgives.
passages.vernacular: 去拎手帕嚟!我心裡唔安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿手帕來!我心裡不安。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Come, come. You’ll never meet a more sufficient man.
passages.vernacular: 得啦,得啦。你再也遇唔到更勝任嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,得了。你再也遇不到更勝任的人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I pray, talk me of Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 請你,同我傾傾凱西奧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,跟我談談凱西奧。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: A man that all his time Hath founded his good fortunes on your love, Shar’d dangers with you,—
passages.vernacular: 一個一生都把好運建立在你嘅愛之上、與你共擔危險嘅人——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個一生都把好運建立在你的愛之上、與你共擔危險的人——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: In sooth, you are to blame.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,你唔對。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,你不對。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Away!
passages.vernacular: 走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Is not this man jealous?
passages.vernacular: 呢個人唔係在嫉妒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個人不是在嫉妒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I ne’er saw this before. Sure there’s some wonder in this handkerchief, I am most unhappy in the loss of it.
passages.vernacular: 我以前從未見過咁樣。呢條手帕裡肯定有咩奇妙,丟失佢令我極其不幸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我以前從未見過這樣。這條手帕裡肯定有什麼奇妙,丟失它令我極其不幸。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Tis not a year or two shows us a man: They are all but stomachs and we all but food; They eat us hungerly, and when they are full, They belch us.
passages.vernacular: 一兩年睇唔出一個男人:佢哋全係胃,我哋全係食物;佢哋飢餓地食我哋,食飽喇,就把我哋打嗝吐出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一兩年看不出一個男人:他們全是胃,我們全是食物;他們飢餓地吃我們,吃飽了,就把我們打嗝吐出來。

passages.original: Enter Cassio and Iago.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧同伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧和伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Look you, Cassio and my husband.
passages.vernacular: 睇,凱西奧同我丈夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,凱西奧和我丈夫。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: There is no other way; ’tis she must do ’t, And, lo, the happiness! Go and importune her.
passages.vernacular: 冇別嘅路;必須由佢做,睇,真係幸運!去纏住佢吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有別的路;必須由她做,看,真是幸運!去纏著她吧。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: How now, good Cassio, what’s the news with you?
passages.vernacular: 點樣喇,好凱西奧,有咩消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,好凱西奧,有什麼消息?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Madam, my former suit: I do beseech you That by your virtuous means I may again Exist, and be a member of his love, Whom I, with all the office of my heart, Entirely honour. I would not be delay’d. If my offence be of such mortal kind That nor my service past, nor present sorrows, Nor purpos’d merit in futurity, Can ransom me into his love again, But to know so must be my benefit; So shall I clothe me in a forc’d content, And shut myself up in some other course To fortune’s alms.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,仲係我以前嘅請求:我懇求你,憑你賢德嘅幫助,讓我重新存在,成為佢嘅愛嘅一員,我以我心嘅全部職責完全尊敬佢。我唔想被拖延。如果我嘅冒犯係如此致命,以致我過去嘅服務、而家嘅悲傷、將來計劃立嘅功,都唔能把我贖返佢嘅愛,咁至少讓我知道呢點,也係我嘅好處;咁樣我可以披上被迫嘅滿足,把自己關進另一條路,靠命運嘅施捨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,還是我以前的請求:我懇求你,憑你賢德的幫助,讓我重新存在,成為他的愛的一員,我以我心的全部職責完全尊敬他。我不想被拖延。如果我的冒犯是如此致命,以致我過去的服務、現在的悲傷、將來計劃立的功,都不能把我贖回他的愛,那麼至少讓我知道這點,也是我的好處;這樣我可以披上被迫的滿足,把自己關進另一條路,靠命運的施捨。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio, My advocation is not now in tune; My lord is not my lord; nor should I know him Were he in favour as in humour alter’d. So help me every spirit sanctified, As I have spoken for you all my best, And stood within the blank of his displeasure For my free speech! You must awhile be patient. What I can do I will; and more I will Than for myself I dare. Let that suffice you.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,三倍溫柔嘅凱西奧,我嘅辯護而家唔合時宜;我嘅大人唔係我嘅大人;即使佢嘅面貌像佢嘅脾氣一樣變咗,我也認唔出佢。願每一位聖靈幫助我,我已盡我所能為你講嘢,並因我坦率嘅言辭,企喺佢不悅嘅靶心之內!你必須耐心等一會兒。我能做嘅我會做;我會做嘅比我敢為自己做嘅更多。讓呢個足夠你吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,三倍溫柔的凱西奧,我的辯護現在不合時宜;我的大人不是我的大人;即使他的面貌像他的脾氣一樣變了,我也認不出他。願每一位聖靈幫助我,我已盡我所能為你說話,並因我坦率的言辭,站在他不悅的靶心之內!你必須耐心等一會兒。我能做的我會做;我會做的比我敢為自己做的更多。讓這足夠你吧。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Is my lord angry?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人生氣了嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人生氣了嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He went hence but now, And certainly in strange unquietness.
passages.vernacular: 佢剛才離開呢度,而且肯定處於奇異嘅不安中。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他剛才離開這裡,而且肯定處於奇異的不安中。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Can he be angry? I have seen the cannon, When it hath blown his ranks into the air And, like the devil, from his very arm Puff’d his own brother, and can he be angry? Something of moment then. I will go meet him. There’s matter in’t indeed if he be angry.
passages.vernacular: 佢會生氣嗎?我見過大炮,當佢把佢嘅隊伍吹上空中,並好似魔鬼般,把佢自己嘅兄弟從佢嘅手臂旁炸飛,佢也會生氣嗎?咁一定係咩重要嘅事。我去搵佢。如果佢生氣,確實有事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會生氣嗎?我見過大炮,當它把他的隊伍吹上空中,並像魔鬼般,把他自己的兄弟從他的手臂旁炸飛,他也會生氣嗎?那一定是什麼重要的事。我去找他。如果他生氣,確實有事。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I prithee do so.
passages.vernacular: 請你去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你去吧。

passages.original: [Exit Iago.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古下。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Something sure of state, Either from Venice, or some unhatch’d practice Made demonstrable here in Cyprus to him, Hath puddled his clear spirit, and in such cases Men’s natures wrangle with inferior things, Though great ones are their object. ’Tis even so. For let our finger ache, and it indues Our other healthful members even to that sense Of pain. Nay, we must think men are not gods, Nor of them look for such observancy As fits the bridal. Beshrew me much, Emilia, I was (unhandsome warrior as I am) Arraigning his unkindness with my soul; But now I find I had suborn’d the witness, And he’s indicted falsely.
passages.vernacular: 一定係咩國家大事,或者來自威尼斯,或者喺塞浦路斯向佢顯露嘅咩尚未孵化嘅陰謀,攪渾咗佢清澈嘅精神,呢種情況下,人嘅本性會與小事爭吵,即使佢哋嘅對象係大事。確實如此。因為只要我哋嘅手指痛,就會令其他健康嘅肢體也感到嗰種痛楚。唔,我哋必須想到男人唔係神,也唔能期望佢哋像新郎嗰樣始終殷勤。愛米利亞,我真該罵自己,我(作為不體面嘅戰士)曾在心裡審判佢嘅無情;但而家我發現我收買咗證人,佢係被冤枉指控嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一定是什麼國家大事,或者來自威尼斯,或者在塞浦路斯向他顯露的什麼尚未孵化的陰謀,攪渾了他清澈的精神,這種情況下,人的本性會與小事爭吵,即使他們的對象是大事。確實如此。因為只要我們的手指疼,就會讓其他健康的肢體也感到那種疼痛。不,我們必須想到男人不是神,也不能期望他們像新郎那樣始終殷勤。愛米利亞,我真該罵自己,我(作為不體面的戰士)曾在心裡審判他的無情;但現在我發現我收買了證人,他是被冤枉指控的。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Pray heaven it be state matters, as you think, And no conception nor no jealous toy Concerning you.
passages.vernacular: 求上天保佑嗰係國家大事,如你所諗,而唔係咩關於你嘅猜想或嫉妒嘅小念頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 求上天保佑那是國家大事,如你所想,而不是什麼關於你的猜想或嫉妒的小念頭。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas the day, I never gave him cause!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我從未畀佢理由!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我從未給他理由!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But jealous souls will not be answer’d so; They are not ever jealous for the cause, But jealous for they are jealous: ’tis a monster Begot upon itself, born on itself.
passages.vernacular: 但嫉妒嘅人唔會咁樣被回答;佢哋並非總為咗原因而嫉妒,而係因為嫉妒而嫉妒:佢係一個自己生自己、自己誕生於自己嘅怪物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但嫉妒的人不會這樣被回答;他們並非總為了原因而嫉妒,而是因為嫉妒而嫉妒:它是一個自己生自己、自己誕生於自己的怪物。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven keep that monster from Othello’s mind!
passages.vernacular: 願上天令呢個怪物遠離奧賽羅嘅心!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上天讓這個怪物遠離奧賽羅的心!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Lady, amen.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,阿們。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,阿們。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will go seek him. Cassio, walk hereabout: If I do find him fit, I’ll move your suit, And seek to effect it to my uttermost.
passages.vernacular: 我去搵佢。凱西奧,你喺呢附近行下:如果我發現佢心情合適,我就為你嘅請求進言,並盡力促成。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我去找他。凱西奧,你在這附近走走:如果我發現他心情合適,我就為你的請求進言,並盡力促成。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I humbly thank your ladyship.
passages.vernacular: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。

passages.original: [Exeunt Desdemona and Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞下。]

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Save you, friend Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 向你問安,朋友凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向你問安,朋友凱西奧!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What make you from home? How is it with you, my most fair Bianca? I’ faith, sweet love, I was coming to your house.
passages.vernacular: 你離家出嚟做咩?你點樣,我最美麗嘅比安卡?講真嘅,甜愛人,我正要去你家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你離家出來做什麼?你好嗎,我最美麗的比安卡?說真的,甜愛人,我正要去你家。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: And I was going to your lodging, Cassio. What, keep a week away? Seven days and nights? Eight score eight hours, and lovers’ absent hours, More tedious than the dial eight score times? O weary reckoning!
passages.vernacular: 我也正要去你嘅住處,凱西奧。咩,離開一個星期?七日七夜?一百六十八個鐘,情人不在嘅時辰,比鐘面長一百六十倍嘅煩悶?啊,疲憊嘅計算!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也正要去你的住處,凱西奧。什麼,離開一個星期?七日七夜?一百六十八小時,情人不在的時辰,比鐘面長一百六十倍的煩悶?啊,疲憊的計算!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Pardon me, Bianca. I have this while with leaden thoughts been press’d, But I shall in a more continuate time Strike off this score of absence. Sweet Bianca,
passages.vernacular: 原諒我,比安卡。我呢陣子被沉重嘅思緒壓住,但我會喺更連續嘅時間裡,把呢筆缺席嘅帳還清。親愛嘅比安卡,
passages.vernacularMandarin: 原諒我,比安卡。我這陣子被沉重的思緒壓著,但我會在更連續的時間裡,把這筆缺席的帳還清。親愛的比安卡,

passages.original: [Giving her Desdemona’s handkerchief.]
passages.vernacular: [把戴絲德夢娜嘅手帕遞畀佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [把戴絲德夢娜的手帕遞給她。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Take me this work out.
passages.vernacular: 幫我把呢個花樣描低。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 幫我把這花樣描下來。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: O Cassio, whence came this? This is some token from a newer friend. To the felt absence now I feel a cause. Is’t come to this? Well, well.
passages.vernacular: 啊凱西奧,呢個從邊度嚟?呢個係新朋友畀嘅信物。對於我感覺到嘅缺席,而家我感覺到咗原因。到咗咁地步嗎?好,好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊凱西奧,這從哪來的?這是新朋友給的信物。對於我感覺到的缺席,現在我感覺到了原因。到了這地步嗎?好,好。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Go to, woman! Throw your vile guesses in the devil’s teeth, From whence you have them. You are jealous now That this is from some mistress, some remembrance. No, in good troth, Bianca.
passages.vernacular: 得啦,女人!把你嗰啲卑劣嘅猜想,掟返落魔鬼嘴裡,你就係從嗰度得來嘅。你而家嫉妒,以為呢個係邊個情婦畀嘅紀念品。唔,講真嘅,比安卡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,女人!把你那些卑劣的猜想,扔回魔鬼嘴裡,你就是從那裡得來的。你現在嫉妒,以為這是哪個情婦給的紀念品。不,說真的,比安卡。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Why, whose is it?
passages.vernacular: 咦,嗰係誰嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,那是誰的?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I know not neither. I found it in my chamber. I like the work well. Ere it be demanded, As like enough it will, I’d have it copied. Take it, and do ’t, and leave me for this time.
passages.vernacular: 我也唔知道。我喺我房間裡搵到嘅。我鍾意呢個花樣。喺有人嚟要之前(好有可能會),我要把佢描低。拎去,描吧,今次先離開我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不知道。我在我房間裡找到的。我喜歡這花樣。在有人來要之前(很可能會),我要把它描下來。拿去,描吧,這次先離開我。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Leave you, wherefore?
passages.vernacular: 離開你,點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 離開你,為什麼?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I do attend here on the general, And think it no addition, nor my wish, To have him see me woman’d.
passages.vernacular: 我喺度等將軍,我認為,我也唔希望,畀佢見到我被女人纏住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這裡等將軍,我認為,我也不希望,讓他看見我被女人纏著。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Why, I pray you?
passages.vernacular: 咦,請問點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,請問為什麼?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Not that I love you not.
passages.vernacular: 唔係因為我唔愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是因為我不愛你。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: But that you do not love me. I pray you bring me on the way a little, And say if I shall see you soon at night.
passages.vernacular: 而係因為你唔愛我。請你送我一小段路,告訴我今晚會唔會好快見到你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而是因為你不愛我。請你送我一小段路,告訴我今晚會不會很快見到你。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: ’Tis but a little way that I can bring you, For I attend here. But I’ll see you soon.
passages.vernacular: 我只能送你一小段路,因為我要喺度等候。不過我好快會去見你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我只能送你一小段路,因為我要在這裡等候。不過我很快會去見你。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: ’Tis very good; I must be circumstanc’d.
passages.vernacular: 好好;我必須順從境況。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好;我必須順從境況。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene I — Cyprus. Before the Castle 第四幕第一場:塞浦路斯城堡前

passages.original: Enter Othello and Iago.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅同伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅和伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you think so?
passages.vernacular: 你會咁想嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會這麼想嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Think so, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 咁想,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這麼想,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What, To kiss in private?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,私下接吻?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,私下接吻?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: An unauthoriz’d kiss.
passages.vernacular: 未經許可嘅吻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 未經許可的吻。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Or to be naked with her friend in bed An hour or more, not meaning any harm?
passages.vernacular: 或者同佢嘅朋友赤身躺喺床上一小時以上,卻不含惡意?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或者與她的朋友赤身躺在床上一小時以上,卻不含惡意?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Naked in bed, Iago, and not mean harm? It is hypocrisy against the devil: They that mean virtuously and yet do so, The devil their virtue tempts, and they tempt heaven.
passages.vernacular: 赤身喺床,伊阿古,卻不含惡意?呢個係對魔鬼嘅偽善:嗰啲存心貞潔卻咁樣做嘅人,魔鬼誘惑佢哋嘅美德,佢哋就喺誘惑上天。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 赤身在床,伊阿古,卻不含惡意?這是對魔鬼的偽善:那些存心貞潔卻這樣做的人,魔鬼誘惑他們的美德,他們就在誘惑上天。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: So they do nothing, ’tis a venial slip. But if I give my wife a handkerchief—
passages.vernacular: 如果佢哋乜嘢都不做,呢只係個可原諒嘅小過失。但如果我畀我妻子一條手帕——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他們什麼都不做,這只是個可原諒的小過失。但如果我給我妻子一條手帕——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What then?
passages.vernacular: 嗰又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那又怎樣?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why then, ’tis hers, my lord, and being hers, She may, I think, bestow’t on any man.
passages.vernacular: 咁佢就係佢嘅,大人,既然係佢嘅,我想佢可以把佢送畀任何男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼它就是她的,大人,既然是她的,我想她可以把它送給任何男人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She is protectress of her honour too. May she give that?
passages.vernacular: 佢都係自己名譽嘅保護者。佢可以把嗰個都送出嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她也是自己名譽的保護者。她可以把那個也送出嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Her honour is an essence that’s not seen; They have it very oft that have it not: But for the handkerchief—
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅名譽係一種睇唔見嘅本質;冇名譽嘅人往往卻擁有佢:但講到手帕——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她的名譽是一種看不見的本質;沒有名譽的人往往卻擁有它:但說到手帕——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, I would most gladly have forgot it. Thou said’st (O, it comes o’er my memory, As doth the raven o’er the infected house, Boding to all) he had my handkerchief.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,我幾咁希望忘掉佢。你講過(啊,佢掠過我嘅記憶,就像烏鴉飛過染疫嘅屋子,對所有人都預告不祥)佢有我嘅手帕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,我多麼希望忘掉它。你說過(啊,它掠過我的記憶,就像烏鴉飛過染疫的屋子,對所有人都預告不祥)他有我的手帕。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, what of that?
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,嗰又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,那又怎樣?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That’s not so good now.
passages.vernacular: 而家呢不太好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在這不太好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What If I had said I had seen him do you wrong? Or heard him say (as knaves be such abroad, Who having, by their own importunate suit, Or voluntary dotage of some mistress, Convinced or supplied them, cannot choose But they must blab.)
passages.vernacular: 如果我講我見佢對你做咗壞事呢?或者聽到佢講(外面有咁樣嘅惡棍,佢哋憑自己不斷嘅追求,或某個情婦自願嘅癡迷,講服或滿足咗佢哋,就忍不住要胡講。)
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我說我見他對你做了壞事呢?或者聽到他說(外面有這樣的惡棍,他們憑自己不斷的追求,或某個情婦自願的癡迷,說服或滿足了她們,就忍不住要胡說。)

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Hath he said anything?
passages.vernacular: 佢講咗乜嘢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了什麼嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He hath, my lord, but be you well assur’d, No more than he’ll unswear.
passages.vernacular: 佢講喇,大人,不過您放心,唔會超過佢會否認嘅程度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了,大人,不過您放心,不會超過他會否認的程度。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What hath he said?
passages.vernacular: 佢講咗乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了什麼?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, that he did—I know not what he did.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,佢做喇——我唔知道佢做咗乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,他做了——我不知道他做了什麼。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What? What?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢?乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼?什麼?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lie.
passages.vernacular: 同瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同睡。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With her?
passages.vernacular: 同佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同她?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: With her, on her, what you will.
passages.vernacular: 同佢,喺佢身上,隨您點講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同她,在她身上,隨您怎麼說。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Lie with her! lie on her!—We say lie on her when they belie her.—Lie with her! that’s fulsome. Handkerchief—confessions—handkerchief! To confess, and be hanged for his labour. First, to be hanged, and then to confess. I tremble at it. Nature would not invest herself in such shadowing passion without some instruction. It is not words that shake me thus. Pish! Noses, ears, and lips. Is’t possible?—Confess?—handkerchief?—O devil!—
passages.vernacular: 同佢同瞓!喺佢身上瞓!——當人誣衊佢時,我哋講「喺佢身上講謊」。——同佢同瞓!嗰太下流。手帕——招供——手帕!招供,然後為佢嘅辛勞被絞死。先被絞死,再招供。我為此發抖。天性若冇某種啟示,唔會披上咁樣陰影般嘅激情。讓我咁樣顫抖嘅唔係言語。呸!鼻子,耳朵,嘴唇。有可能嗎?——招供?——手帕?——啊,魔鬼!——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與她同睡!在她身上睡!——當人誣衊她時,我們說「在她身上說謊」。——與她同睡!那太下流。手帕——招供——手帕!招供,然後為他的辛勞被絞死。先被絞死,再招供。我為此發抖。天性若沒有某種啟示,不會披上這樣陰影般的激情。讓我這樣顫抖的不是言語。呸!鼻子,耳朵,嘴唇。有可能嗎?——招供?——手帕?——啊,魔鬼!——

passages.original: [Falls in a trance.]
passages.vernacular: [昏倒喺恍惚中。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [昏倒在恍惚中。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Work on, My medicine, work! Thus credulous fools are caught, And many worthy and chaste dames even thus, All guiltless, meet reproach. What, ho! my lord! My lord, I say! Othello!
passages.vernacular: 繼續發作吧,我嘅藥,起作用吧!輕信嘅傻瓜就係咁樣上當,許多可敬貞潔嘅夫人都係咁樣,全然無辜卻蒙受責難。喂,大人!大人,我講!奧賽羅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 繼續發作吧,我的藥,起作用吧!輕信的傻瓜就是這樣上當,許多可敬貞潔的夫人也是這樣,全然無辜卻蒙受責難。喂,大人!大人,我說!奧賽羅!

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 點喇,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,凱西奧!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My lord is fallen into an epilepsy. This is his second fit. He had one yesterday.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人癲癇發作喇。呢個係佢第二次發作。尋日發作過一次。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人癲癇發作了。這是他第二次發作。昨天發作過一次。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Rub him about the temples.
passages.vernacular: 揉佢嘅太陽穴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 揉他的太陽穴。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: No, forbear; The lethargy must have his quiet course. If not, he foams at mouth, and by and by Breaks out to savage madness. Look, he stirs: Do you withdraw yourself a little while, He will recover straight. When he is gone, I would on great occasion speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 不,別動;昏迷必須安靜地走完佢嘅過程。否則佢會口吐白沫,不久便爆發野蠻嘅狂亂。睇,佢動喇:你暫時迴避一下,佢好快會恢復。等佢走喇,我有重要嘅事要同你談。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,別動;昏迷必須安靜地走完它的過程。否則他會口吐白沫,不久便爆發野蠻的狂亂。看,他動了:你暫時迴避一下,他很快會恢復。等他走了,我有重要的事要和你談。

passages.original: [Exit Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧下。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How is it, general? Have you not hurt your head?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,將軍?你冇傷到頭吧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,將軍?你沒有傷到頭吧?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Dost thou mock me?
passages.vernacular: 你喺嘲弄我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在嘲弄我嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I mock you? No, by heaven. Would you would bear your fortune like a man!
passages.vernacular: 我嘲弄你?不,憑天發誓。但願您能像個男子漢嗰樣承受命運!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我嘲弄你?不,憑天發誓。但願您能像個男子漢那樣承受命運!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: A horned man’s a monster and a beast.
passages.vernacular: 長角嘅男人係怪物同野獸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 長角的男人是怪物和野獸。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: There’s many a beast, then, in a populous city, And many a civil monster.
passages.vernacular: 咁,喺人口稠密嘅城市裡有許多野獸,都有許多文明嘅怪物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,在人口稠密的城市裡有許多野獸,也有許多文明的怪物。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Did he confess it?
passages.vernacular: 佢招認咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他招認了嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Good sir, be a man. Think every bearded fellow that’s but yok’d May draw with you. There’s millions now alive That nightly lie in those unproper beds Which they dare swear peculiar: your case is better. O, ’tis the spite of hell, the fiend’s arch-mock, To lip a wanton in a secure couch, And to suppose her chaste! No, let me know, And knowing what I am, I know what she shall be.
passages.vernacular: 好先生,做個男子漢。想想每一個有鬍子嘅、被套上軛嘅人,都可以同你同拉一輛車。而家活住嘅有成百萬人,夜夜瞓喺佢哋敢發誓只屬於自己嘅不潔床上:您嘅情況仲好些。啊,呢個係地獄嘅惡意、魔鬼最大嘅嘲弄:喺安穩嘅床上親吻一個蕩婦,卻仲以為佢貞潔!不,讓我知道,知道咗我係乜嘢,我就知道佢將成乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生,做個男子漢。想想每一個有鬍子的、被套上軛的人,都可以與你同拉一輛車。現在活著的有成百萬人,夜夜睡在他們敢發誓只屬於自己的不潔床上:您的情況還好些。啊,這是地獄的惡意、魔鬼最大的嘲弄:在安穩的床上親吻一個蕩婦,卻還以為她貞潔!不,讓我知道,知道了我是什麼,我就知道她將成什麼。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, thou art wise, ’tis certain.
passages.vernacular: 啊,你係明智嘅,呢個係肯定嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你是明智的,這是肯定的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Stand you awhile apart, Confine yourself but in a patient list. Whilst you were here o’erwhelmed with your grief, (A passion most unsuiting such a man) Cassio came hither. I shifted him away, And laid good ’scuse upon your ecstasy, Bade him anon return, and here speak with me, The which he promis’d. Do but encave yourself, And mark the fleers, the gibes, and notable scorns, That dwell in every region of his face; For I will make him tell the tale anew, Where, how, how oft, how long ago, and when He hath, and is again to cope your wife: I say, but mark his gesture. Marry, patience, Or I shall say you are all in all in spleen, And nothing of a man.
passages.vernacular: 您暫時站到一旁,把自己限制喺耐心嘅界限內。您喺呢度被悲痛壓倒時(呢種激情最不適合您咁樣嘅人),凱西奧嚟喇。我把佢支走喇,並用好理由解釋您嘅失神,叫佢稍後回嚟,喺呢度同我談話,佢答應喇。只要您躲進洞裡,留意佢臉上每一處嘅嘲笑、譏諷同明顯嘅輕蔑;因為我要讓佢重新講述,喺邊度、點樣、多少次、多久以前、乜嘢時候,佢曾經並將再次同您妻子苟合:我講,只要留意佢嘅姿態。當然,要耐心,否則我就會講您整個人都係怒氣,啲男子氣概都冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您暫時站到一旁,把自己限制在耐心的界限內。您在這裡被悲痛壓倒時(這種激情最不適合您這樣的人),凱西奧來了。我把他支走了,並用好理由解釋您的失神,叫他稍後回來,在這裡與我談話,他答應了。只要您躲進洞裡,留意他臉上每一處的嘲笑、譏諷和明顯的輕蔑;因為我要讓他重新講述,在哪裡、怎樣、多少次、多久以前、什麼時候,他曾經並將再次與您妻子苟合:我說,只要留意他的姿態。當然,要耐心,否則我就會說您整個人都是怒氣,一點男子氣概都沒有。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Dost thou hear, Iago? I will be found most cunning in my patience; But,—dost thou hear?—most bloody.
passages.vernacular: 你聽到嗎,伊阿古?我嘅耐心會被發現最為狡猾;但——你聽到嗎?——最為血腥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽到嗎,伊阿古?我的耐心會被發現最為狡猾;但——你聽到嗎?——最為血腥。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: That’s not amiss. But yet keep time in all. Will you withdraw?
passages.vernacular: 嗰冇錯。但一切都要合拍。您願意迴避嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那沒有錯。但一切都要合拍。您願意迴避嗎?

passages.original: [Othello withdraws.]
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅退到一旁。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅退到一旁。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Now will I question Cassio of Bianca, A housewife that by selling her desires Buys herself bread and clothes: it is a creature That dotes on Cassio, (as ’tis the strumpet’s plague To beguile many and be beguil’d by one.) He, when he hears of her, cannot refrain From the excess of laughter. Here he comes.
passages.vernacular: 而家我要向凱西奧問比安卡,一個靠出賣慾望為自己換取衣食嘅婦人:佢迷戀凱西奧(娼婦嘅災難就係騙咗許多人,卻被一個人所騙。)佢一聽到佢,就忍不住大笑。佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我要向凱西奧問比安卡,一個靠出賣慾望為自己換取衣食的婦人:她迷戀凱西奧(娼婦的災難就是騙了許多人,卻被一個人所騙。)他一聽到她,就忍不住大笑。他來了。

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: As he shall smile Othello shall go mad, And his unbookish jealousy must construe Poor Cassio’s smiles, gestures, and light behaviour Quite in the wrong. How do you now, lieutenant?
passages.vernacular: 佢一微笑,奧賽羅就會發瘋,而佢嗰不通書本嘅嫉妒,必定把可憐凱西奧嘅微笑、姿態同輕浮舉止完全解讀錯。你而家點樣,副官?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他一微笑,奧賽羅就會發瘋,而他那不通書本的嫉妒,必定把可憐凱西奧的微笑、姿態和輕浮舉止完全解讀錯。你現在怎樣,副官?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: The worser that you give me the addition Whose want even kills me.
passages.vernacular: 你畀我呢個頭銜,只讓我更糟,因為缺少佢幾乎要咗我嘅命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你給我這個頭銜,只讓我更糟,因為缺少它幾乎要了我的命。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ply Desdemona well, and you are sure on’t. [Speaking lower.] Now, if this suit lay in Bianca’s power, How quickly should you speed!
passages.vernacular: 好好求戴絲德夢娜,你一定成功。[聲音放低。]而家,如果呢請求喺比安卡嘅力量之內,你會多快成功!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好好求戴絲德夢娜,你一定成功。[聲音放低。]現在,如果這請求在比安卡的力量之內,你會多快成功!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Alas, poor caitiff!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐嘅傢伙!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐的傢伙!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Aside.] Look how he laughs already!
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]睇佢已經喺笑喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]看他已經在笑了!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I never knew a woman love man so.
passages.vernacular: 我從未見過一個女人咁樣愛一個男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我從未見過一個女人這樣愛一個男人。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Alas, poor rogue! I think, i’ faith, she loves me.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐嘅小流氓!我想,講真嘅,佢愛我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐的小流氓!我想,說真的,她愛我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Aside.] Now he denies it faintly and laughs it out.
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]而家佢微弱地否認,又用笑掩飾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]現在他微弱地否認,又用笑掩飾。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do you hear, Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 你聽到嗎,凱西奧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽到嗎,凱西奧?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Now he importunes him To tell it o’er. Go to, well said, well said.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢催促佢再講一遍。講吧,講得好,講得好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他催促他再講一遍。說吧,說得好,說得好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: She gives it out that you shall marry her. Do you intend it?
passages.vernacular: 佢放風講你會娶佢。你有此打算嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她放風說你會娶她。你有此打算嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Do you triumph, Roman? Do you triumph?
passages.vernacular: 你得意咗吧,羅馬人?你得意嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你得意了吧,羅馬人?你得意嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I marry her? What? A customer? I prithee, bear some charity to my wit, do not think it so unwholesome. Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 我娶佢?乜嘢?一個嫖客嘅女人?請你對我嘅頭腦寬容啲,別認為佢咁不健康。哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我娶她?什麼?一個嫖客的女人?請你對我的頭腦寬容一點,別認為它這麼不健康。哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: So, so, so, so. They laugh that wins.
passages.vernacular: 係,係,係,係。贏嘅人才笑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,是,是,是。贏的人才笑。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, the cry goes that you shall marry her.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,傳言講你會娶佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,傳言說你會娶她。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Prithee say true.
passages.vernacular: 請講實話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請說實話。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am a very villain else.
passages.vernacular: 否則我就係十足嘅惡棍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則我就是十足的惡棍。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Have you scored me? Well.
passages.vernacular: 你畀我記賬咗嗎?好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你給我記賬了嗎?好。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: This is the monkey’s own giving out. She is persuaded I will marry her, out of her own love and flattery, not out of my promise.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係嗰隻猴子自己放嘅風。佢自以為我會娶佢,係出於佢自己嘅愛同自負,而唔係出於我嘅承諾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是那隻猴子自己放的風。她自以為我會娶她,是出於她自己的愛和自負,而不是出於我的承諾。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Iago beckons me. Now he begins the story.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古向我招手。而家佢開始講故事喇。
