passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古向我招手。現在他開始講故事了。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: She was here even now. She haunts me in every place. I was the other day talking on the sea-bank with certain Venetians, and thither comes the bauble, and falls thus about my neck.
passages.vernacular: 佢頭先仲喺呢度。佢到處纏住我。前幾天我喺海岸同幾個威尼斯人談話,嗰個小玩意就嚟喇,咁樣撲到我脖子上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她剛才還在這裡。她到處纏著我。前幾天我在海岸與幾個威尼斯人談話,那個小玩意就來了,這樣撲到我脖子上。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Crying, “O dear Cassio!” as it were: his gesture imports it.
passages.vernacular: 喊住「啊,親愛嘅凱西奧!」大概如此:佢嘅姿勢表示出嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喊著「啊,親愛的凱西奧!」大概如此:他的姿勢表示出來了。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: So hangs, and lolls, and weeps upon me; so hales and pulls me. Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 咁樣掛住、賴住、對我哭泣;咁樣拖我、扯我。哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣掛著、賴著、對我哭泣;這樣拖我、扯我。哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Now he tells how she plucked him to my chamber. O, I see that nose of yours, but not that dog I shall throw it to.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢講佢點樣把佢拽進我嘅房間。啊,我睇見你嘅鼻子,卻睇唔見我要把佢扔畀嘅嗰條狗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他說她怎樣把他拽進我的房間。啊,我看見你的鼻子,卻看不見我要把它扔給的那條狗。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Well, I must leave her company.
passages.vernacular: 好,我必須離開佢嘅陪伴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我必須離開她的陪伴。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Before me! look where she comes.
passages.vernacular: 天啊!睇,佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊!看,她來了。

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: ’Tis such another fitchew! Marry, a perfum’d one. What do you mean by this haunting of me?
passages.vernacular: 又係一隻咁樣嘅臭鼬!當然,係一隻香水味嘅。你咁樣纏住我係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 又是一隻這樣的臭鼬!當然,是一隻香水味的。你這樣纏著我是什麼意思?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Let the devil and his dam haunt you! What did you mean by that same handkerchief you gave me even now? I was a fine fool to take it. I must take out the work? A likely piece of work, that you should find it in your chamber and not know who left it there! This is some minx’s token, and I must take out the work? There, give it your hobby-horse. Wheresoever you had it, I’ll take out no work on’t.
passages.vernacular: 讓魔鬼同佢母親去纏你吧!你頭先畀我嘅嗰條手帕係乜嘢意思?我攞佢真係個大傻瓜。我要把花樣描下嚟?好一個像樣嘅講法:你喺自己房間找到佢,卻唔知道邊個丟喺嗰兒!呢個係邊個賤人嘅信物,我仲要把花樣描下嚟?喏,攞去畀你嘅玩物。無論你從邊度得嚟,我不描佢嘅花樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓魔鬼和他母親去纏你吧!你剛才給我的那條手帕是什麼意思?我拿它真是個大傻瓜。我要把花樣描下來?好一個像樣的說法:你在自己房間找到它,卻不知道誰丟在那兒!這是哪個賤人的信物,我還要把花樣描下來?喏,拿去給你的玩物。無論你從哪裡得來,我不描它的花樣。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: How now, my sweet Bianca? How now, how now?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,我甜美嘅比安卡?點喇,點喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,我甜美的比安卡?怎麼了,怎麼了?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, that should be my handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 天啊,嗰應該係我嘅手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,那應該是我的手帕!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: If you’ll come to supper tonight, you may. If you will not, come when you are next prepared for.
passages.vernacular: 如果你今晚嚟食晚飯,可以。如果不嚟,下次有準備時再嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你今晚來吃晚飯,可以。如果不來,下次有準備時再來。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: After her, after her.
passages.vernacular: 追上佢,追上佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 追上她,追上她。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Faith, I must; she’ll rail in the street else.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我必須去;否則佢會喺街上大罵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我必須去;否則她會在街上大罵。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you sup there?
passages.vernacular: 你喺嗰度食晚飯嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在那裡吃晚飯嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Faith, I intend so.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我打算去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我打算去。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Well, I may chance to see you, for I would very fain speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 好,我或者會碰到你,因為我好想同你談談。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我也許會碰到你,因為我很想與你談談。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Prithee come, will you?
passages.vernacular: 請你嚟吧,好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你來吧,好嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Go to; say no more.
passages.vernacular: 好喇,唔好再講喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好了,別再說了。

passages.original: [Exit Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Coming forward.] How shall I murder him, Iago?
passages.vernacular: [上前。]我該點樣殺佢,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: [上前。]我該怎樣殺他,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Did you perceive how he laughed at his vice?
passages.vernacular: 你睇到佢點樣嘲笑自己嘅惡行嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看到他怎樣嘲笑自己的惡行嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O Iago!
passages.vernacular: 啊伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊伊阿古!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And did you see the handkerchief?
passages.vernacular: 你睇到手帕咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看到手帕了嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Was that mine?
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係我嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是我的嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Yours, by this hand: and to see how he prizes the foolish woman your wife! she gave it him, and he hath given it his whore.
passages.vernacular: 係您嘅,憑呢隻手:睇佢多重視嗰個愚蠢嘅女人,您嘅妻子!佢畀咗佢,佢又送畀咗佢嘅娼妓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是您的,憑這隻手:看他多重視那個愚蠢的女人,您的妻子!她給了他,他又送給了他的娼妓。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I would have him nine years a-killing. A fine woman, a fair woman, a sweet woman!
passages.vernacular: 我要佢死上九年。一個好女人,美麗嘅女人,甜美嘅女人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要他死上九年。一個好女人,美麗的女人,甜美的女人!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, you must forget that.
passages.vernacular: 不,您必須忘掉呢點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,您必須忘掉這點。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, let her rot, and perish, and be damned tonight, for she shall not live. No, my heart is turned to stone; I strike it, and it hurts my hand. O, the world hath not a sweeter creature. She might lie by an emperor’s side, and command him tasks.
passages.vernacular: 係,讓佢今晚腐爛、滅亡、受詛咒,因為佢唔能夠活。不,我嘅心變成咗石頭;我捶佢,卻傷咗我嘅手。啊,世上冇更甜美嘅人喇。佢可以躺喺皇帝身邊,指派佢做事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,讓她今晚腐爛、滅亡、受詛咒,因為她不能活。不,我的心變成了石頭;我捶它,卻傷了我的手。啊,世上沒有更甜美的人了。她可以躺在皇帝身邊,指派他做事。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, that’s not your way.
passages.vernacular: 不,呢唔係您該有嘅方式。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這不是您該有的方式。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Hang her, I do but say what she is. So delicate with her needle, an admirable musician! O, she will sing the savageness out of a bear! Of so high and plenteous wit and invention!
passages.vernacular: 該死,我只係講佢係點樣嘅人。針線活咁精巧,係位出色嘅音樂家!啊,佢能唱得熊都失去野性!才智同創造力咁高、咁豐富!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該死,我只是說她是怎樣的人。針線活那麼精巧,是位出色的音樂家!啊,她能唱得熊都失去野性!才智和創造力那麼高、那麼豐富!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: She’s the worse for all this.
passages.vernacular: 就因為呢啲,佢更糟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就因為這些,她更糟。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, a thousand, a thousand times: and then of so gentle a condition!
passages.vernacular: 啊,千倍,千倍:而且品性咁溫柔!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,千倍,千倍:而且品性那麼溫柔!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, too gentle.
passages.vernacular: 係,太溫柔喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,太溫柔了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, that’s certain. But yet the pity of it, Iago! O Iago, the pity of it, Iago!
passages.vernacular: 不,呢個係肯定嘅。但係呢多可惜,伊阿古!啊伊阿古,幾咁可惜,伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這是肯定的。但是這多可惜,伊阿古!啊伊阿古,多麼可惜,伊阿古!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: If you are so fond over her iniquity, give her patent to offend, for if it touch not you, it comes near nobody.
passages.vernacular: 如果您對佢嘅罪惡如此癡情,就畀佢作惡嘅特許,因為如果呢不觸及您,就冇人會被觸及。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您對她的罪惡如此癡情,就給她作惡的特許,因為如果這不觸及您,就沒有人會被觸及。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I will chop her into messes. Cuckold me!
passages.vernacular: 我要把佢剁成肉塊。畀我戴綠帽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把她剁成肉塊。給我戴綠帽!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, ’tis foul in her.
passages.vernacular: 啊,佢太卑鄙喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,她太卑鄙了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With mine officer!
passages.vernacular: 仲跟我嘅軍官!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還跟我的軍官!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: That’s fouler.
passages.vernacular: 嗰更卑鄙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那更卑鄙。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Get me some poison, Iago; this night. I’ll not expostulate with her, lest her body and beauty unprovide my mind again. This night, Iago.
passages.vernacular: 畀我弄點毒藥,伊阿古;今晚。我不同佢理論,免得佢嘅身體同美貌又使我嘅決心瓦解。今晚,伊阿古。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我弄點毒藥,伊阿古;今晚。我不與她理論,免得她的身體和美貌又使我的決心瓦解。今晚,伊阿古。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do it not with poison, strangle her in her bed, even the bed she hath contaminated.
passages.vernacular: 唔好用毒藥,喺佢床上把佢勒死,就喺佢玷污嘅嗰張床上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要用毒藥,在她床上把她勒死,就在她玷污的那張床上。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Good, good. The justice of it pleases. Very good.
passages.vernacular: 好,好。呢公正令我滿意。好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,好。這公正令我滿意。很好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And for Cassio, let me be his undertaker. You shall hear more by midnight.
passages.vernacular: 至於凱西奧,讓我嚟承包佢嘅後事。午夜前你會聽到更多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於凱西奧,讓我來承包他的後事。午夜前你會聽到更多。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Excellent good. [A trumpet within.] What trumpet is that same?
passages.vernacular: 好極喇。[內有號角聲。]嗰個係乜嘢號角?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好極了。[內有號角聲。]那是什麼號角?

passages.original: Enter Lodovico, Desdemona and Attendant.
passages.vernacular: [洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜同侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜和侍從上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Something from Venice, sure. ’Tis Lodovico Come from the duke. See, your wife is with him.
passages.vernacular: 肯定係威尼斯嚟嘅。係洛多維科,從公爵嗰度嚟嘅。睇,您妻子跟佢喺一起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定是威尼斯來的。是洛多維科,從公爵那裡來的。看,您妻子跟他在一起。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Save you, worthy general!
passages.vernacular: 向您問安,尊貴嘅將軍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向您問安,尊貴的將軍!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With all my heart, sir.
passages.vernacular: 衷心感謝,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 衷心感謝,先生。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: The duke and senators of Venice greet you.
passages.vernacular: 威尼斯公爵同議員哋向您問候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 威尼斯公爵和議員們向您問候。

passages.original: [Gives him a packet.]
passages.vernacular: [遞畀佢一包文件。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [遞給他一包文件。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I kiss the instrument of their pleasures.
passages.vernacular: 我親吻佢哋意願嘅文書。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我親吻他們意願的文書。

passages.original: [Opens the packet and reads.]
passages.vernacular: [打開文件閱讀。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [打開文件閱讀。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: And what’s the news, good cousin Lodovico?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢消息,好堂兄洛多維科?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼消息,好堂兄洛多維科?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am very glad to see you, signior. Welcome to Cyprus.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興見到您,大人。歡迎嚟到塞浦路斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興見到您,大人。歡迎來到塞浦路斯。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I thank you. How does Lieutenant Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 謝謝您。凱西奧副官好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝您。凱西奧副官好嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lives, sir.
passages.vernacular: 活住,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 活著,先生。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Cousin, there’s fall’n between him and my lord An unkind breach, but you shall make all well.
passages.vernacular: 堂兄,佢同我丈夫之間出現咗不愉快嘅裂痕,但你會讓一切恢復。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 堂兄,他和我丈夫之間出現了不愉快的裂痕,但你會讓一切恢復。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are you sure of that?
passages.vernacular: 你確定嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你確定嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Reads.] “This fail you not to do, as you will—”
passages.vernacular: [讀。]「你務必照此行事,隨你——」
passages.vernacularMandarin: [讀。]「你務必照此行事,隨你——」

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: He did not call; he’s busy in the paper. Is there division ’twixt my lord and Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 佢冇叫你;佢喺忙住睇文件。我丈夫同凱西奧之間有分歧嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他沒有叫你;他在忙著看文件。我丈夫和凱西奧之間有分歧嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: A most unhappy one. I would do much To atone them, for the love I bear to Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 好不幸嘅分歧。為了我對凱西奧嘅愛,我願意盡力讓佢哋和解。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常不幸的分歧。為了我對凱西奧的愛,我願意盡力讓他們和解。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fire and brimstone!
passages.vernacular: 烈火同硫磺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 烈火與硫磺!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are you wise?
passages.vernacular: 你神志清醒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你神志清醒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What, is he angry?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,佢生氣喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,他生氣了?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: May be the letter mov’d him; For, as I think, they do command him home, Deputing Cassio in his government.
passages.vernacular: 或者係信打動咗佢;因為我想,佢哋命令佢回國,由凱西奧接任佢嘅總督職位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也許是信打動了他;因為我想,他們命令他回國,由凱西奧接任他的總督職位。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Trust me, I am glad on’t.
passages.vernacular: 相信我,我為此高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我,我為此高興。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Indeed!
passages.vernacular: 真嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am glad to see you mad.
passages.vernacular: 睇到你發瘋,我好高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看到你發瘋,我很高興。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, sweet Othello?
passages.vernacular: 點解,親愛嘅奧賽羅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,親愛的奧賽羅?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Devil!
passages.vernacular: 魔鬼!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 魔鬼!

passages.original: [Striking her.]
passages.vernacular: [打佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [打她。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have not deserv’d this.
passages.vernacular: 我不該受呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不該受這個。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: My lord, this would not be believ’d in Venice, Though I should swear I saw’t: ’tis very much. Make her amends. She weeps.
passages.vernacular: 大人,呢喺威尼斯唔會有人相信,即使我發誓親眼睇到:呢太過分喇。向佢賠罪吧。佢哭喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,這在威尼斯不會有人相信,即使我發誓親眼看到:這太過分了。向她賠罪吧。她哭了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O devil, devil! If that the earth could teem with woman’s tears, Each drop she falls would prove a crocodile. Out of my sight!
passages.vernacular: 啊,魔鬼,魔鬼!如果大地能孕育女人嘅眼淚,佢落下嘅每一滴都會變成鱷魚。滾出我嘅視線!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,魔鬼,魔鬼!如果大地能孕育女人的眼淚,她落下的每一滴都會變成鱷魚。滾出我的視線!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will not stay to offend you.
passages.vernacular: 我不留下嚟冒犯你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不留下來冒犯你。

passages.original: [Going.]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Truly, an obedient lady. I do beseech your lordship, call her back.
passages.vernacular: 真係一位順從嘅夫人。我懇求大人,叫佢回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真是一位順從的夫人。我懇求大人,叫她回來。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Mistress!
passages.vernacular: 夫人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What would you with her, sir?
passages.vernacular: 你想對佢做乜嘢,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你想對她做什麼,先生?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Who, I, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 邊個,我,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰,我,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, you did wish that I would make her turn. Sir, she can turn, and turn, and yet go on, And turn again. And she can weep, sir, weep; And she’s obedient, as you say, obedient, Very obedient. Proceed you in your tears. Concerning this, sir,—O well-painted passion! I am commanded home.—Get you away; I’ll send for you anon.—Sir, I obey the mandate, And will return to Venice.—Hence, avaunt!
passages.vernacular: 對,你曾希望我讓佢轉身。先生,佢能轉身,再轉身,繼續走,再轉身。佢都能哭,先生,哭;佢順從,如你所講,順從,好順從。你繼續流淚吧。至於呢件事,先生——啊,畫得多好嘅激情!我被命令回國。——你走開;我稍後會派人叫你。——先生,我服從命令,將回威尼斯。——滾開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,你曾希望我讓她轉身。先生,她能轉身,再轉身,繼續走,再轉身。她也能哭,先生,哭;她順從,如你所說,順從,非常順從。你繼續流淚吧。至於這件事,先生——啊,畫得多好的激情!我被命令回國。——你走開;我稍後會派人叫你。——先生,我服從命令,將回威尼斯。——滾開!

passages.original: [Exit Desdemona.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Cassio shall have my place. And, sir, tonight, I do entreat that we may sup together. You are welcome, sir, to Cyprus. Goats and monkeys!
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧將接替我嘅職位。仲有,先生,今晚我請你同我哋共進晚餐。先生,歡迎你嚟到塞浦路斯。山羊同猴子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧將接替我的職位。還有,先生,今晚我請你與我們共進晚餐。先生,歡迎你來到塞浦路斯。山羊和猴子!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Is this the noble Moor, whom our full senate Call all in all sufficient? Is this the nature Whom passion could not shake? whose solid virtue The shot of accident nor dart of chance Could neither graze nor pierce?
passages.vernacular: 呢個就係我哋整個元老院稱為全才全能嘅高貴摩爾人嗎?呢個就係激情都無法動搖嘅本性嗎?佢堅實嘅美德,意外嘅子彈同機遇嘅飛鏢都唔能夠擦傷或刺穿?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這就是我們整個元老院稱為全才全能的高貴摩爾人嗎?這就是激情都無法動搖的本性嗎?他堅實的美德,意外的子彈和機遇的飛鏢都不能擦傷或刺穿?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He is much chang’d.
passages.vernacular: 佢變咗好多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他變了很多。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Are his wits safe? Is he not light of brain?
passages.vernacular: 佢神志正常嗎?佢唔係頭腦輕浮嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他神志正常嗎?他不是頭腦輕浮嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He’s that he is. I may not breathe my censure What he might be. If what he might he is not, I would to heaven he were!
passages.vernacular: 佢就係佢嗰個樣子。我不便講出我對佢可能係乜嘢嘅判斷。如果佢唔係佢可能嘅樣子,我但願上天讓佢係!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他就是他那個樣子。我不便說出我對他可能是什麼的判斷。如果他不是他可能的樣子,我但願上天讓他是!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: What, strike his wife?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,打佢妻子?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,打他妻子?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, that was not so well; yet would I knew That stroke would prove the worst!
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,嗰不太好;但我希望知道嗰一擊會係最壞嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,那不太好;但我希望知道那一擊會是最壞的!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Is it his use? Or did the letters work upon his blood, And new-create this fault?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢嘅習慣嗎?定係信件作用於佢嘅血氣,新造出呢個過失?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他的習慣嗎?還是信件作用於他的血氣,新造出這個過失?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Alas, alas! It is not honesty in me to speak What I have seen and known. You shall observe him, And his own courses will denote him so That I may save my speech: do but go after, And mark how he continues.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,哎呀!我講出我所見所知,並非誠實。你會觀察佢,佢自己嘅行為會顯示佢嘅樣子,我就唔使多講:只管跟住去,留意佢點樣繼續。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,哎呀!我說出我所見所知,並非誠實。你會觀察他,他自己的行為會顯示他的樣子,我就不必多說:只管跟著去,留意他怎樣繼續。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I am sorry that I am deceiv’d in him.
passages.vernacular: 我好遺憾,我睇錯咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很遺憾,我看錯了他。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene II — Cyprus. A Room in the Castle 第四幕第二場:塞浦路斯城堡一室

passages.original: Enter Othello and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: You have seen nothing, then?
passages.vernacular: 咁你乜嘢都冇睇到?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼你什麼都沒看到?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Nor ever heard, nor ever did suspect.
passages.vernacular: 冇聽過,都從未懷疑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒聽過,也從未懷疑。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Yes, you have seen Cassio and she together.
passages.vernacular: 不過你睇到過凱西奧同佢喺一起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可是你看到過凱西奧和她在一起。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But then I saw no harm, and then I heard Each syllable that breath made up between them.
passages.vernacular: 但嗰時我冇睇到有乜嘢不妥,而且我聽到咗佢哋之間講嘅每一個音節。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但那時我沒看到有什麼不妥,而且我聽到了他們之間說的每一個音節。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What, did they never whisper?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,佢哋從不低聲講話?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,他們從不低聲說話?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 從不,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nor send you out o’ the way?
passages.vernacular: 都冇支開你?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也沒有支開你?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never.
passages.vernacular: 從不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: To fetch her fan, her gloves, her mask, nor nothing?
passages.vernacular: 去攞佢嘅扇子、手套、面具,乜嘢都冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿她的扇子、手套、面具,什麼都沒有?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 從不,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That’s strange.
passages.vernacular: 真奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真奇怪。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I durst, my lord, to wager she is honest, Lay down my soul at stake: if you think other, Remove your thought, it doth abuse your bosom. If any wretch have put this in your head, Let heaven requite it with the serpent’s curse, For if she be not honest, chaste, and true, There’s no man happy. The purest of their wives Is foul as slander.
passages.vernacular: 大人,我敢打賭佢係貞潔嘅,攞我嘅靈魂作賭注:如果您認為唔係,請除去呢個想法,佢喺欺騙您嘅胸懷。如果有邊個壞蛋把呢想法放進您腦裡,願上天用蛇嘅詛咒報應佢,因為如果佢不貞潔、不純潔、不忠誠,就冇邊個男人係幸福嘅。佢哋妻子中最純潔嘅,都像誹謗一樣污穢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,我敢打賭她是貞潔的,拿我的靈魂作賭注:如果您認為不是,請除去這個想法,它在欺騙您的胸懷。如果有哪個壞蛋把這想法放進您腦裡,願上天用蛇的詛咒報應他,因為如果她不貞潔、不純潔、不忠誠,就沒有哪個男人是幸福的。他們妻子中最純潔的,也像誹謗一樣污穢。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Bid her come hither. Go.
passages.vernacular: 叫佢過嚟。去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 叫她過來。去。

passages.original: [Exit Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She says enough. Yet she’s a simple bawd That cannot say as much. This is a subtle whore, A closet lock and key of villainous secrets. And yet she’ll kneel and pray. I have seen her do ’t.
passages.vernacular: 佢講得夠多喇。然而,講不出呢啲話嘅,都係個愚蠢嘅皮條客。呢個係個狡猾嘅娼婦,一把鎖住卑鄙祕密嘅內室鎖同鑰匙。然而佢仲會下跪祈禱。我見過佢咁樣做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她說得夠多了。然而,說不出這些話的,也是個愚蠢的皮條客。這是個狡猾的娼婦,一把鎖住卑鄙祕密的內室鎖和鑰匙。然而她還會下跪祈禱。我見過她這樣做。

passages.original: Enter Desdemona and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord, what is your will?
passages.vernacular: 大人,您有乜嘢吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,您有什麼吩咐?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Pray, chuck, come hither.
passages.vernacular: 請過嚟,小雞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請過來,小雞。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What is your pleasure?
passages.vernacular: 您想要乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您想要什麼?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Let me see your eyes. Look in my face.
passages.vernacular: 讓我睇睇你嘅眼睛。睇住我嘅臉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我看看你的眼睛。看著我的臉。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What horrible fancy’s this?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢可怕嘅念頭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼可怕的念頭?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [To Emilia.] Some of your function, mistress, Leave procreants alone, and shut the door. Cough, or cry hem, if anybody come. Your mystery, your mystery. Nay, dispatch.
passages.vernacular: [對愛米利亞。]夫人,做你嗰一行該做嘅事,讓交歡嘅人獨處,關上門。有人嚟就咳嗽或喊一聲「哼」。你嘅行當,你嘅行當。快去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對愛米利亞。]夫人,做你那一行該做的事,讓交歡的人獨處,關上門。有人來就咳嗽或喊一聲「哼」。你的行當,你的行當。快去。

passages.original: [Exit Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞下。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Upon my knees, what doth your speech import? I understand a fury in your words, But not the words.
passages.vernacular: 我跪喺你面前,你嘅話係乜嘢意思?我聽出你話中嘅狂怒,卻不明白話語。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我跪在你面前,你的話是什麼意思?我聽出你話中的狂怒,卻不明白話語。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why, what art thou?
passages.vernacular: 咦,你係乜嘢人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,你是什麼人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Your wife, my lord, your true and loyal wife.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅妻子,大人,你真誠忠實嘅妻子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的妻子,大人,你真誠忠實的妻子。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Come, swear it, damn thyself, Lest, being like one of heaven, the devils themselves Should fear to seize thee. Therefore be double-damn’d. Swear thou art honest.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,發誓吧,詛咒你自己,免得你像天上嘅人一樣,連魔鬼都唔敢抓你。所以要加倍受詛咒。發誓你貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,發誓吧,詛咒你自己,免得你像天上的人一樣,連魔鬼都不敢抓你。所以要加倍受詛咒。發誓你貞潔。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven doth truly know it.
passages.vernacular: 上天確實知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天確實知道。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Heaven truly knows that thou art false as hell.
passages.vernacular: 上天確實知道你像地獄一樣虛偽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天確實知道你像地獄一樣虛偽。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: To whom, my lord? With whom? How am I false?
passages.vernacular: 對邊個,大人?跟邊個?我點虛偽?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對誰,大人?跟誰?我怎麼虛偽?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O Desdemona, away! away! away!
passages.vernacular: 啊戴絲德夢娜,走開!走開!走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊戴絲德夢娜,走開!走開!走開!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas the heavy day, why do you weep? Am I the motive of these tears, my lord? If haply you my father do suspect An instrument of this your calling back, Lay not your blame on me. If you have lost him, Why, I have lost him too.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,沉重嘅日子,你點解哭?大人,我係呢啲眼淚嘅緣由嗎?如果您或許懷疑我父親係召您回國嘅工具,請唔好把責任推到我身上。如果您失去咗佢,咦,我都失去咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,沉重的日子,你為什麼哭?大人,我是這些眼淚的緣由嗎?如果您或許懷疑我父親是召您回國的工具,請不要把責任推到我身上。如果您失去了他,咦,我也失去了他。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Had it pleas’d heaven To try me with affliction, had they rain’d All kinds of sores and shames on my bare head, Steep’d me in poverty to the very lips, Given to captivity me and my utmost hopes, I should have found in some place of my soul A drop of patience. But, alas, to make me A fixed figure for the time of scorn To point his slow unmoving finger at. Yet could I bear that too, well, very well: But there, where I have garner’d up my heart, Where either I must live or bear no life, The fountain from the which my current runs, Or else dries up, to be discarded thence, Or keep it as a cistern for foul toads To knot and gender in!—turn thy complexion there, Patience, thou young and rose-lipp’d cherubin, Ay, there, look grim as hell!
passages.vernacular: 如果上天高興用苦難考驗我,把各種瘡痍同恥辱降喺我光禿禿嘅頭上,讓我貧窮到浸冇嘴唇,把我同我最大嘅希望都交畀囚禁,我都能喺我靈魂嘅某處找到一滴耐心。但係,哎呀,要把我變成時代嘲笑嘅固定靶子,讓佢用遲緩不動嘅手指指點。然而我都能承受呢個,好好,好好:但喺嗰度,我曾把心儲藏嘅地方,我必須喺嗰度生活或唔再有生命,我嘅水流所從出嘅泉源,或者就此乾涸,竟要被趕出嗰度,或者讓佢成為骯髒蟾蜍交配繁殖嘅水池!——喺嗰度,耐心,你呢年輕玫瑰唇嘅小天使,都要變臉,對,喺嗰度,像地獄一樣陰沉!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果上天高興用苦難考驗我,把各種瘡痍和恥辱降在我光禿禿的頭上,讓我貧窮到浸沒嘴唇,把我和我最大的希望都交給囚禁,我也能在我靈魂的某處找到一滴耐心。但是,哎呀,要把我變成時代嘲笑的固定靶子,讓它用遲緩不動的手指指點。然而我也能承受這個,很好,非常好:但在那裡,我曾把心儲藏的地方,我必須在那裡生活或不再有生命,我的水流所從出的泉源,或者就此乾涸,竟要被趕出那裡,或者讓它成為骯髒蟾蜍交配繁殖的水池!——在那裡,耐心,你這年輕玫瑰唇的小天使,也要變臉,對,在那裡,像地獄一樣陰沉!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I hope my noble lord esteems me honest.
passages.vernacular: 我希望我高貴嘅大人認為我貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望我高貴的大人認為我貞潔。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, ay, as summer flies are in the shambles, That quicken even with blowing. O thou weed, Who art so lovely fair, and smell’st so sweet, That the sense aches at thee, Would thou hadst ne’er been born!
passages.vernacular: 啊,係,就像屠宰場裡嘅夏蠅,一吹氣就生蛆。啊你呢野草,如此可愛美麗,氣味如此甜美,令感官為你疼痛,但願你從未出生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,是,就像屠宰場裡的夏蠅,一吹氣就生蛆。啊你這野草,如此可愛美麗,氣味如此甜美,令感官為你疼痛,但願你從未出生!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, what ignorant sin have I committed?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我犯咗乜嘢無知嘅罪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我犯了什麼無知的罪?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Was this fair paper, this most goodly book, Made to write “whore” upon? What committed? Committed! O thou public commoner! I should make very forges of my cheeks, That would to cinders burn up modesty, Did I but speak thy deeds. What committed! Heaven stops the nose at it, and the moon winks; The bawdy wind, that kisses all it meets, Is hush’d within the hollow mine of earth, And will not hear it. What committed! Impudent strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 呢張美麗嘅紙,呢本最美好嘅書,係為了喺上面寫「娼婦」而造嘅嗎?犯咗乜嘢?犯喇!啊你呢公共嘅妓女!如果我講出你嘅行為,我會把我嘅臉頰燒成熔爐,把羞恥燒成灰燼。犯咗乜嘢!上天捂住鼻子,月亮閉上眼睛;嗰淫蕩嘅風,吻遍所遇嘅一切,喺大地空洞嘅礦穴裡靜默,唔願聽佢。犯咗乜嘢!無恥嘅娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這張美麗的紙,這本最美好的書,是為了在上面寫「娼婦」而造的嗎?犯了什麼?犯了!啊你這公共的妓女!如果我說出你的行為,我會把我的臉頰燒成熔爐,把羞恥燒成灰燼。犯了什麼!上天捂住鼻子,月亮閉上眼睛;那淫蕩的風,吻遍所遇的一切,在大地空洞的礦穴裡靜默,不願聽它。犯了什麼!無恥的娼婦!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: By heaven, you do me wrong.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,您冤枉我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,您冤枉我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are not you a strumpet?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係娼婦嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是娼婦嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, as I am a Christian: If to preserve this vessel for my lord From any other foul unlawful touch Be not to be a strumpet, I am none.
passages.vernacular: 不,我以基督徒嘅身份講:如果為我丈夫保存呢個軀殼,免受任何其他骯髒不合法嘅觸碰,不算娼婦,嗰我就唔係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我以基督徒的身份說:如果為我丈夫保存這個軀殼,免受任何其他骯髒不合法的觸碰,不算娼婦,那我就不是。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What, not a whore?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,唔係妓女?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,不是妓女?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, as I shall be sav’d.
passages.vernacular: 不,我以我將得救起誓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我以我將得救起誓。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Is’t possible?
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: O, heaven forgive us!
passages.vernacular: 啊,上天寬恕我哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,上天寬恕我們!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I cry you mercy then. I took you for that cunning whore of Venice That married with Othello.—You, mistress,
passages.vernacular: 嗰我請求你原諒。我把你當成嫁畀奧賽羅嘅嗰個威尼斯狡猾娼婦喇。——你,夫人,
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我請求你原諒。我把你當成嫁給奧賽羅的那個威尼斯狡猾娼婦了。——你,夫人,

passages.original: Enter Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That have the office opposite to Saint Peter, And keeps the gate of hell. You, you, ay, you! We have done our course; there’s money for your pains. I pray you turn the key, and keep our counsel.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅職務同聖彼得相反,睇守住地獄嘅大門。你,你,對,你!我哋嘅事辦完喇;呢個係畀你辛苦嘅錢。請你轉動鑰匙,替我哋保密。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的職務與聖彼得相反,看守著地獄的大門。你,你,對,你!我們的事辦完了;這是給你辛苦的錢。請你轉動鑰匙,替我們保密。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, what does this gentleman conceive? How do you, madam? How do you, my good lady?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,呢位先生喺想乜嘢?您點樣,夫人?您點樣,我嘅好夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,這位先生在想什麼?您怎樣,夫人?您怎樣,我的好夫人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Faith, half asleep.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,半瞓半醒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,半睡半醒。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Good madam, what’s the matter with my lord?
passages.vernacular: 好夫人,我嘅大人點喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好夫人,我的大人怎麼了?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: With who?
passages.vernacular: 邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, with my lord, madam.
passages.vernacular: 咦,我嘅大人,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,我的大人,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Who is thy lord?
passages.vernacular: 邊個係你嘅大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰是你的大人?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He that is yours, sweet lady.
passages.vernacular: 就係您嘅大人,親愛嘅夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是您的大人,親愛的夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have none. Do not talk to me, Emilia, I cannot weep, nor answer have I none But what should go by water. Prithee, tonight Lay on my bed my wedding sheets, remember, And call thy husband hither.
passages.vernacular: 我冇。別跟我講話,愛米利亞,我唔能夠哭,我都冇答案,只有淚水能表達。請你,今晚喺我床上鋪我嘅結婚床單,記住,並叫你丈夫過嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我沒有。別跟我說話,愛米利亞,我不能哭,我也沒有答案,只有淚水能表達。請你,今晚在我床上鋪我的結婚床單,記住,並叫你丈夫過來。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Here’s a change indeed!
passages.vernacular: 真係變喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真是變了!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: ’Tis meet I should be us’d so, very meet. How have I been behav’d, that he might stick The small’st opinion on my least misuse?
passages.vernacular: 我被咁樣對待係應該嘅,好應該。我嘅行為點樣,竟使佢對我最小嘅過錯都加以最輕微嘅懷疑?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被這樣對待是應該的,非常應該。我的行為怎樣,竟使他對我最小的過錯也加以最輕微的懷疑?

passages.original: Enter Iago and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What is your pleasure, madam? How is’t with you?
passages.vernacular: 夫人,您有乜嘢吩咐?您點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,您有什麼吩咐?您怎麼樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I cannot tell. Those that do teach young babes Do it with gentle means and easy tasks. He might have chid me so, for, in good faith, I am a child to chiding.
passages.vernacular: 我講不出嚟。嗰啲教導小孩嘅人,用溫和嘅方法同簡單嘅功課。佢本可以咁樣責備我,因為講真嘅,我對責備仲像個細路。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說不出來。那些教導小孩的人,用溫和的方法和簡單的功課。他本可以這樣責備我,因為說真的,我對責備還像個孩子。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What’s the matter, lady?
passages.vernacular: 夫人,點回事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,怎麼回事?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, Iago, my lord hath so bewhor’d her, Thrown such despite and heavy terms upon her, As true hearts cannot bear.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,伊阿古,我嘅大人把佢罵成娼婦,用咁惡毒沉重嘅話對佢,真心嘅人係無法忍受嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,伊阿古,我的大人把她罵成娼婦,用這麼惡毒沉重的話對她,真心的人是無法忍受的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Am I that name, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 我係嗰個名字嗎,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是那個名字嗎,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What name, fair lady?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢名字,好夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼名字,好夫人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Such as she says my lord did say I was.
passages.vernacular: 就係佢講我丈夫講我嘅嗰個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是她說我丈夫說我的那個。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He call’d her whore: a beggar in his drink Could not have laid such terms upon his callet.
passages.vernacular: 佢叫佢娼婦:連一個飲醉嘅乞丐,都唔會咁樣對待佢嘅情婦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他叫她娼婦:連一個喝醉的乞丐,也不會這樣對待他的情婦。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why did he so?
passages.vernacular: 佢點解咁樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他為什麼這樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I do not know. I am sure I am none such.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道。我肯定我唔係嗰樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道。我肯定我不是那樣。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do not weep, do not weep: alas the day!
passages.vernacular: 別哭,別哭:哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別哭,別哭:哎呀!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Hath she forsook so many noble matches, Her father, and her country, and her friends, To be call’d whore? would it not make one weep?
passages.vernacular: 佢捨棄咗咁多高貴嘅婚事、佢嘅父親、佢嘅國家、佢嘅朋友,就為了被叫作娼婦?呢不叫人哭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她捨棄了那麼多高貴的婚事、她的父親、她的國家、她的朋友,就為了被叫作娼婦?這不叫人哭嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It is my wretched fortune.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我悲慘嘅命運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我悲慘的命運。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Beshrew him for’t! How comes this trick upon him?
passages.vernacular: 該死嘅佢!佢點會咁樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該死的他!他怎麼會這樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Nay, heaven doth know.
passages.vernacular: 不,上天知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,上天知道。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I will be hang’d, if some eternal villain, Some busy and insinuating rogue, Some cogging, cozening slave, to get some office, Have not devis’d this slander. I’ll be hang’d else.
passages.vernacular: 我願被吊死,如果唔係某個永遠嘅惡棍,某個忙碌又阿諛嘅流氓,某個欺詐嘅奴才,為了謀取官職,編造咗呢個誹謗。否則我願被吊死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我願被吊死,如果不是某個永遠的惡棍,某個忙碌又阿諛的流氓,某個欺詐的奴才,為了謀取官職,編造了這個誹謗。否則我願被吊死。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Fie, there is no such man. It is impossible.
passages.vernacular: 呸,冇呢種人。呢唔可能。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,沒有這種人。這不可能。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: If any such there be, heaven pardon him!
passages.vernacular: 如果有呢種人,上天寬恕佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果有這種人,上天寬恕他!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: A halter pardon him, and hell gnaw his bones! Why should he call her whore? who keeps her company? What place? what time? what form? what likelihood? The Moor’s abused by some most villainous knave, Some base notorious knave, some scurvy fellow. O heaven, that such companions thou’dst unfold, And put in every honest hand a whip To lash the rascals naked through the world Even from the east to the west!
passages.vernacular: 讓絞索寬恕佢,讓地獄啃佢嘅骨頭!佢點解叫佢娼婦?邊個同佢作伴?喺邊度?乜嘢時候?乜嘢形式?有乜嘢可能?摩爾人被某個最卑鄙嘅惡棍欺騙喇,某個惡名昭彰嘅卑鄙人,某個下流傢伙。啊上天,但願你揭露呢啲人,喺每個誠實人手裡放一條鞭子,把呢啲無賴赤身抽遍全世界,從東到西!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓絞索寬恕他,讓地獄啃他的骨頭!他為什麼叫她娼婦?誰與她作伴?在哪裡?什麼時候?什麼形式?有什麼可能?摩爾人被某個最卑鄙的惡棍欺騙了,某個惡名昭彰的卑鄙人,某個下流傢伙。啊上天,但願你揭露這些人,在每個誠實人手裡放一條鞭子,把這些無賴赤身抽遍全世界,從東到西!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Speak within door.
passages.vernacular: 小聲講,唔好畀外面聽見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小聲說,別讓外面聽見。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, fie upon them! Some such squire he was That turn’d your wit the seamy side without, And made you to suspect me with the Moor.
passages.vernacular: 啊,呸佢哋!佢就係咁樣一個傢伙,把你嘅頭腦翻咗面,令你懷疑我同摩爾人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,呸他們!他就是這樣一個傢伙,把你的頭腦翻了面,令你懷疑我與摩爾人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You are a fool. Go to.
passages.vernacular: 你係個傻瓜。得喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是個傻瓜。得了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, Iago, What shall I do to win my lord again? Good friend, go to him. For by this light of heaven, I know not how I lost him. Here I kneel. If e’er my will did trespass ’gainst his love, Either in discourse of thought or actual deed, Or that mine eyes, mine ears, or any sense, Delighted them in any other form, Or that I do not yet, and ever did, And ever will, (though he do shake me off To beggarly divorcement) love him dearly, Comfort forswear me! Unkindness may do much; And his unkindness may defeat my life, But never taint my love. I cannot say “whore,” It does abhor me now I speak the word; To do the act that might the addition earn Not the world’s mass of vanity could make me.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,伊阿古,我該點做才能重新贏回我嘅大人?好朋友,去找佢。因為憑呢天上嘅光,我唔知道我係點失去佢嘅。我喺呢度跪下。如果我嘅意願曾喺言語或行動上冒犯佢嘅愛,或者我嘅眼睛、耳朵或任何感官,曾喺其他形象上取樂,或者我而家不、過去一向不、將來都永遠不(即使佢把我趕入乞丐般嘅離婚)深愛佢,願安慰離棄我!無情可以做好多事;佢嘅無情可以毀掉我嘅生命,卻永遠唔能夠玷污我嘅愛。我講不出「娼婦」,我講呢個詞,佢就令我厭惡;為了做可能贏得呢個稱號嘅事,整個世界嘅虛榮都唔能夠引誘我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,伊阿古,我該怎麼做才能重新贏回我的大人?好朋友,去找他。因為憑這天上的光,我不知道我是怎麼失去他的。我在這裡跪下。如果我的意願曾在言語或行動上冒犯他的愛,或者我的眼睛、耳朵或任何感官,曾在其他形象上取樂,或者我現在不、過去一向不、將來也永遠不(即使他把我趕入乞丐般的離婚)深愛他,願安慰離棄我!無情可以做很多事;他的無情可以毀掉我的生命,卻永遠不能玷污我的愛。我說不出「娼婦」,我說這個詞,它就令我厭惡;為了做可能贏得這個稱號的事,整個世界的虛榮都不能引誘我。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I pray you, be content. ’Tis but his humour. The business of the state does him offence, And he does chide with you.
passages.vernacular: 請你安心。呢只係佢嘅脾氣。國家事務使佢不快,佢就對你發脾氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你安心。這只是他的脾氣。國家事務使他不快,他就對你發脾氣。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: If ’twere no other,—
passages.vernacular: 如果冇別嘅——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果沒有別的——

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: ’Tis but so, I warrant.
passages.vernacular: 肯定只係咁樣,我擔保。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定只是這樣,我擔保。

passages.original: [Trumpets within.]
passages.vernacular: [內有號角聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有號角聲。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Hark, how these instruments summon to supper. The messengers of Venice stay the meat. Go in, and weep not. All things shall be well.
passages.vernacular: 聽,呢啲樂器喺召喚食晚飯。威尼斯嘅使者喺等候用餐。進去吧,別哭。一切都會好起嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽,這些樂器在召喚吃晚飯。威尼斯的使者在等候用餐。進去吧,別哭。一切都會好起來。

passages.original: [Exeunt Desdemona and Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞下。]

passages.original: Enter Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: [羅德利哥上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅德利哥上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now, Roderigo?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,羅德利哥?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,羅德利哥?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I do not find that thou dealest justly with me.
passages.vernacular: 我發現你對我並不公平。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我發現你對我並不公平。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What in the contrary?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢不公平?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼不公平?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Every day thou daffest me with some device, Iago, and rather, as it seems to me now, keepest from me all conveniency than suppliest me with the least advantage of hope. I will indeed no longer endure it. Nor am I yet persuaded to put up in peace what already I have foolishly suffered.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古,你每天用某種花招搪塞我,而且而家睇來,同其講畀我啲希望嘅好處,不如講一直阻止我所有嘅便利。我真嘅唔能夠再忍受喇。我都仲冇被講服,把我已經愚蠢地受過嘅就咁忍氣吞聲地算喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古,你每天用某種花招搪塞我,而且現在看來,與其說給我一點希望的好處,不如說一直阻止我所有的便利。我真的不能再忍受了。我也還沒被說服,把我已經愚蠢地受過的就這麼忍氣吞聲地算了。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you hear me, Roderigo?
passages.vernacular: 你肯聽我講嗎,羅德利哥?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你肯聽我說嗎,羅德利哥?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Faith, I have heard too much, for your words and performances are no kin together.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我聽得太多喇,因為你嘅話同你嘅行動毫不相干。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我聽得太多了,因為你的話和你的行動毫不相干。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You charge me most unjustly.
passages.vernacular: 你咁樣指責我太不公平。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這樣指責我太不公平。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: With naught but truth. I have wasted myself out of my means. The jewels you have had from me to deliver to Desdemona would half have corrupted a votarist: you have told me she hath received them, and returned me expectations and comforts of sudden respect and acquaintance, but I find none.
passages.vernacular: 我只講實話。我已經把自己嘅財產耗盡喇。你攞去交畀戴絲德夢娜嘅珠寶,足以收買半個修女:你告訴我佢收下喇,並回畀我即將受到尊重同結識嘅期待同安慰,不過我啲都冇得到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我只說實話。我已經把自己的財產耗盡了。你拿去交給戴絲德夢娜的珠寶,足以收買半個修女:你告訴我她收下了,並回給我即將受到尊重和結識的期待與安慰,可是我一點也沒得到。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Well, go to, very well.
passages.vernacular: 好,得喇,好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,得了,很好。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Very well, go to, I cannot go to, man, nor ’tis not very well. Nay, I say ’tis very scurvy, and begin to find myself fopped in it.
passages.vernacular: 好好,得喇,我可得不喇,老兄,都並不好好。不,我講呢好卑劣,我開始發現自己被愚弄喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好,得了,我可得不了,老兄,也並不很好。不,我說這很卑劣,我開始發現自己被愚弄了。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Very well.
passages.vernacular: 好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I tell you ’tis not very well. I will make myself known to Desdemona. If she will return me my jewels, I will give over my suit and repent my unlawful solicitation. If not, assure yourself I will seek satisfaction of you.
passages.vernacular: 我告訴你呢不好。我要向戴絲德夢娜表明身份。如果佢把我嘅珠寶還畀我,我就放棄追求,並為我不當嘅求愛懺悔。如果不,你放心,我會向你討回公道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我告訴你這不好。我要向戴絲德夢娜表明身份。如果她把我的珠寶還給我,我就放棄追求,並為我不當的求愛懺悔。如果不,你放心,我會向你討回公道。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You have said now.
passages.vernacular: 你講完咗吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說完了吧。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Ay, and said nothing but what I protest intendment of doing.
passages.vernacular: 係,而且我講嘅都係我聲明打算去做嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,而且我說的都是我聲明打算去做的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, now I see there’s mettle in thee, and even from this instant do build on thee a better opinion than ever before. Give me thy hand, Roderigo. Thou hast taken against me a most just exception, but yet I protest, I have dealt most directly in thy affair.
passages.vernacular: 咦,而家我睇到你有膽量,從此刻起,我對你嘅睇法比以往任何時候都更好。把你嘅手畀我,羅德利哥。你對我提出咗最公正嘅異議,不過我聲明,我喺你嘅事情上辦得最直接。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,現在我看到你有膽量,從此刻起,我對你的看法比以往任何時候都更好。把你的手給我,羅德利哥。你對我提出了最公正的異議,不過我聲明,我在你的事情上辦得最直接。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: It hath not appeared.
passages.vernacular: 呢並冇顯現出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這並沒有顯現出來。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I grant indeed it hath not appeared, and your suspicion is not without wit and judgement. But, Roderigo, if thou hast that in thee indeed, which I have greater reason to believe now than ever,—I mean purpose, courage, and valour,—this night show it. If thou the next night following enjoy not Desdemona, take me from this world with treachery and devise engines for my life.
passages.vernacular: 我確實承認冇顯現出嚟,你嘅懷疑並非冇智慧同判斷。不過,羅德利哥,如果你身上確實有我而家比以往更有理由相信嘅嗰種嘢——我指嘅係決心、膽量同勇氣——今晚就顯示出嚟。如果你第二天夜裡仲冇享受到戴絲德夢娜,就用背叛把我從呢世界上除去,並設計機關要我嘅命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我確實承認沒有顯現出來,你的懷疑並非沒有智慧和判斷。不過,羅德利哥,如果你身上確實有我現在比以往更有理由相信的那種東西——我指的是決心、膽量和勇氣——今晚就顯示出來。如果你第二天夜裡還沒有享受到戴絲德夢娜,就用背叛把我從這世界上除去,並設計機關要我的命。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Well, what is it? Is it within reason and compass?
passages.vernacular: 好,係乜嘢?呢喺情理同範圍之內嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,是什麼?這在情理和範圍之內嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Sir, there is especial commission come from Venice to depute Cassio in Othello’s place.
passages.vernacular: 先生,威尼斯有特別命令送嚟,要派凱西奧接替奧賽羅嘅位置。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,威尼斯有特別命令送來,要派凱西奧接替奧賽羅的位置。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Is that true? Why then Othello and Desdemona return again to Venice.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係真嘅嗎?咁奧賽羅同戴絲德夢娜會回威尼斯嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是真的嗎?那麼奧賽羅和戴絲德夢娜會回威尼斯嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, no; he goes into Mauritania, and takes away with him the fair Desdemona, unless his abode be lingered here by some accident: wherein none can be so determinate as the removing of Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 啊,不;佢要去毛里塔尼亞,並帶走美麗嘅戴絲德夢娜,除非佢嘅逗留被某個意外耽擱喺呢度:而其中冇邊個比移除凱西奧更確定嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,不;他要去毛里塔尼亞,並帶走美麗的戴絲德夢娜,除非他的逗留被某個意外耽擱在這裡:而其中沒有哪個比移除凱西奧更確定的。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: How do you mean “removing” of him?
passages.vernacular: 你講「移除」佢係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說「移除」他是什麼意思?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, by making him uncapable of Othello’s place: knocking out his brains.
passages.vernacular: 就係使佢無法接任奧賽羅嘅位置:打碎佢嘅腦袋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是使他無法接任奧賽羅的位置:打碎他的腦袋。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: And that you would have me to do?
passages.vernacular: 你要我做呢個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要我做這個?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, if you dare do yourself a profit and a right. He sups tonight with a harlotry, and thither will I go to him. He knows not yet of his honourable fortune. If you will watch his going thence, which I will fashion to fall out between twelve and one, you may take him at your pleasure: I will be near to second your attempt, and he shall fall between us. Come, stand not amazed at it, but go along with me. I will show you such a necessity in his death that you shall think yourself bound to put it on him. It is now high supper-time, and the night grows to waste. About it.
passages.vernacular: 係,如果你敢為自己謀利益、爭權利。佢今晚同一個蕩婦食晚飯,我會去嗰度找佢。佢仲唔知道佢嘅光榮命運。如果你觀察佢離開嗰度,我會安排喺十二點到啲之間,你可以隨意對佢下手:我會喺附近支援你嘅行動,佢會倒喺我哋兩人之間。嚟,別愣住,跟我嚟。我會向你講明佢嘅死如何必要,使你覺得自己有責任動手。而家正是晚飯時間,夜晚喺流逝。動手吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,如果你敢為自己謀利益、爭權利。他今晚與一個蕩婦吃晚飯,我會去那裡找他。他還不知道他的光榮命運。如果你觀察他離開那裡,我會安排在十二點到一點之間,你可以隨意對他下手:我會在附近支援你的行動,他會倒在我們兩人之間。來,別愣著,跟我來。我會向你說明他的死如何必要,使你覺得自己有責任動手。現在正是晚飯時間,夜晚在流逝。動手吧。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I will hear further reason for this.
passages.vernacular: 我要再聽聽呢件事嘅更多理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要再聽聽這件事的更多理由。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And you shall be satisfied.
passages.vernacular: 你會得到滿足嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會得到滿足的。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene III — Cyprus. Another Room in the Castle 第四幕第三場:塞浦路斯城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter Othello, Lodovico, Desdemona, Emilia and Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅、洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞同侍從哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅、洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞和侍從們上。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I do beseech you, sir, trouble yourself no further.
passages.vernacular: 我懇求您,先生,唔好再勞駕喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我懇求您,先生,不要再勞駕了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, pardon me; ’twill do me good to walk.
passages.vernacular: 啊,請原諒;散步對我有好處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,請原諒;散步對我有好處。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Madam, good night. I humbly thank your ladyship.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,晚安。我謙卑地感謝夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,晚安。我謙卑地感謝夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Your honour is most welcome.
passages.vernacular: 閣下,歡迎之至。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 閣下,歡迎之至。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Will you walk, sir?— O, Desdemona,—
passages.vernacular: 您願意散步嗎,先生?——啊,戴絲德夢娜——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您願意散步嗎,先生?——啊,戴絲德夢娜——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Get you to bed on th’ instant, I will be return’d forthwith. Dismiss your attendant there. Look ’t be done.
passages.vernacular: 即刻去瞓覺,我即刻回嚟。打發走你嗰度嘅侍女。務必照辦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 立刻去睡覺,我馬上回來。打發走你那裡的侍女。務必照辦。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我會,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會,大人。

passages.original: [Exeunt Othello, Lodovico and Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅、洛多維科同侍從哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅、洛多維科和侍從們下。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: How goes it now? He looks gentler than he did.
passages.vernacular: 而家點樣?佢睇起嚟比頭先溫和喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在怎麼樣?他看起來比剛才溫和了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He says he will return incontinent, He hath commanded me to go to bed, And bade me to dismiss you.
passages.vernacular: 佢講佢好快就回嚟,佢命令我去瞓覺,並吩咐我打發你走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說他很快就回來,他命令我去睡覺,並吩咐我打發你走。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Dismiss me?
passages.vernacular: 打發我走?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 打發我走?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It was his bidding. Therefore, good Emilia, Give me my nightly wearing, and adieu. We must not now displease him.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢嘅吩咐。所以,好愛米利亞,把我嘅瞓衣畀我,再見。我哋而家唔能夠惹佢不高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他的吩咐。所以,好愛米利亞,把我的睡衣給我,再見。我們現在不能惹他不高興。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I would you had never seen him!
passages.vernacular: 但願你從未見過佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願你從未見過他!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: So would not I. My love doth so approve him, That even his stubbornness, his checks, his frowns,— Prithee, unpin me,—have grace and favour in them.
passages.vernacular: 我唔願意。我嘅愛如此認可佢,連佢嘅固執、佢嘅責備、佢嘅皺眉——請你替我解開別針——都都帶住優雅同恩惠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不願意。我的愛如此認可他,連他的固執、他的責備、他的皺眉——請你替我解開別針——也都帶著優雅與恩惠。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I have laid those sheets you bade me on the bed.
passages.vernacular: 我已把你吩咐嘅嗰啲床單鋪喺床上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已把你吩咐的那些床單鋪在床上。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: All’s one. Good faith, how foolish are our minds! If I do die before thee, prithee, shroud me In one of those same sheets.
passages.vernacular: 都一樣。講真嘅,我哋嘅心幾咁愚蠢!如果我比你先死,請你用嗰啲床單中嘅一條裹我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 都一樣。說真的,我們的心多麼愚蠢!如果我比你先死,請你用那些床單中的一條裹我。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Come, come, you talk.
passages.vernacular: 得喇,得喇,你講些乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,得了,你說些什麼。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My mother had a maid call’d Barbary, She was in love, and he she lov’d prov’d mad And did forsake her. She had a song of “willow”, An old thing ’twas, but it express’d her fortune, And she died singing it. That song tonight Will not go from my mind. I have much to do But to go hang my head all at one side And sing it like poor Barbary. Prithee dispatch.
passages.vernacular: 我母親有個侍女叫芭芭莉,佢戀愛喇,佢愛嘅人變心發瘋,離棄咗佢。佢有一首「柳樹」嘅歌,係首古老嘅歌,但表達咗佢嘅命運,佢唱住佢死去。今晚嗰首歌從我心裡揮之不去。我簡直忍不住要把頭歪向一邊,像可憐嘅芭芭莉嗰樣唱佢。請你快點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我母親有個侍女叫芭芭莉,她戀愛了,她愛的人變心發瘋,離棄了她。她有一首「柳樹」的歌,是首古老的歌,但表達了她的命運,她唱著它死去。今晚那首歌從我心裡揮之不去。我簡直忍不住要把頭歪向一邊,像可憐的芭芭莉那樣唱它。請你快點。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Shall I go fetch your night-gown?
passages.vernacular: 要我去攞你嘅瞓袍嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要我去拿你的睡袍嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, unpin me here. This Lodovico is a proper man.
passages.vernacular: 不,喺呢度幫我解開別針。呢個洛多維科係個俊俏嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,在這裡幫我解開別針。這個洛多維科是個俊俏的人。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: A very handsome man.
passages.vernacular: 好英俊嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常英俊的人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He speaks well.
passages.vernacular: 佢講話得體。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說話得體。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I know a lady in Venice would have walked barefoot to Palestine for a touch of his nether lip.
passages.vernacular: 我知道威尼斯有位夫人,為了碰一下佢嘅下唇,願意赤腳走到巴勒斯坦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道威尼斯有位夫人,為了碰一下他的下唇,願意赤腳走到巴勒斯坦。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: [Singing.] The poor soul sat sighing by a sycamore tree, Sing all a green willow. Her hand on her bosom, her head on her knee, Sing willow, willow, willow. The fresh streams ran by her, and murmur’d her moans, Sing willow, willow, willow; Her salt tears fell from her, and soften’d the stones;—
passages.vernacular: [唱。]可憐嘅人兒坐喺無花果樹旁歎息,唱啊,一片綠柳。佢手放胸前,頭靠膝上,唱柳,柳,柳。清清嘅溪流從佢身旁流過,應同佢嘅哀歎,唱柳,柳,柳;佢鹹鹹嘅眼淚落下,軟化咗石頭;——
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]可憐的人兒坐在無花果樹旁歎息,唱啊,一片綠柳。她手放胸前,頭靠膝上,唱柳,柳,柳。清清的溪流從她身旁流過,應和她的哀歎,唱柳,柳,柳;她鹹鹹的眼淚落下,軟化了石頭;——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Lay by these:—
passages.vernacular: 把呢啲收起:——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把這些收起:——

passages.original: [Sings.] Sing willow, willow, willow.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]唱柳,柳,柳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]唱柳,柳,柳。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Prithee hie thee. He’ll come anon.
passages.vernacular: 請你快點。佢即刻就嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你快點。他馬上就來。

passages.original: [Sings.] Sing all a green willow must be my garland. Let nobody blame him, his scorn I approve,—
passages.vernacular: [唱。]唱啊,一片綠柳必係我嘅花環。邊個都唔好怪佢,佢嘅輕蔑我認可——
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]唱啊,一片綠柳必是我的花環。誰也不要怪他,他的輕蔑我認可——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Nay, that’s not next. Hark! who is’t that knocks?
passages.vernacular: 不,下面唔係呢句。聽!邊個喺敲門?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,下面不是這句。聽!誰在敲門?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: It’s the wind.
passages.vernacular: 係風。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是風。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: [Sings.] I call’d my love false love; but what said he then? Sing willow, willow, willow: If I court mo women, you’ll couch with mo men.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]我叫我嘅愛人負心人;佢點回答?唱柳,柳,柳:如果我追求更多女人,你就同更多男人同瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]我叫我的愛人負心人;他怎麼回答?唱柳,柳,柳:如果我追求更多女人,你就和更多男人同睡。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: So get thee gone; good night. Mine eyes do itch; Doth that bode weeping?
passages.vernacular: 所以走吧;晚安。我嘅眼睛發癢;呢預示要哭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以走吧;晚安。我的眼睛發癢;這預示要哭嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Tis neither here nor there.
passages.vernacular: 呢不好講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不好說。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have heard it said so. O, these men, these men! Dost thou in conscience think,—tell me, Emilia,— That there be women do abuse their husbands In such gross kind?
passages.vernacular: 我聽人咁樣講過。啊,呢啲男人,呢啲男人!憑良心講,你認為,告訴我,愛米利亞,有女人會咁樣粗劣地欺騙自己嘅丈夫嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我聽人這樣說過。啊,這些男人,這些男人!憑良心說,你認為,告訴我,愛米利亞,有女人會這樣粗劣地欺騙自己的丈夫嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: There be some such, no question.
passages.vernacular: 肯定有啲,毫無疑問。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定有一些,毫無疑問。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?
passages.vernacular: 你會為了整個世界做呢種事嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會為了整個世界做這種事嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, would not you?
passages.vernacular: 咦,你唔會嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,你不會嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, by this heavenly light!
passages.vernacular: 不,憑呢天上嘅光!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,憑這天上的光!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Nor I neither by this heavenly light, I might do’t as well i’ the dark.
passages.vernacular: 我都唔會,憑呢天上嘅光,我喺黑暗中都能做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不會,憑這天上的光,我在黑暗中也能做。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?
passages.vernacular: 你會為了整個世界做呢種事嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會為了整個世界做這種事嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: The world’s a huge thing. It is a great price For a small vice.
passages.vernacular: 世界係個巨大嘅嘢。對一件小惡來講,呢個係個好大嘅代價。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世界是個巨大的東西。對一件小惡來說,這是個很大的代價。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: In troth, I think thou wouldst not.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我想你唔會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我想你不會。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: In troth, I think I should, and undo’t when I had done. Marry, I would not do such a thing for a joint-ring, nor for measures of lawn, nor for gowns, petticoats, nor caps, nor any petty exhibition; but, for the whole world—why, who would not make her husband a cuckold to make him a monarch? I should venture purgatory for ’t.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我想我會,做完再把佢抹去。當然,我唔會為了一枚連環戒指、幾匹細麻布、袍子、襯裙或帽子,或任何小小嘅津貼做呢種事;但為了整個世界——咦,邊個唔願意畀丈夫戴綠帽,換佢做君王?我願冒煉獄之險。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我想我會,做完再把它抹去。當然,我不會為了一枚連環戒指、幾匹細麻布、袍子、襯裙或帽子,或任何小小的津貼做這種事;但為了整個世界——咦,誰不願意給丈夫戴綠帽,換他做君王?我願冒煉獄之險。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Beshrew me, if I would do such a wrong for the whole world.
passages.vernacular: 我若為了整個世界做呢種錯事,真該死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我若為了整個世界做這種錯事,真該死。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, the wrong is but a wrong i’ the world; and having the world for your labour, ’tis a wrong in your own world, and you might quickly make it right.
passages.vernacular: 咦,呢種錯喺呢世界上不過係一種錯;既然得到整個世界作為報酬,佢就係你自己世界裡嘅錯,你可以好快把佢變成對嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,這種錯在這世界上不過是一種錯;既然得到整個世界作為報酬,它就是你自己世界裡的錯,你可以很快把它變成對的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I do not think there is any such woman.
passages.vernacular: 我不認為有咁樣嘅女人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不認為有這樣的女人。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Yes, a dozen; and as many to the vantage as would store the world they played for. But I do think it is their husbands’ faults If wives do fall: say that they slack their duties, And pour our treasures into foreign laps; Or else break out in peevish jealousies, Throwing restraint upon us. Or say they strike us, Or scant our former having in despite. Why, we have galls; and though we have some grace, Yet have we some revenge. Let husbands know Their wives have sense like them: they see, and smell And have their palates both for sweet and sour, As husbands have. What is it that they do When they change us for others? Is it sport? I think it is. And doth affection breed it? I think it doth. Is’t frailty that thus errs? It is so too. And have not we affections, Desires for sport, and frailty, as men have? Then let them use us well: else let them know, The ills we do, their ills instruct us so.
passages.vernacular: 有,有十幾打;而且多到足以充滿佢哋所賭嘅世界。但我確實認為,如果妻子墮落,係丈夫嘅過錯:比如講佢哋疏忽咗責任,把我哋嘅財寶倒進外人嘅懷裡;或者爆發出古怪嘅嫉妒,對我哋加以限制。或者講佢哋打我哋,或惡意地削減我哋原有嘅嘢。咦,我哋都有脾氣;雖然我哋有些德行,但都有些報復心。讓丈夫哋知道佢哋嘅妻子同佢哋一樣有感覺:佢哋睇得見,聞得到,都有分辨甜酸嘅味覺,同丈夫一樣。佢哋用別嘅女人換掉我哋時,係喺做乜嘢?係消遣嗎?我想係。係感情引起嘅嗎?我想係。係軟弱導致咁樣嘅錯嗎?都係。難道我哋冇感情、貪玩嘅慾望同軟弱,像男人一樣嗎?嗰就讓佢哋好好對待我哋:否則讓佢哋知道,我哋做嘅壞事,係佢哋嘅壞事教我哋嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有,有十幾打;而且多到足以充滿她們所賭的世界。但我確實認為,如果妻子墮落,是丈夫的過錯:比如說他們疏忽了責任,把我們的財寶倒進外人的懷裡;或者爆發出古怪的嫉妒,對我們加以限制。或者說他們打我們,或惡意地削減我們原有的東西。咦,我們也有脾氣;雖然我們有些德行,但也有些報復心。讓丈夫們知道他們的妻子和他們一樣有感覺:她們看得見,聞得到,也有分辨甜酸的味覺,和丈夫一樣。他們用別的女人換掉我們時,是在做什麼?是消遣嗎?我想是。是感情引起的嗎?我想是。是軟弱導致這樣的錯嗎?也是。難道我們沒有感情、貪玩的慾望和軟弱,像男人一樣嗎?那就讓他們好好對待我們:否則讓他們知道,我們做的壞事,是他們的壞事教我們的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Good night, good night. Heaven me such usage send, Not to pick bad from bad, but by bad mend!
passages.vernacular: 晚安,晚安。願上天賜我咁樣嘅待遇:唔係從壞中選壞,而係借壞變好!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 晚安,晚安。願上天賜我這樣的待遇:不是從壞中選壞,而是借壞變好!

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene I — Cyprus. A Street 第五幕第一場:塞浦路斯街道

passages.original: Enter Iago and Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古同羅德利哥上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古和羅德利哥上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Here, stand behind this bulk. Straight will he come. Wear thy good rapier bare, and put it home. Quick, quick, fear nothing; I’ll be at thy elbow. It makes us, or it mars us, think on that, And fix most firm thy resolution.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,站喺呢個大塊頭後面。佢即刻就嚟。拔出你嘅好細劍,插進去。快,快,別怕;我就喺你身邊。呢決定我哋成敗,想想呢點,堅定你嘅決心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,站在這個大塊頭後面。他馬上就來。拔出你的好細劍,插進去。快,快,別怕;我就在你身邊。這決定我們成敗,想想這點,堅定你的決心。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Be near at hand, I may miscarry in ’t.
passages.vernacular: 靠近我,我可能失手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 靠近我,我可能失手。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Here, at thy hand. Be bold, and take thy stand.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度,喺你手邊。大膽些,站好位置。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡,在你手邊。大膽些,站好位置。

passages.original: [Retires to a little distance.]
passages.vernacular: [退到不遠處。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [退到不遠處。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I have no great devotion to the deed; And yet he hath given me satisfying reasons. ’Tis but a man gone. Forth, my sword; he dies.
passages.vernacular: 我對呢件事並不好熱心;然而佢畀咗我令人滿意嘅理由。不過係少咗一個人。出鞘吧,我嘅劍;佢要死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對這件事並不十分熱心;然而他給了我令人滿意的理由。不過是少了一個人。出鞘吧,我的劍;他要死了。

passages.original: [Goes to his stand.]
passages.vernacular: [走到自己嘅位置。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [走到自己的位置。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I have rubb’d this young quat almost to the sense, And he grows angry. Now, whether he kill Cassio, Or Cassio him, or each do kill the other, Every way makes my gain. Live Roderigo, He calls me to a restitution large Of gold and jewels that I bobb’d from him, As gifts to Desdemona. It must not be. If Cassio do remain, He hath a daily beauty in his life That makes me ugly. And besides, the Moor May unfold me to him; there stand I in much peril. No, he must die. But so, I hear him coming.
passages.vernacular: 我把呢個小傢伙擦到幾乎有感覺喇,佢發怒喇。而家,無論佢殺凱西奧,定係凱西奧殺佢,定係兩個互相殺死,點樣都對我有利。羅德利哥若活住,佢會要我歸還大量金子同珠寶,嗰個係我騙佢當作送畀戴絲德夢娜嘅禮物嘅。唔能夠讓咁樣。如果凱西奧活住,佢生活中有一種每日嘅美,使我顯得醜陋。而且,摩爾人可能向佢揭穿我;嗰樣我就處於極大危險中。不,佢必須死。就咁樣,我聽到佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我把這個小傢伙擦到幾乎有感覺了,他發怒了。現在,無論他殺凱西奧,還是凱西奧殺他,還是兩個互相殺死,怎麼樣都對我有利。羅德利哥若活著,他會要我歸還大量金子和珠寶,那是我騙他當作送給戴絲德夢娜的禮物的。不能讓這樣。如果凱西奧活著,他生活中有一種每日的美,使我顯得醜陋。而且,摩爾人可能向他揭穿我;那樣我就處於極大危險中。不,他必須死。就這樣,我聽到他來了。

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I know his gait; ’tis he. Villain, thou diest!
passages.vernacular: 我認得佢嘅步態;係佢。惡棍,你去死吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認得他的步態;是他。惡棍,你去死吧!

passages.original: [Rushes out, and makes a pass at Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [衝出,向凱西奧刺一劍。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [衝出,向凱西奧刺一劍。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: That thrust had been mine enemy indeed, But that my coat is better than thou know’st. I will make proof of thine.
passages.vernacular: 嗰一刺本來真係我嘅敵人,不過我嘅外衣比你知道嘅更好。我嚟試試你嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那一刺本來真是我的敵人,不過我的外衣比你知道的更好。我來試試你的。

passages.original: [Draws, and wounds Roderigo.]
passages.vernacular: [拔劍,刺傷羅德利哥。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [拔劍,刺傷羅德利哥。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, I am slain!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我被殺喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我被殺了!

passages.original: [Iago rushes from his post, cuts Cassio behind in the leg, and exit.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古從崗位衝出,從後面砍傷凱西奧嘅腿,然後下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古從崗位衝出,從後面砍傷凱西奧的腿,然後下。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I am maim’d forever. Help, ho! murder, murder!
passages.vernacular: 我永遠殘廢喇。救命,喂!謀殺,謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠殘廢了。救命,喂!謀殺,謀殺!

passages.original: [Falls.]
passages.vernacular: [倒下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [倒下。]

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The voice of Cassio. Iago keeps his word.
passages.vernacular: 係凱西奧嘅聲音。伊阿古信守諾言。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是凱西奧的聲音。伊阿古信守諾言。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, villain that I am!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我真係個惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我真是個惡棍!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: It is even so.
passages.vernacular: 確實如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實如此。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: O, help, ho! light! a surgeon!
passages.vernacular: 啊,救命,喂!光!外科醫生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,救命,喂!光!外科醫生!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: ’Tis he. O brave Iago, honest and just, That hast such noble sense of thy friend’s wrong! Thou teachest me,—minion, your dear lies dead, And your unbless’d fate hies. Strumpet, I come! Forth of my heart those charms, thine eyes, are blotted; Thy bed, lust-stain’d, shall with lust’s blood be spotted.
passages.vernacular: 係佢。啊勇敢嘅伊阿古,誠實而公正,對朋友所受嘅冤屈有如此高貴嘅感觸!你教我——寶貝,你嘅愛人死喇,你不蒙福嘅命運快嚟喇。娼婦,我嚟喇!你眼睛嘅魅力已從我心中抹去;你沾染淫慾嘅床,將被淫慾嘅血染汙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是他。啊勇敢的伊阿古,誠實而公正,對朋友所受的冤屈有如此高貴的感觸!你教我——寶貝,你的愛人死了,你不蒙福的命運快來了。娼婦,我來了!你眼睛的魅力已從我心中抹去;你沾染淫慾的床,將被淫慾的血染汙。

passages.original: [Exit.]
Enter Lodovico and Gratiano.
passages.vernacular: [洛多維科同格拉希安諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [洛多維科和格拉希安諾上。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What, ho! No watch? No passage? murder, murder!
passages.vernacular: 喂!冇守衛嗎?冇路人嗎?謀殺,謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂!沒有守衛嗎?沒有路人嗎?謀殺,謀殺!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: ’Tis some mischance; the cry is very direful.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢意外;喊聲好可怕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼意外;喊聲很可怕。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: O, help!
passages.vernacular: 啊,救命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,救命!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Hark!
passages.vernacular: 聽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O wretched villain!
passages.vernacular: 啊可憐嘅惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊可憐的惡棍!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Two or three groan. It is a heavy night. These may be counterfeits. Let’s think’t unsafe To come in to the cry without more help.
passages.vernacular: 有兩三個人喺呻吟。呢個係個沉重嘅夜。呢可能係假裝嘅。我哋別冒險,不增援就貿然走向喊聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有兩三個人在呻吟。這是個沉重的夜。這可能是假裝的。我們別冒險,不增援就貿然走向喊聲。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Nobody come? Then shall I bleed to death.
passages.vernacular: 冇人嚟嗎?嗰我會流血而死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒人來嗎?那我會流血而死。

passages.original: Enter Iago with a light.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古持燈上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古持燈上。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Hark!
passages.vernacular: 聽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Here’s one comes in his shirt, with light and weapons.
passages.vernacular: 有個人穿住襯衫嚟喇,帶住燈同武器。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有個人穿著襯衫來了,帶著燈和武器。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Who’s there? Whose noise is this that cries on murder?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺嗰度?係邊個喺喊謀殺?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?是誰在喊謀殺?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: We do not know.
passages.vernacular: 我哋唔知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不知道。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Did not you hear a cry?
passages.vernacular: 你哋冇聽到喊聲嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們沒聽到喊聲嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Here, here! for heaven’s sake, help me!
passages.vernacular: 呢度,呢度!睇喺天嘅份上,救我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡,這裡!看在天的份上,救我!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: This is Othello’s ancient, as I take it.
passages.vernacular: 我想呢個係奧賽羅嘅旗官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想這是奧賽羅的旗官。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: The same indeed, a very valiant fellow.
passages.vernacular: 正是,一個好勇敢嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是,一個很勇敢的人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What are you here that cry so grievously?
passages.vernacular: 你係邊個,喺呢度咁悲慘地叫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是誰,在這裡這麼悲慘地叫?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Iago? O, I am spoil’d, undone by villains! Give me some help.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古?啊,我被毀喇,被惡棍害喇!畀我些幫助。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古?啊,我被毀了,被惡棍害了!給我些幫助。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O me, lieutenant! What villains have done this?
passages.vernacular: 啊,副官!乜嘢惡棍幹嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,副官!什麼惡棍幹的?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I think that one of them is hereabout, And cannot make away.
passages.vernacular: 我想佢哋有一個喺附近,逃不掉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想他們有一個在附近,逃不掉。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O treacherous villains! [To Lodovico and Gratiano.] What are you there? Come in and give some help.
passages.vernacular: 啊,奸詐嘅惡棍![對洛多維科同格拉希安諾。]你哋係邊個?過嚟幫忙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,奸詐的惡棍![對洛多維科和格拉希安諾。]你們是誰?過來幫忙。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, help me here!
passages.vernacular: 啊,喺呢度幫我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,在這裡幫我!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: That’s one of them.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係佢哋中嘅一個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是他們中的一個。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O murderous slave! O villain!
passages.vernacular: 啊,殺人嘅奴才!啊,惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,殺人的奴才!啊,惡棍!

passages.original: [Stabs Roderigo.]
passages.vernacular: [刺羅德利哥。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺羅德利哥。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O damn’d Iago! O inhuman dog!
passages.vernacular: 啊,該死嘅伊阿古!啊,冇人性嘅狗!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,該死的伊阿古!啊,沒人性的狗!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Kill men i’ the dark! Where be these bloody thieves? How silent is this town! Ho! murder! murder! What may you be? Are you of good or evil?
passages.vernacular: 喺黑暗中殺人!呢啲血腥嘅賊喺邊度?呢座城幾咁安靜!喂!謀殺!謀殺!你哋係乜嘢人?係善係惡?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在黑暗中殺人!這些血腥的賊在哪裡?這座城多麼安靜!喂!謀殺!謀殺!你們是什麼人?是善是惡?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: As you shall prove us, praise us.
passages.vernacular: 你哋將點樣證明我哋,就點樣稱讚我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們將怎樣證明我們,就怎樣稱讚我們。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Signior Lodovico?
passages.vernacular: 洛多維科大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 洛多維科大人?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: He, sir.
passages.vernacular: 係我,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是我,先生。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I cry you mercy. Here’s Cassio hurt by villains.
passages.vernacular: 請原諒。呢個係凱西奧被惡棍所傷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請原諒。這是凱西奧被惡棍所傷。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How is’t, brother?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,兄弟?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,兄弟?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: My leg is cut in two.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅腿被砍成兩段。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的腿被砍成兩段。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Marry, heaven forbid! Light, gentlemen, I’ll bind it with my shirt.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,但願唔係!先生哋,攞燈嚟,我用我嘅襯衫包紮佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,但願不是!先生們,拿燈來,我用我的襯衫包紮它。

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: What is the matter, ho? Who is’t that cried?
passages.vernacular: 點回事,喂?係邊個喺喊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼回事,喂?是誰在喊?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Who is’t that cried?
passages.vernacular: 係邊個喺喊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是誰在喊?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: O my dear Cassio, my sweet Cassio! O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 啊我親愛嘅凱西奧,我甜美嘅凱西奧!啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我親愛的凱西奧,我甜美的凱西奧!啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O notable strumpet! Cassio, may you suspect Who they should be that have thus mangled you?
passages.vernacular: 啊,出名嘅娼婦!凱西奧,你能懷疑係邊個把你弄成咁樣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,出名的娼婦!凱西奧,你能懷疑是誰把你弄成這樣嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: No.
passages.vernacular: 唔能夠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不能。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: I am sorry to find you thus; I have been to seek you.
passages.vernacular: 睇到你咁樣我好難過;我一直喺找你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看到你這樣我很難過;我一直在找你。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lend me a garter. So.—O, for a chair, To bear him easily hence!
passages.vernacular: 借我一條襪帶。好。——啊,要一張椅子,輕輕把佢抬走!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 借我一條襪帶。好。——啊,要一張椅子,輕輕把他抬走!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Alas, he faints! O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,佢昏過去喇!啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,他昏過去了!啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Gentlemen all, I do suspect this trash To be a party in this injury. Patience awhile, good Cassio. Come, come; Lend me a light. Know we this face or no? Alas, my friend and my dear countryman Roderigo? No. Yes, sure; O heaven! Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: 各位先生,我懷疑呢垃圾都參與咗呢次傷害。耐心一會兒,好凱西奧。嚟,嚟;借我一盞燈。我哋認得呢張臉嗎?哎呀,我嘅朋友同親愛嘅同鄉羅德利哥?不。係,肯定;啊天啊!羅德利哥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 各位先生,我懷疑這垃圾也參與了這次傷害。耐心一會兒,好凱西奧。來,來;借我一盞燈。我們認得這張臉嗎?哎呀,我的朋友和親愛的同鄉羅德利哥?不。是,肯定;啊天啊!羅德利哥。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: What, of Venice?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,威尼斯嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,威尼斯的?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Even he, sir. Did you know him?
passages.vernacular: 正是佢,先生。你認識佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是他,先生。你認識他?

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Know him? Ay.
passages.vernacular: 認識佢?係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 認識他?是。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Signior Gratiano? I cry you gentle pardon. These bloody accidents must excuse my manners, That so neglected you.
passages.vernacular: 格拉希安諾大人?請原諒。呢啲血腥嘅事故必須原諒我嘅失禮,竟怠慢咗您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 格拉希安諾大人?請原諒。這些血腥的事故必須原諒我的失禮,竟怠慢了您。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: I am glad to see you.
passages.vernacular: 見到你我好高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 見到你我很高興。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How do you, Cassio? O, a chair, a chair!
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,凱西奧?啊,一張椅子,一張椅子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎樣,凱西奧?啊,一張椅子,一張椅子!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Roderigo!
passages.vernacular: 羅德利哥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅德利哥!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He, he, ’tis he.
passages.vernacular: 係佢,係佢,係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是他,是他,是他。

passages.original: [A chair brought in.]
passages.vernacular: [抬進一張椅子。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [抬進一張椅子。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, that’s well said; the chair. Some good man bear him carefully from hence, I’ll fetch the general’s surgeon. [To Bianca] For you, mistress, Save you your labour. He that lies slain here, Cassio, Was my dear friend. What malice was between you?
passages.vernacular: 啊,講得好;椅子。請邊位好心人小心地把佢抬走,我去叫將軍嘅外科醫生。[對比安卡]至於你,夫人,唔使白費力氣。躺喺呢度被殺嘅人,凱西奧,係我親愛嘅朋友。你哋之間有乜嘢怨恨?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,說得好;椅子。請哪位好心人小心地把他抬走,我去叫將軍的外科醫生。[對比安卡]至於你,夫人,不用白費力氣。躺在這裡被殺的人,凱西奧,是我親愛的朋友。你們之間有什麼怨恨?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: None in the world. Nor do I know the man.
passages.vernacular: 世上啲都冇。我都不認識呢個人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世上一點也沒有。我也不認識這個人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: [To Bianca.] What, look you pale?—O, bear him out o’ the air.
passages.vernacular: [對比安卡。]點,你臉色蒼白?——啊,把佢抬出去呼吸新鮮空氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對比安卡。]怎麼,你臉色蒼白?——啊,把他抬出去呼吸新鮮空氣。

passages.original: [Cassio and Roderigo are borne off.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧同羅德利哥被抬走。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧和羅德利哥被抬走。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Stay you, good gentlemen.—Look you pale, mistress? Do you perceive the gastness of her eye? Nay, if you stare, we shall hear more anon. Behold her well. I pray you, look upon her. Do you see, gentlemen? Nay, guiltiness will speak Though tongues were out of use.
passages.vernacular: 留下,好先生哋。——夫人,你臉色蒼白?你哋注意到佢眼神嘅驚恐咗嗎?不,如果你瞪眼,我哋好快就會聽到更多。好好睇佢。請你哋睇睇佢。你哋睇到咗嗎,先生哋?不,罪疚會講話,即使舌頭唔能夠用。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 留下,好先生們。——夫人,你臉色蒼白?你們注意到她眼神的驚恐了嗎?不,如果你瞪眼,我們很快就會聽到更多。好好看她。請你們看看她。你們看到了嗎,先生們?不,罪疚會說話,即使舌頭不能用。

passages.original: Enter Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Las, what’s the matter? What’s the matter, husband?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,點回事?點回事,丈夫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,怎麼回事?怎麼回事,丈夫?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Cassio hath here been set on in the dark By Roderigo, and fellows that are ’scap’d. He’s almost slain, and Roderigo dead.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧喺黑暗中被羅德利哥同逃掉嘅同夥襲擊喇。佢幾乎被殺,羅德利哥死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧在黑暗中被羅德利哥和逃掉的同夥襲擊了。他幾乎被殺,羅德利哥死了。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, good gentleman! alas, good Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,好先生!哎呀,好凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,好先生!哎呀,好凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: This is the fruit of whoring. Prithee, Emilia, Go know of Cassio where he supp’d tonight. What, do you shake at that?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係嫖娼嘅果實。請你,愛米利亞,去問凱西奧今晚喺邊度食晚飯。乜嘢,你為呢個發抖?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是嫖娼的果實。請你,愛米利亞,去問凱西奧今晚在哪裡吃晚飯。什麼,你為這個發抖?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: He supp’d at my house, but I therefore shake not.
passages.vernacular: 佢喺我家食晚飯,但我並不因此發抖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在我家吃晚飯,但我並不因此發抖。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, did he so? I charge you go with me.
passages.vernacular: 啊,係嗎?我命令你跟我走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,是嗎?我命令你跟我走。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Fie, fie upon thee, strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 呸,呸你,娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,呸你,娼婦!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: I am no strumpet, but of life as honest As you that thus abuse me.
passages.vernacular: 我唔係娼婦,我嘅品行跟你咁樣辱罵我嘅人一樣誠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不是娼婦,我的品行跟你這樣辱罵我的人一樣誠實。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: As I? Foh! fie upon thee!
passages.vernacular: 像我一樣?呸!呸你!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 像我一樣?呸!呸你!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Kind gentlemen, let’s go see poor Cassio dress’d. Come, mistress, you must tell’s another tale. Emilia, run you to the citadel, And tell my lord and lady what hath happ’d. Will you go on afore? [Aside.] This is the night That either makes me or fordoes me quite.
passages.vernacular: 好先生哋,我哋去睇睇可憐嘅凱西奧包紮。嚟,夫人,你必須講另一個故事。愛米利亞,你跑去城堡,告訴大人同夫人發生咗乜嘢事。你哋肯先走嗎?[旁白。]今夜要麼成就我,要麼徹底毀掉我。
