passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生們,我們去看看可憐的凱西奧包紮。來,夫人,你必須講另一個故事。愛米利亞,你跑去城堡,告訴大人和夫人發生了什麼事。你們肯先走嗎?[旁白。]今夜要麼成就我,要麼徹底毀掉我。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene II — Cyprus. A Bedchamber in the Castle 第五幕第二場:塞浦路斯城堡寢室

passages.original: Desdemona in bed asleep; a light burning.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜瞓喺床上;一盞燈亮住。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜睡在床上;一盞燈亮著。]

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: It is the cause, it is the cause, my soul, Let me not name it to you, you chaste stars! It is the cause. Yet I’ll not shed her blood, Nor scar that whiter skin of hers than snow, And smooth as monumental alabaster. Yet she must die, else she’ll betray more men. Put out the light, and then put out the light: If I quench thee, thou flaming minister, I can again thy former light restore, Should I repent me. But once put out thy light, Thou cunning’st pattern of excelling nature, I know not where is that Promethean heat That can thy light relume. When I have pluck’d thy rose, I cannot give it vital growth again, It must needs wither. I’ll smell it on the tree.
passages.vernacular: 就係呢個緣由,就係呢個緣由,我嘅靈魂,貞潔嘅星辰啊,唔好畀我向你哋講出佢嘅名字!就係呢個緣由。然而我唔會流佢嘅血,都唔會傷佢嗰比雪更白、像墓碑雪花石膏般光滑嘅皮膚。然而佢必須死,否則佢會背叛更多男人。熄滅燈,然後熄滅嗰盞燈:如果我熄滅你,你呢燃燒嘅僕人,我若後悔,仲能重新恢復你從前嘅光。但一旦熄滅你嘅光,你呢造化最精巧嘅傑作,我唔知道邊度有能重燃你光嘅普羅米修斯之火。當我摘下你嘅玫瑰,我就唔能夠再賦予佢生命嘅成長,佢必定枯萎。我要喺樹上嗅佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是這個緣由,就是這個緣由,我的靈魂,貞潔的星辰啊,別讓我向你們說出它的名字!就是這個緣由。然而我不會流她的血,也不會傷她那比雪更白、像墓碑雪花石膏般光滑的皮膚。然而她必須死,否則她會背叛更多男人。熄滅燈,然後熄滅那盞燈:如果我熄滅你,你這燃燒的僕人,我若後悔,還能重新恢復你從前的光。但一旦熄滅你的光,你這造化最精巧的傑作,我不知道哪裡有能重燃你光的普羅米修斯之火。當我摘下你的玫瑰,我就不能再賦予它生命的成長,它必定枯萎。我要在樹上嗅它。

passages.original: [Kissing her.]
passages.vernacular: [吻佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [吻她。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, balmy breath, that dost almost persuade Justice to break her sword! One more, one more. Be thus when thou art dead, and I will kill thee, And love thee after. One more, and this the last. So sweet was ne’er so fatal. I must weep, But they are cruel tears. This sorrow’s heavenly, It strikes where it doth love. She wakes.
passages.vernacular: 啊,芬芳嘅氣息,幾乎講服正義折斷佢嘅劍!再一個,再一個。你死後都咁樣,我會殺你,然後愛你。再一個,呢個係最後一個。從未有過如此甜美卻如此致命。我必須哭泣,但呢個係殘酷嘅眼淚。呢悲傷係神聖嘅,佢打擊佢所愛嘅。佢醒喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,芬芳的氣息,幾乎說服正義折斷她的劍!再一個,再一個。你死後也這樣,我會殺你,然後愛你。再一個,這是最後一個。從未有過如此甜美卻如此致命。我必須哭泣,但這是殘酷的眼淚。這悲傷是神聖的,它打擊它所愛的。她醒了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Who’s there? Othello?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺嗰度?奧賽羅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?奧賽羅?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, Desdemona.
passages.vernacular: 係,戴絲德夢娜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,戴絲德夢娜。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Will you come to bed, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 你要嚟瞓嗎,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要來睡嗎,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Have you pray’d tonight, Desdemona?
passages.vernacular: 你今晚祈禱咗嗎,戴絲德夢娜?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你今晚祈禱了嗎,戴絲德夢娜?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Ay, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 祈禱喇,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 祈禱了,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: If you bethink yourself of any crime Unreconcil’d as yet to heaven and grace, Solicit for it straight.
passages.vernacular: 如果你想起任何尚未同天同恩典和解嘅罪,即刻去懇求。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你想起任何尚未與天和恩典和解的罪,立刻去懇求。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alack, my lord, what may you mean by that?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,大人,您呢話係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,大人,您這話是什麼意思?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Well, do it, and be brief, I will walk by. I would not kill thy unprepared spirit, No, heaven forfend! I would not kill thy soul.
passages.vernacular: 好,去做,簡短些,我喺旁邊走走。我唔願殺你冇準備嘅靈魂,不,天不許!我唔願殺你嘅靈魂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,去做,簡短些,我在旁邊走走。我不願殺你沒有準備的靈魂,不,天不許!我不願殺你的靈魂。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Talk you of killing?
passages.vernacular: 你講殺人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說殺人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, I do.
passages.vernacular: 係,我講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我說。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Then heaven have mercy on me!
passages.vernacular: 咁願上天憐憫我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼願上天憐憫我!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Amen, with all my heart!
passages.vernacular: 阿哋,衷心!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 阿們,衷心!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: If you say so, I hope you will not kill me.
passages.vernacular: 如果您咁樣講,我希望您唔會殺我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您這樣說,我希望您不會殺我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Hum!
passages.vernacular: 哼!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哼!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: And yet I fear you, for you are fatal then When your eyes roll so: why I should fear I know not, Since guiltiness I know not, but yet I feel I fear.
passages.vernacular: 然而我怕您,因為您眼睛咁樣轉動時,係致命嘅:我點解怕,我唔知道,因為我唔知道自己有乜嘢罪,可我感到我怕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而我怕您,因為您眼睛這樣轉動時,是致命的:我為什麼怕,我不知道,因為我不知道自己有什麼罪,可我感到我怕。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Think on thy sins.
passages.vernacular: 想想你嘅罪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想想你的罪。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: They are loves I bear to you.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋係我對您嘅愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它們是我對您的愛。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, and for that thou diest.
passages.vernacular: 係,為了嗰個你要死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,為了那個你要死。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: That death’s unnatural that kills for loving. Alas, why gnaw you so your nether lip? Some bloody passion shakes your very frame. These are portents; but yet I hope, I hope, They do not point on me.
passages.vernacular: 嗰樣嘅死不自然,因愛而殺人。哎呀,您點解咁樣咬下唇?某種血腥嘅激情震撼您整個身軀。呢啲係預兆;但我希望,我希望,佢哋唔係指向我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那樣的死不自然,因愛而殺人。哎呀,您為什麼這樣咬下唇?某種血腥的激情震撼您整個身軀。這些是預兆;但我希望,我希望,它們不是指向我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Peace, and be still!
passages.vernacular: 安靜,別動!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安靜,別動!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will so. What’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 我會嘅。點喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會的。怎麼了?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That handkerchief which I so loved and gave thee, Thou gav’st to Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 嗰條我咁愛、送畀你嘅手帕,你畀咗凱西奧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那條我那麼愛、送給你的手帕,你給了凱西奧。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, by my life and soul! Send for the man and ask him.
passages.vernacular: 不,憑我嘅生命同靈魂!派人去叫嗰人嚟問佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,憑我的生命和靈魂!派人去叫那人來問他。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Sweet soul, take heed, take heed of perjury, Thou’rt on thy death-bed.
passages.vernacular: 甜美嘅靈魂,當心,當心偽誓,你喺臨終之床上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 甜美的靈魂,當心,當心偽誓,你在臨終之床上。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Ay, but not yet to die.
passages.vernacular: 係,但仲唔到死嘅時候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,但還不到死的時候。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Yes, presently: Therefore confess thee freely of thy sin. For to deny each article with oath Cannot remove nor choke the strong conception That I do groan withal. Thou art to die.
passages.vernacular: 對,即刻:所以自由地懺悔你嘅罪。因為即使用誓言否認每一條,都唔能夠消除或扼殺我為之呻吟嘅強烈信念。你要死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,馬上:所以自由地懺悔你的罪。因為即使用誓言否認每一條,也不能消除或扼殺我為之呻吟的強烈信念。你要死了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Then, Lord have mercy on me!
passages.vernacular: 咁,主啊,憐憫我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,主啊,憐憫我!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I say, amen.
passages.vernacular: 我講,阿哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說,阿們。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: And have you mercy too! I never did Offend you in my life, never lov’d Cassio But with such general warranty of heaven As I might love. I never gave him token.
passages.vernacular: 願你都得到憐憫!我一生從未冒犯您,從未愛過凱西奧,除咗上天允許嘅一般嘅愛。我從未畀佢信物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願你也得到憐憫!我一生從未冒犯您,從未愛過凱西奧,除了上天允許的一般的愛。我從未給他信物。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, I saw my handkerchief in ’s hand. O perjur’d woman, thou dost stone my heart, And mak’st me call what I intend to do A murder, which I thought a sacrifice. I saw the handkerchief.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,我睇見我嘅手帕喺佢手裡。啊,背誓嘅女人,你使我嘅心變成石頭,使我把我想做嘅稱為謀殺,而我原以為係獻祭。我睇見咗手帕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,我看見我的手帕在他手裡。啊,背誓的女人,你使我的心變成石頭,使我把我想做的稱為謀殺,而我原以為是獻祭。我看見了手帕。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He found it then. I never gave it him. Send for him hither. Let him confess a truth.
passages.vernacular: 嗰佢係撿到嘅。我從未畀佢。派人叫佢嚟呢度。讓佢講出實話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那他是撿到的。我從未給他。派人叫他來這裡。讓他說出實話。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: He hath confess’d.
passages.vernacular: 佢已經招認喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他已經招認了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That he hath us’d thee.
passages.vernacular: 佢已經占有咗你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他已經占有了你。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: How? Unlawfully?
passages.vernacular: 點?不正當地?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼?不正當地?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay.
passages.vernacular: 係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He will not say so.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔會咁樣講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不會這樣說。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: No, his mouth is stopp’d. Honest Iago hath ta’en order for ’t.
passages.vernacular: 不,佢嘅嘴被封住喇。誠實嘅伊阿古已作咗安排。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,他的嘴被封住了。誠實的伊阿古已作了安排。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: O, my fear interprets! What, is he dead?
passages.vernacular: 啊,我嘅恐懼喺解釋!乜嘢,佢死喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我的恐懼在解釋!什麼,他死了?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Had all his hairs been lives, my great revenge Had stomach for them all.
passages.vernacular: 就算佢嘅每一根頭髮都係一條命,我嘅大復仇都吞得下佢哋全部。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就算他的每一根頭髮都是一條命,我的大復仇也吞得下它們全部。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, he is betray’d, and I undone!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,佢被出賣喇,我完喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,他被出賣了,我完了!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Out, strumpet! Weep’st thou for him to my face?
passages.vernacular: 滾,娼婦!你當住我嘅面為佢哭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾,娼婦!你當著我的面為他哭?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: O, banish me, my lord, but kill me not!
passages.vernacular: 啊,放逐我吧,大人,但別殺我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,放逐我吧,大人,但別殺我!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Down, strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 倒下,娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 倒下,娼婦!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Kill me tomorrow, let me live tonight!
passages.vernacular: 聽日殺我,讓我今晚活住!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 明天殺我,讓我今晚活著!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, if you strive,—
passages.vernacular: 不,如果你掙扎——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,如果你掙扎——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: But half an hour!
passages.vernacular: 只要半小時!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要半小時!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Being done, there is no pause.
passages.vernacular: 一旦動手,就唔再停頓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一旦動手,就不再停頓。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: But while I say one prayer!
passages.vernacular: 只要讓我講一句禱告!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要讓我說一句禱告!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: It is too late.
passages.vernacular: 太遲喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 太遲了。

passages.original: [Smothers her.]
passages.vernacular: [悶死佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [悶死她。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: [Within.] My lord, my lord! what, ho! my lord, my lord!
passages.vernacular: [內。]大人,大人!喂!大人,大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]大人,大人!喂!大人,大人!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What noise is this? Not dead? Not yet quite dead? I that am cruel am yet merciful, I would not have thee linger in thy pain. So, so.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢聲音?冇死?仲冇完全死?我雖殘酷,卻仍然仁慈,我唔願你喺痛苦中拖延。咁樣,咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼聲音?沒死?還沒完全死?我雖殘酷,卻仍然仁慈,我不願你在痛苦中拖延。這樣,這樣。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: [Within.] What, ho! my lord, my lord!
passages.vernacular: [內。]喂!大人,大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]喂!大人,大人!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Who’s there?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺嗰度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: [Within.] O, good my lord, I would speak a word with you!
passages.vernacular: [內。]啊,好大人,我想同您講句話!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]啊,好大人,我想和您說句話!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Yes. ’Tis Emilia, by and by. She’s dead. ’Tis like she comes to speak of Cassio’s death; The noise was high.—Ha! no more moving? Still as the grave. Shall she come in? Were’t good? I think she stirs again; no. What’s best to do? If she come in, she’ll sure speak to my wife. My wife! my wife! what wife? I have no wife. O, insupportable! O heavy hour! Methinks it should be now a huge eclipse Of sun and moon, and that the affrighted globe Should yawn at alteration.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅。係愛米利亞,等一下。佢死喇。佢多半係來講凱西奧之死嘅;聲音好大。——哈!不動喇?靜如墳墓。要讓佢進嚟嗎?咁樣好嗎?我想佢又動喇;不。點做最好?如果佢進嚟,一定會對我妻子講話。我妻子!我妻子!乜嘢妻子?我冇妻子。啊,無法忍受!啊,沉重嘅時刻!我覺得而家應該有一場巨大嘅日月蝕,驚恐嘅地球應該對呢變化張開大口。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的。是愛米利亞,等一下。她死了。她多半是來說凱西奧之死的;聲音很大。——哈!不動了?靜如墳墓。要讓她進來嗎?這樣好嗎?我想她又動了;不。怎麼做最好?如果她進來,一定會對我妻子說話。我妻子!我妻子!什麼妻子?我沒有妻子。啊,無法忍受!啊,沉重的時刻!我覺得現在應該有一場巨大的日月蝕,驚恐的地球應該對這變化張開大口。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: [Within.] I do beseech you That I may speak with you, O, good my lord!
passages.vernacular: [內。]我懇求您讓我跟您講話,啊,好大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]我懇求您讓我跟您說話,啊,好大人!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I had forgot thee: O, come in, Emilia. Soft, by and by; let me the curtains draw. Where art thou?
passages.vernacular: 我忘咗你:啊,進嚟吧,愛米利亞。等一下,即刻;讓我把帳子拉上。你喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我忘了你:啊,進來吧,愛米利亞。等一下,馬上;讓我把帳子拉上。你在哪裡?

passages.original: [Unlocks the door.]
passages.vernacular: [開門鎖。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [開門鎖。]

passages.original: Enter Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What’s the matter with thee now?
passages.vernacular: 你而家有乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在有什麼事?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, my good lord, yonder’s foul murders done!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我嘅好大人,嗰邊發生咗可怕嘅謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我的好大人,那邊發生了可怕的謀殺!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What, now?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,而家?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,現在?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But now, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 就喺頭先,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就在剛才,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: It is the very error of the moon, She comes more nearer earth than she was wont And makes men mad.
passages.vernacular: 呢正是月亮嘅錯亂,佢比平常更靠近地球,使人發瘋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這正是月亮的錯亂,她比平常更靠近地球,使人發瘋。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Cassio, my lord, hath kill’d a young Venetian Call’d Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧,大人,殺咗一個叫羅德利哥嘅年輕威尼斯人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧,大人,殺了一個叫羅德利哥的年輕威尼斯人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Roderigo kill’d? And Cassio kill’d?
passages.vernacular: 羅德利哥被殺喇?凱西奧都被殺喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅德利哥被殺了?凱西奧也被殺了?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: No, Cassio is not kill’d.
passages.vernacular: 不,凱西奧冇被殺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,凱西奧沒被殺。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Not Cassio kill’d! Then murder’s out of tune, And sweet revenge grows harsh.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧冇被殺!咁謀殺走調喇,甜美嘅復仇變得刺耳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧沒被殺!那麼謀殺走調了,甜美的復仇變得刺耳。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: O, falsely, falsely murder’d!
passages.vernacular: 啊,冤枉地,冤枉地被殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,冤枉地,冤枉地被殺!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, what cry is that?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,嗰個係乜嘢喊聲?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,那是什麼喊聲?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That? What?
passages.vernacular: 嗰?乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那?什麼?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Out, and alas! That was my lady’s voice. Help! help, ho! help! O lady, speak again, Sweet Desdemona! O sweet mistress, speak!
passages.vernacular: 啊,哎呀!嗰個係我夫人嘅聲音。救命!救命,喂!救命!啊夫人,再講一次話,甜美嘅戴絲德夢娜!啊甜美嘅夫人,講話!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,哎呀!那是我夫人的聲音。救命!救命,喂!救命!啊夫人,再說一次話,甜美的戴絲德夢娜!啊甜美的夫人,說話!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: A guiltless death I die.
passages.vernacular: 我無罪而死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我無罪而死。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, who hath done this deed?
passages.vernacular: 啊,係邊個幹嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,是誰幹的?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Nobody; I myself. Farewell. Commend me to my kind lord. O, farewell!
passages.vernacular: 冇人;係我自己。再見。替我向我仁慈嘅大人問候。啊,再見!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有人;是我自己。再見。替我向我仁慈的大人問候。啊,再見!

passages.original: [She dies.]
passages.vernacular: [佢死。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [她死。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why, how should she be murder’d?
passages.vernacular: 咦,佢點會被謀殺?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,她怎麼會被謀殺?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, who knows?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,邊個知道?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,誰知道?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: You heard her say herself, it was not I.
passages.vernacular: 你聽到佢自己講嘅,唔係我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽到她自己說的,不是我。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: She said so. I must needs report the truth.
passages.vernacular: 佢係咁樣講嘅。我唔得不報告真相。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她是這樣說的。我不得不報告真相。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She’s like a liar, gone to burning hell. ’Twas I that kill’d her.
passages.vernacular: 佢像個講謊嘅人,下咗燃燒嘅地獄。係我殺咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她像個說謊的人,下了燃燒的地獄。是我殺了她。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, the more angel she, And you the blacker devil!
passages.vernacular: 啊,佢越像天使,你越像黑色嘅魔鬼!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,她越像天使,你越像黑色的魔鬼!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She turn’d to folly, and she was a whore.
passages.vernacular: 佢轉向愚行,佢係個娼婦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她轉向愚行,她是個娼婦。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Thou dost belie her, and thou art a devil.
passages.vernacular: 你誣衊佢,你係個魔鬼。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你誣衊她,你是個魔鬼。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She was false as water.
passages.vernacular: 佢像水一樣虛假。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她像水一樣虛假。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Thou art rash as fire, to say That she was false: O, she was heavenly true!
passages.vernacular: 你像火一樣魯莽,竟講佢虛假:啊,佢天使般忠貞!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你像火一樣魯莽,竟說她虛假:啊,她天使般忠貞!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Cassio did top her; ask thy husband else. O, I were damn’d beneath all depth in hell, But that I did proceed upon just grounds To this extremity. Thy husband knew it all.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧騎咗佢;不信去問你丈夫。啊,我該被詛咒到地獄最深處,如果我唔係有正當理由才走到呢極端。你丈夫全知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧騎了她;不信去問你丈夫。啊,我該被詛咒到地獄最深處,如果我不是有正當理由才走到這極端。你丈夫全知道。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: My husband?
passages.vernacular: 我丈夫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我丈夫?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Thy husband.
passages.vernacular: 你丈夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你丈夫。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: That she was false to wedlock?
passages.vernacular: 講佢對婚姻不忠?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說她對婚姻不忠?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, with Cassio. Nay, had she been true, If heaven would make me such another world Of one entire and perfect chrysolite, I’d not have sold her for it.
passages.vernacular: 係,同凱西奧。不,如果佢係忠貞嘅,即使上天為我造另一個完整完美嘅黃玉世界,我都唔會用佢去換。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,與凱西奧。不,如果她是忠貞的,即使上天為我造另一個完整完美的黃玉世界,我也不會用她去換。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: My husband?
passages.vernacular: 我丈夫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我丈夫?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, ’twas he that told me first. An honest man he is, and hates the slime That sticks on filthy deeds.
passages.vernacular: 係,係佢最先告訴我嘅。佢係個誠實嘅人,憎恨黏附喺骯髒行為上嘅污穢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,是他最先告訴我的。他是個誠實的人,憎恨黏附在骯髒行為上的污穢。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: My husband?
passages.vernacular: 我丈夫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我丈夫?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What needs this iterance, woman? I say thy husband.
passages.vernacular: 何必重複,女人?我講你丈夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 何必重複,女人?我說你丈夫。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O mistress, villainy hath made mocks with love! My husband say that she was false?
passages.vernacular: 啊夫人,奸惡竟攞愛嚟嘲弄!我丈夫講佢不貞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊夫人,奸惡竟拿愛來嘲弄!我丈夫說她不貞?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: He, woman; I say thy husband: dost understand the word? My friend, thy husband, honest, honest Iago.
passages.vernacular: 佢,女人;我講你丈夫:你懂呢個詞嗎?我嘅朋友,你丈夫,誠實嘅,誠實嘅伊阿古。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他,女人;我說你丈夫:你懂這個詞嗎?我的朋友,你丈夫,誠實的,誠實的伊阿古。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: If he say so, may his pernicious soul Rot half a grain a day! he lies to the heart. She was too fond of her most filthy bargain.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢咁樣講,願佢邪惡嘅靈魂每日腐爛半粒!佢講謊講到心底。佢太迷戀佢最骯髒嘅交易。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他這樣說,願他邪惡的靈魂每日腐爛半粒!他說謊說到心底。她太迷戀她最骯髒的交易。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ha!
passages.vernacular: 哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Do thy worst: This deed of thine is no more worthy heaven Than thou wast worthy her.
passages.vernacular: 你儘管做最壞嘅吧:你呢件行為配不上天堂,就像你配不上佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你儘管做最壞的吧:你這件行為配不上天堂,就像你配不上她。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Peace, you were best.
passages.vernacular: 住嘴,你最好閉嘴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 住嘴,你最好閉嘴。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Thou hast not half that power to do me harm As I have to be hurt. O gull! O dolt! As ignorant as dirt! Thou hast done a deed (I care not for thy sword) I’ll make thee known, Though I lost twenty lives. Help! help, ho! help! The Moor hath kill’d my mistress! Murder, murder!
passages.vernacular: 你傷害我嘅力量,仲不及我受傷嘅能力嘅一半。啊傻瓜!啊笨蛋!像泥土一樣無知!你做咗一件事(我不怕你嘅劍),我要揭發你,即使我要丟二十條命。救命!救命,喂!救命!摩爾人殺咗我嘅夫人!謀殺,謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你傷害我的力量,還不及我受傷的能力的一半。啊傻瓜!啊笨蛋!像泥土一樣無知!你做了一件事(我不怕你的劍),我要揭發你,即使我要丟二十條命。救命!救命,喂!救命!摩爾人殺了我的夫人!謀殺,謀殺!

passages.original: Enter Montano, Gratiano and Iago.
passages.vernacular: [蒙塔諾、格拉希安諾同伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [蒙塔諾、格拉希安諾和伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Montano 蒙塔諾
passages.original: What is the matter? How now, general?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?點喇,將軍?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?怎麼了,將軍?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, are you come, Iago? You have done well, That men must lay their murders on your neck.
passages.vernacular: 啊,你嚟喇,伊阿古?你做得好,竟讓人把佢哋嘅謀殺都推到你脖子上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你來了,伊阿古?你做得好,竟讓人把他們的謀殺都推到你脖子上。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: What is the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Disprove this villain, if thou be’st a man. He says thou told’st him that his wife was false. I know thou didst not, thou’rt not such a villain. Speak, for my heart is full.
passages.vernacular: 駁倒呢個惡棍,如果你係男人。佢講你告訴佢佢妻子不貞。我知道你冇,你唔係咁樣嘅惡棍。講吧,我嘅心脹滿喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 駁倒這個惡棍,如果你是男人。他說你告訴他他妻子不貞。我知道你沒有,你不是這樣的惡棍。說吧,我的心脹滿了。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I told him what I thought, and told no more Than what he found himself was apt and true.
passages.vernacular: 我告訴佢我所想嘅,所講嘅不多於佢自己發現嘅合理真實嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我告訴他我所想的,所說的不多於他自己發現的合理真實的。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But did you ever tell him she was false?
passages.vernacular: 但你有冇告訴佢佢不貞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你有沒有告訴他她不貞?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I did.
passages.vernacular: 有。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: You told a lie, an odious, damned lie; Upon my soul, a lie; a wicked lie. She false with Cassio? Did you say with Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 你撒咗謊,一個可憎、該死嘅謊;憑我嘅靈魂,係謊言;邪惡嘅謊言。佢同凱西奧不貞?你講係同凱西奧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你撒了謊,一個可憎、該死的謊;憑我的靈魂,是謊言;邪惡的謊言。她與凱西奧不貞?你說是與凱西奧?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: With Cassio, mistress. Go to, charm your tongue.
passages.vernacular: 同凱西奧,夫人。得喇,管住你嘅舌頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與凱西奧,夫人。得了,管住你的舌頭。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I will not charm my tongue; I am bound to speak. My mistress here lies murder’d in her bed.
passages.vernacular: 我不管住我嘅舌頭;我有責任講話。我嘅夫人躺喺呢度,喺佢床上被謀殺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不管住我的舌頭;我有責任說話。我的夫人躺在這裡,在她床上被謀殺了。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: O heavens forfend!
passages.vernacular: 啊天啊,唔會吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊天啊,不會吧!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: And your reports have set the murder on.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅報告煽動咗呢次謀殺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的報告煽動了這次謀殺。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, stare not, masters, it is true indeed.
passages.vernacular: 不,別瞪眼,各位,呢確實係真嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,別瞪眼,各位,這確實是真的。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: ’Tis a strange truth.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係奇怪嘅真相。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是奇怪的真相。

passages.title: Montano 蒙塔諾
passages.original: O monstrous act!
passages.vernacular: 啊,荒唐嘅行為!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,荒唐的行為!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Villany, villany, villany! I think upon’t, I think I smell’t; O villany! I thought so then. I’ll kill myself for grief. O villany, villany!
passages.vernacular: 奸惡,奸惡,奸惡!我想起嚟喇,我聞到喇;啊奸惡!我當時就咁樣想。我要因悲痛自殺。啊奸惡,奸惡!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奸惡,奸惡,奸惡!我想起來了,我聞到了;啊奸惡!我當時就這樣想。我要因悲痛自殺。啊奸惡,奸惡!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What, are you mad? I charge you, get you home.
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,你瘋喇?我命令你,回家去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,你瘋了?我命令你,回家去。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Good gentlemen, let me have leave to speak. ’Tis proper I obey him, but not now. Perchance, Iago, I will ne’er go home.
passages.vernacular: 好先生哋,讓我講話。我應該服從佢,但而家不。或者,伊阿古,我永遠不回家喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生們,讓我說話。我應該服從他,但現在不。也許,伊阿古,我永遠不回家了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O! O! O!
passages.vernacular: 啊!啊!啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊!啊!啊!

passages.original: [Hanging over his wife.]
passages.vernacular: [伏喺妻子身上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伏在妻子身上。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Nay, lay thee down and roar; For thou hast kill’d the sweetest innocent That e’er did lift up eye.
passages.vernacular: 不,躺下去吼叫吧;因為你殺咗舉目所見最甜美嘅無辜者。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,躺下去吼叫吧;因為你殺了舉目所見最甜美的無辜者。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Rising.] O, she was foul! I scarce did know you, uncle, there lies your niece, Whose breath indeed these hands have newly stopp’d. I know this act shows horrible and grim.
passages.vernacular: [起身。]啊,佢係骯髒嘅!我幾乎認不出你,叔叔,你嘅姪女躺喺嗰度,佢嘅呼吸確實剛被呢雙手止住。我知道呢行為顯得可怕而陰森。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [起身。]啊,她是骯髒的!我幾乎認不出你,叔叔,你的姪女躺在那裡,她的呼吸確實剛被這雙手止住。我知道這行為顯得可怕而陰森。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Poor Desdemona! I am glad thy father’s dead. Thy match was mortal to him, and pure grief Shore his old thread in twain: did he live now, This sight would make him do a desperate turn, Yea, curse his better angel from his side, And fall to reprobance.
passages.vernacular: 可憐嘅戴絲德夢娜!我好高興你父親死喇。你嘅婚事對佢係致命嘅,純粹嘅悲痛剪斷咗佢嘅老線:佢而家若活住,呢景象會使佢做出絕望嘅事,係啊,詛咒佢身邊嘅好天使,墮入沉淪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可憐的戴絲德夢娜!我很高興你父親死了。你的婚事對他是致命的,純粹的悲痛剪斷了他的老線:他現在若活著,這景象會使他做出絕望的事,是啊,詛咒他身邊的好天使,墮入沉淪。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: ’Tis pitiful. But yet Iago knows That she with Cassio hath the act of shame A thousand times committed; Cassio confess’d it, And she did gratify his amorous works With that recognizance and pledge of love Which I first gave her; I saw it in his hand. It was a handkerchief, an antique token My father gave my mother.
passages.vernacular: 真可憐。但伊阿古知道佢同凱西奧做嗰羞恥之事上千次;凱西奧招認喇,佢用我最初畀佢嘅嗰份愛嘅憑證同信物回報佢嘅情事;我睇見佢喺佢手裡。嗰個係一條手帕,我父親畀我母親嘅古老信物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真可憐。但伊阿古知道她和凱西奧做那羞恥之事上千次;凱西奧招認了,她用我最初給她的那份愛的憑證和信物回報他的情事;我看見它在他手裡。那是一條手帕,我父親給我母親的古老信物。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O heaven! O heavenly powers!
passages.vernacular: 啊天啊!啊天上嘅諸力!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊天啊!啊天上的諸力!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Come, hold your peace.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,閉嘴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,閉嘴。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Twill out, ’twill out. I peace? No, I will speak as liberal as the north. Let heaven and men and devils, let them all, All, all, cry shame against me, yet I’ll speak.
passages.vernacular: 佢要講出嚟,佢要講出嚟。我閉嘴?不,我要像北風嗰樣自由地講。讓天、人、魔鬼,讓佢哋全部,全部,都喊羞恥嚟攻擊我,我仍要講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它要說出來,它要說出來。我閉嘴?不,我要像北風那樣自由地說。讓天、人、魔鬼,讓他們全部,全部,都喊羞恥來攻擊我,我仍要說。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Be wise, and get you home.
passages.vernacular: 放聰明點,回家去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放聰明點,回家去。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I will not.
passages.vernacular: 我不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不。

passages.original: [Iago offers to stab his wife.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古作勢刺佢妻子。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古作勢刺他妻子。]

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Fie! Your sword upon a woman?
passages.vernacular: 呸!你嘅劍對住一個女人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸!你的劍對著一個女人?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O thou dull Moor, that handkerchief thou speak’st of I found by fortune and did give my husband; For often with a solemn earnestness, More than indeed belong’d to such a trifle, He begg’d of me to steal it.
passages.vernacular: 啊你呢遲鈍嘅摩爾人,你講嘅嗰條手帕係我偶然撿到,交畀我丈夫嘅;因為佢常常懷住莊重嘅認真,遠超呢種小事所應有嘅,求我偷佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你這遲鈍的摩爾人,你說的那條手帕是我偶然撿到,交給我丈夫的;因為他常常懷著莊重的認真,遠超這種小事所應有的,求我偷它。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Villanous whore!
passages.vernacular: 奸惡嘅娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奸惡的娼婦!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: She give it Cassio! no, alas, I found it, And I did give’t my husband.
passages.vernacular: 佢畀凱西奧!不,哎呀,我撿到佢,並把佢畀咗我丈夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她給凱西奧!不,哎呀,我撿到它,並把它給了我丈夫。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Filth, thou liest!
passages.vernacular: 污穢,你撒謊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 污穢,你撒謊!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: By heaven, I do not, I do not, gentlemen. O murderous coxcomb! What should such a fool Do with so good a wife?
passages.vernacular: 天啊,我冇,我冇,各位先生。啊殺人嘅蠢貨!咁樣一個傻瓜,要咁好嘅妻子做乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,我沒有,我沒有,各位先生。啊殺人的蠢貨!這樣一個傻瓜,要這麼好的妻子做什麼?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are there not stones in heaven But what serve for thunder? Precious villain!
passages.vernacular: 天上難道除咗打雷用嘅,冇別嘅石頭嗎?寶貝一樣嘅惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天上難道除了打雷用的,沒有別的石頭嗎?寶貝一樣的惡棍!

passages.original: [Iago stabs Emilia and then runs out.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古刺愛米利亞,然後跑出。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古刺愛米利亞,然後跑出。]

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: The woman falls. Sure, he hath kill’d his wife.
passages.vernacular: 嗰女人倒下喇。肯定,佢殺咗佢妻子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那女人倒下了。肯定,他殺了他妻子。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Ay, ay. O, lay me by my mistress’ side.
passages.vernacular: 係,係。啊,把我放喺我夫人身旁。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,是。啊,把我放在我夫人身旁。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: He’s gone, but his wife’s kill’d.
passages.vernacular: 佢逃喇,但佢妻子被殺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他逃了,但他妻子被殺了。

passages.title: Montano 蒙塔諾
passages.original: ’Tis a notorious villain. Take you this weapon, Which I have here recover’d from the Moor. Come, guard the door without, let him not pass, But kill him rather. I’ll after that same villain, For ’tis a damned slave.
passages.vernacular: 佢係個惡名昭彰嘅惡棍。你攞呢把武器,我從摩爾人嗰度奪回嚟嘅。嚟,守住外面嘅門,唔好畀佢過,殺咗佢都行。我去追嗰個惡棍,因為佢係個該死嘅奴才。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他是個惡名昭彰的惡棍。你拿這把武器,我從摩爾人那裡奪回來的。來,守住外面的門,別讓他過,殺了他也行。我去追那個惡棍,因為他是個該死的奴才。

passages.original: [Exit Montano and Gratiano.]
passages.vernacular: [蒙塔諾同格拉希安諾下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [蒙塔諾和格拉希安諾下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am not valiant neither, But every puny whipster gets my sword. But why should honour outlive honesty? Let it go all.
passages.vernacular: 我都不勇敢,連每個瘦弱嘅鞭子手都能奪走我嘅劍。但點解榮譽要比誠實活得更久?讓一切都去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不勇敢,連每個瘦弱的鞭子手都能奪走我的劍。但為什麼榮譽要比誠實活得更久?讓一切都去吧。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: What did thy song bode, lady? Hark, canst thou hear me? I will play the swan, And die in music. [Sings.] Willow, willow, willow. Moor, she was chaste. She lov’d thee, cruel Moor, So come my soul to bliss, as I speak true; So speaking as I think, I die, I die.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅歌預示乜嘢,夫人?聽,你能聽到我嗎?我要扮天鵝,喺音樂中死去。[唱。]柳,柳,柳。摩爾人,佢係貞潔嘅。佢愛你,殘酷嘅摩爾人,我講嘅係真話,願我嘅靈魂得享福樂;按我所想嘅講,我死喇,我死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的歌預示什麼,夫人?聽,你能聽到我嗎?我要扮天鵝,在音樂中死去。[唱。]柳,柳,柳。摩爾人,她是貞潔的。她愛你,殘酷的摩爾人,我說的是真話,願我的靈魂得享福樂;按我所想的說,我死了,我死了。

passages.original: [She dies.]
passages.vernacular: [佢死。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [她死。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I have another weapon in this chamber, It is a sword of Spain, the ice-brook’s temper. O, here it is. Uncle, I must come forth.
passages.vernacular: 我喺呢房間裡仲有另一件武器,係西班牙劍,冰溪淬煉嘅。啊,喺呢度。叔叔,我必須出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這房間裡還有另一件武器,是西班牙劍,冰溪淬煉的。啊,在這裡。叔叔,我必須出來。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: [Within.] If thou attempt it, it will cost thee dear; Thou hast no weapon, and perforce must suffer.
passages.vernacular: [內。]如果你試圖咁樣,你會付出昂貴代價;你冇武器,只能忍受。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]如果你試圖這樣,你會付出昂貴代價;你沒有武器,只能忍受。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Look in upon me then, and speak with me, Or, naked as I am, I will assault thee.
passages.vernacular: 咁進嚟睇我,同我講話,否則我赤手都要攻擊你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼進來看我,與我說話,否則我赤手也要攻擊你。

passages.original: Enter Gratiano.
passages.vernacular: [格拉希安諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [格拉希安諾上。]

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: What is the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Behold, I have a weapon. A better never did itself sustain Upon a soldier’s thigh: I have seen the day That with this little arm and this good sword I have made my way through more impediments Than twenty times your stop. But, O vain boast! Who can control his fate? ’Tis not so now. Be not afraid, though you do see me weapon’d. Here is my journey’s end, here is my butt, And very sea-mark of my utmost sail. Do you go back dismay’d? ’Tis a lost fear. Man but a rush against Othello’s breast, And he retires. Where should Othello go? Now, how dost thou look now? O ill-starr’d wench, Pale as thy smock, when we shall meet at compt, This look of thine will hurl my soul from heaven, And fiends will snatch at it. Cold, cold, my girl! Even like thy chastity. O cursed, cursed slave! Whip me, ye devils, From the possession of this heavenly sight! Blow me about in winds, roast me in sulphur, Wash me in steep-down gulfs of liquid fire! O Desdemon! Dead, Desdemon! dead! Oh, oh!
passages.vernacular: 睇,我有武器。軍人腿上從未佩帶過更好嘅:我見過嗰樣嘅日子,憑呢條小小嘅臂同呢把好劍,我衝破嘅阻礙比你嘅攔阻多二十倍。但係,啊,虛妄嘅誇口!邊個能控制自己嘅命運?而家唔係嗰樣喇。別怕,雖然你睇見我有武器。呢度係我旅途嘅終點,係我嘅靶子,係我最遠航行嘅海標。你驚慌地退回去嗎?呢個係徒然嘅恐懼。只要用一根蘆葦對住奧賽羅嘅胸膛,佢就退縮。奧賽羅仲能去邊?而家,你睇起嚟點樣?啊命運不幸嘅少女,蒼白如你嘅襯衣,當我哋喺審判時相遇,你呢副面容會把我嘅靈魂從天堂拋下,惡魔會搶走佢。冷,冷,我嘅姑娘!就像你嘅貞潔。啊,該死嘅,該死嘅奴才!鞭打我吧,你哋魔鬼,讓我脫離呢天堂般景象嘅佔有!用風把我吹得四散,用硫磺烤我,把我浸入深淵般嘅液態火中!啊戴絲德夢娜!死喇,戴絲德夢娜!死喇!啊,啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,我有武器。軍人腿上從未佩帶過更好的:我見過那樣的日子,憑這條小小的臂和這把好劍,我衝破的阻礙比你的攔阻多二十倍。但是,啊,虛妄的誇口!誰能控制自己的命運?現在不是那樣了。別怕,雖然你看見我有武器。這裡是我旅途的終點,是我的靶子,是我最遠航行的海標。你驚慌地退回去嗎?這是徒然的恐懼。只要用一根蘆葦對著奧賽羅的胸膛,他就退縮。奧賽羅還能去哪?現在,你看起來怎樣?啊命運不幸的少女,蒼白如你的襯衣,當我們在審判時相遇,你這副面容會把我的靈魂從天堂拋下,惡魔會搶走它。冷,冷,我的姑娘!就像你的貞潔。啊,該死的,該死的奴才!鞭打我吧,你們魔鬼,讓我脫離這天堂般景象的佔有!用風把我吹得四散,用硫磺烤我,把我浸入深淵般的液態火中!啊戴絲德夢娜!死了,戴絲德夢娜!死了!啊,啊!

passages.original: Enter Lodovico, Montano, Cassio carried in a chair, and Officers with Iago prisoner.
passages.vernacular: [洛多維科、蒙塔諾、被抬喺椅子上嘅凱西奧,以及押住被俘嘅伊阿古嘅軍官哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [洛多維科、蒙塔諾、被抬在椅子上的凱西奧,以及押著被俘的伊阿古的軍官們上。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Where is this rash and most unfortunate man?
passages.vernacular: 嗰個魯莽而最不幸嘅人喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那個魯莽而最不幸的人在哪?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That’s he that was Othello. Here I am.
passages.vernacular: 嗰曾係奧賽羅嘅人。我喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那曾是奧賽羅的人。我在這裡。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Where is that viper? Bring the villain forth.
passages.vernacular: 嗰條毒蛇喺邊?把惡棍帶上嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那條毒蛇在哪?把惡棍帶上來。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I look down towards his feet; but that’s a fable. If that thou be’st a devil, I cannot kill thee.
passages.vernacular: 我低頭睇佢嘅腳;但嗰個係神話。如果你係魔鬼,我殺不死你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我低頭看他的腳;但那是神話。如果你是魔鬼,我殺不死你。

passages.original: [Wounds Iago.]
passages.vernacular: [刺傷伊阿古。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺傷伊阿古。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Wrench his sword from him.
passages.vernacular: 奪下佢嘅劍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奪下他的劍。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I bleed, sir, but not kill’d.
passages.vernacular: 我流血喇,先生,但冇被殺死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我流血了,先生,但沒被殺死。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am not sorry neither. I’d have thee live, For in my sense ’tis happiness to die.
passages.vernacular: 我都不覺得遺憾。我要你活住,因為喺我睇來,死係幸福。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不覺得遺憾。我要你活著,因為在我看來,死是幸福。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: O thou Othello, that wert once so good, Fall’n in the practice of a damned slave, What shall be said to thee?
passages.vernacular: 啊你奧賽羅,曾經咁好,竟落入該死奴才嘅詭計中,對你該講乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你奧賽羅,曾經這麼好,竟落入該死奴才的詭計中,對你該說什麼?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why, anything; An honourable murderer, if you will. For naught did I in hate, but all in honour.
passages.vernacular: 咦,隨便乜嘢;一個光榮嘅殺人者,如果你願意。因為我做嘅冇一件係出於恨,全係出於榮譽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,隨便什麼;一個光榮的殺人者,如果你願意。因為我做的沒有一件是出於恨,全是出於榮譽。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: This wretch hath part confess’d his villany. Did you and he consent in Cassio’s death?
passages.vernacular: 呢個惡棍已部分招認咗佢嘅奸惡。你同佢共謀殺凱西奧嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個惡棍已部分招認了他的奸惡。你和他共謀殺凱西奧嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay.
passages.vernacular: 係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Dear general, I never gave you cause.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅將軍,我從未畀你理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的將軍,我從未給你理由。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I do believe it, and I ask your pardon. Will you, I pray, demand that demi-devil Why he hath thus ensnar’d my soul and body?
passages.vernacular: 我相信,請你原諒我。請你問問嗰個半魔鬼,點解佢咁樣纏住我嘅靈魂同身體?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我相信,請你原諒我。請你問問那個半魔鬼,為什麼他這樣纏住我的靈魂和身體?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Demand me nothing. What you know, you know. From this time forth I never will speak word.
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢都別問我。你哋知道嘅,就係知道嘅。從此刻起,我再不講一個字。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼都別問我。你們知道的,就是知道的。從此刻起,我再不說一個字。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: What, not to pray?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,連祈禱都不講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,連祈禱也不說?

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Torments will ope your lips.
passages.vernacular: 酷刑會打開你嘅嘴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 酷刑會打開你的嘴。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Well, thou dost best.
passages.vernacular: 好,你咁樣做最好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,你這樣做最好。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Sir, you shall understand what hath befall’n, Which, as I think, you know not. Here is a letter Found in the pocket of the slain Roderigo, And here another. The one of them imports The death of Cassio, to be undertook By Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: 先生,你要了解發生咗乜嘢,我想你唔知道。呢度有一封信,喺被殺嘅羅德利哥口袋裡找到,仲有另一封。其中一封講明凱西奧嘅死,要由羅德利哥執行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,你要了解發生了什麼,我想你不知道。這裡有一封信,在被殺的羅德利哥口袋裡找到,還有另一封。其中一封說明凱西奧的死,要由羅德利哥執行。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O villain!
passages.vernacular: 啊惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊惡棍!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Most heathenish and most gross!
passages.vernacular: 最異教徒、最粗劣嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最異教徒、最粗劣的!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Now here’s another discontented paper, Found in his pocket too; and this, it seems, Roderigo meant to have sent this damned villain, But that, belike, Iago in the interim Came in and satisfied him.
passages.vernacular: 而家呢度有另一封不滿嘅信,都喺佢口袋裡找到;睇來,羅德利哥本打算把呢封送畀呢個該死嘅惡棍,不過大概伊阿古喺此期間嚟喇,講服咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在這裡有另一封不滿的信,也在他口袋裡找到;看來,羅德利哥本打算把這封送給這個該死的惡棍,可是大概伊阿古在此期間來了,說服了他。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O the pernicious caitiff! How came you, Cassio, by that handkerchief That was my wife’s?
passages.vernacular: 啊,有害嘅惡棍!凱西奧,你點得到嗰條我妻子嘅手帕?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,有害的惡棍!凱西奧,你怎麼得到那條我妻子的手帕?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I found it in my chamber. And he himself confess’d but even now, That there he dropp’d it for a special purpose Which wrought to his desire.
passages.vernacular: 我喺我房間裡找到嘅。而佢自己頭先都招認喇,佢係為了特殊目的把佢丟喺嗰度,結果如願以償。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在我房間裡找到的。而他自己剛才也招認了,他是為了特殊目的把它丟在那裡,結果如願以償。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O fool! fool! fool!
passages.vernacular: 啊傻瓜!傻瓜!傻瓜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊傻瓜!傻瓜!傻瓜!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: There is besides in Roderigo’s letter, How he upbraids Iago, that he made him Brave me upon the watch, whereon it came That I was cast. And even but now he spake, After long seeming dead, Iago hurt him, Iago set him on.
passages.vernacular: 此外,羅德利哥嘅信中仲講,佢點樣責備伊阿古,講佢使佢喺夜間守衛時向我挑釁,導致我被革職。就喺頭先佢講話,佢長久似乎死喇,講伊阿古傷咗佢,伊阿古唆使佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 此外,羅德利哥的信中還說,他怎樣責備伊阿古,說他使他在夜間守衛時向我挑釁,導致我被革職。就在剛才他說話,他長久似乎死了,說伊阿古傷了他,伊阿古唆使他。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: You must forsake this room, and go with us. Your power and your command is taken off, And Cassio rules in Cyprus. For this slave, If there be any cunning cruelty That can torment him much and hold him long, It shall be his. You shall close prisoner rest, Till that the nature of your fault be known To the Venetian state. Come, bring away.
passages.vernacular: 你必須離開呢房間,跟我哋走。你嘅權力同你嘅指揮權已被解除,凱西奧治理塞浦路斯。至於呢個奴才,如果有任何狡猾殘忍嘅手段能最折磨佢、拖延最久,就都歸佢。你將被嚴密囚禁,直到你嘅罪行性質為威尼斯國家所知。嚟,帶走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須離開這房間,跟我們走。你的權力和你的指揮權已被解除,凱西奧治理塞浦路斯。至於這個奴才,如果有任何狡猾殘忍的手段能最折磨他、拖延最久,就都歸他。你將被嚴密囚禁,直到你的罪行性質為威尼斯國家所知。來,帶走。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Soft you; a word or two before you go. I have done the state some service, and they know’t. No more of that. I pray you, in your letters, When you shall these unlucky deeds relate, Speak of me as I am. Nothing extenuate, Nor set down aught in malice. Then must you speak Of one that loved not wisely, but too well; Of one not easily jealous, but being wrought, Perplex’d in the extreme; of one whose hand, Like the base Judean, threw a pearl away Richer than all his tribe; of one whose subdu’d eyes, Albeit unused to the melting mood, Drop tears as fast as the Arabian trees Their medicinal gum. Set you down this. And say besides, that in Aleppo once, Where a malignant and a turban’d Turk Beat a Venetian and traduc’d the state, I took by the throat the circumcised dog, And smote him, thus.
passages.vernacular: 慢住;走之前我講一兩句話。我為國家做過啲事,佢哋知道。唔好再講嗰個喇。我請求你哋,喺你哋嘅信中,敘述呢啲不幸嘅事時,按我嘅真實樣子講我。唔好減輕乜嘢,都唔好懷惡意寫任何事。咁你哋必須講到一個愛得不明智,卻愛得太深嘅人;一個不輕易嫉妒,但一旦被挑動就極度困惑嘅人;一個像卑賤嘅猶太人嗰樣,親手扔掉一顆比佢全族都更富貴嘅珍珠嘅人;一個雖然不習慣流淚,佢被制服嘅眼睛卻像阿拉伯樹滴出藥膠嗰樣迅速落淚嘅人。把呢啲寫下。仲要講,有一次喺阿勒坡,有個惡毒、戴頭巾嘅土耳其人打咗一個威尼斯人並誹謗國家,我揪住呢割過禮嘅狗嘅咽喉,咁樣刺佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 慢著;走之前我說一兩句話。我為國家做過一些事,他們知道。別再說那個了。我請求你們,在你們的信中,敘述這些不幸的事時,按我的真實樣子講我。不要減輕什麼,也不要懷惡意寫任何事。那麼你們必須說到一個愛得不明智,卻愛得太深的人;一個不輕易嫉妒,但一旦被挑動就極度困惑的人;一個像卑賤的猶太人那樣,親手扔掉一顆比他全族都更富貴的珍珠的人;一個雖然不習慣流淚,他被制服的眼睛卻像阿拉伯樹滴出藥膠那樣迅速落淚的人。把這些寫下。還要說,有一次在阿勒坡,有個惡毒、戴頭巾的土耳其人打了一個威尼斯人並誹謗國家,我揪住這割過禮的狗的咽喉,這樣刺他。

passages.original: [Stabs himself.]
passages.vernacular: [刺自己。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺自己。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: O bloody period!
passages.vernacular: 啊,血腥嘅句號!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,血腥的句號!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: All that’s spoke is marr’d.
passages.vernacular: 所有講過嘅都被毀喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所有說過的都被毀了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I kiss’d thee ere I kill’d thee. No way but this, Killing myself, to die upon a kiss.
passages.vernacular: 我喺殺你之前吻咗你。冇別嘅路,只有咁樣,自殺,死喺一個吻上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在殺你之前吻了你。沒有別的路,只有這樣,自殺,死在一個吻上。

passages.original: [Falling upon Desdemona.]
passages.vernacular: [倒喺戴絲德夢娜身上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [倒在戴絲德夢娜身上。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: This did I fear, but thought he had no weapon, For he was great of heart.
passages.vernacular: 呢個我曾擔心,但以為佢冇武器,因為佢心胸寬大。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個我曾擔心,但以為他沒有武器,因為他心胸寬大。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: [To Iago.] O Spartan dog, More fell than anguish, hunger, or the sea, Look on the tragic loading of this bed. This is thy work. The object poisons sight, Let it be hid. Gratiano, keep the house, And seize upon the fortunes of the Moor, For they succeed on you. To you, lord governor, Remains the censure of this hellish villain. The time, the place, the torture, O, enforce it! Myself will straight aboard, and to the state This heavy act with heavy heart relate.
passages.vernacular: [對伊阿古。]啊斯巴達嘅狗,比痛苦、飢餓或海洋更凶殘,睇睇呢張床上悲慘嘅負載。呢個係你嘅傑作。呢景象毒害視覺,把佢遮起嚟。格拉希安諾,守住呢座房子,接管摩爾人嘅財產,因為呢啲由你繼承。大人總督,呢個地獄般惡棍嘅判決由你負責。時間、地點、酷刑,啊,務必施行!我自己即刻上船,把呢沉重嘅事以沉重嘅心情向國家報告。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對伊阿古。]啊斯巴達的狗,比痛苦、飢餓或海洋更凶殘,看看這張床上悲慘的負載。這是你的傑作。這景象毒害視覺,把它遮起來。格拉希安諾,守住這座房子,接管摩爾人的財產,因為這些由你繼承。大人總督,這個地獄般惡棍的判決由你負責。時間、地點、酷刑,啊,務必施行!我自己立刻上船,把這沉重的事以沉重的心情向國家報告。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
